===== FILE: standalone/mezip-local/apps/web/public/crystal-portrait-particle-v2/photo-particles.js =====
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const experience = document.getElementById('experience');
  const canvas = document.getElementById('particleCanvas');
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: true, desynchronized: true });
  const photoAnchor = document.getElementById('photoAnchor');
  const portraitShell = document.getElementById('portraitShell');
  const portraitImage = document.getElementById('portraitImage');
  const status = document.getElementById('renderStatus');
  const sourceCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const sourceContext = sourceCanvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

  const particles = [];
  const viewport = { width: 1, height: 1, dpr: 1 };
  const pointer = {
    x: -1e6, y: -1e6, lastX: -1e6, lastY: -1e6,
    vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 0, inside: false, movedAt: -Infinity
  };
  const viewMotion = { x: 0, y: 0, targetX: 0, targetY: 0, lightX: 50, lightY: 46 };
  let photoBox = { x: 0, y: 0, width: 1, height: 1 };
  let imageReady = false;
  let resizeFrame = 0;
  let lastFrame = performance.now();

  const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
  const luminance = (r, g, b) => r * .2126 + g * .7152 + b * .0722;

  function sizeCanvas() {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    viewport.width = Math.max(1, rect.width);
    viewport.height = Math.max(1, rect.height);
    viewport.dpr = Math.min(Math.max(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1), 1.5);
    canvas.width = Math.round(viewport.width * viewport.dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(viewport.height * viewport.dpr);
    context.setTransform(viewport.dpr, 0, 0, viewport.dpr, 0, 0);
    if (imageReady) buildContourParticles();
  }

  function pixelScore(data, width, height, x, y) {
    const sx = clamp(x, 0, width - 1);
    const sy = clamp(y, 0, height - 1);
    const index = (sy * width + sx) * 4;
    const r = data[index];
    const g = data[index + 1];
    const b = data[index + 2];
    const value = luminance(r, g, b);
    const chroma = Math.max(r, g, b) - Math.min(r, g, b);
    return { r, g, b, value, chroma, foreground: value > 11 || chroma > 19 };
  }

  function addParticle({ x, y, normalX, normalY, r, g, b, edge, brightness, depth }) {
    const homeDistance = 2.2 + Math.random() * (6.5 + edge * 9);
    const tangentX = -normalY;
    const tangentY = normalX;
    const tangent = (Math.random() - .5) * (2.6 + edge * 3.2);
    const homeX = x + normalX * homeDistance + tangentX * tangent;
    const homeY = y + normalY * homeDistance + tangentY * tangent;
    const lift = 1.12 + edge * .31;
    particles.push({
      homeX,
      homeY,
      x: homeX,
      y: homeY,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      z: depth,
      vz: 0,
      baseZ: depth,
      r: clamp(r * lift, 0, 255),
      g: clamp(g * lift, 0, 255),
      b: clamp(b * lift, 0, 255),
      edge,
      size: .85 + edge * 1.55 + Math.random() * .72,
      alpha: clamp(.36 + brightness / 255 * .39 + edge * .28, .35, .98),
      seed: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      shard: edge > .43 && Math.random() > .45
    });
  }

  function buildContourParticles() {
    particles.length = 0;
    const anchorRect = photoAnchor.getBoundingClientRect();
    photoBox = { x: anchorRect.x, y: anchorRect.y, width: anchorRect.width, height: anchorRect.height };

    const sampleWidth = 224;
    const sampleHeight = Math.round(sampleWidth * portraitImage.naturalHeight / portraitImage.naturalWidth);
    sourceCanvas.width = sampleWidth;
    sourceCanvas.height = sampleHeight;
    sourceContext.clearRect(0, 0, sampleWidth, sampleHeight);
    sourceContext.drawImage(portraitImage, 0, 0, sampleWidth, sampleHeight);
    const { data } = sourceContext.getImageData(0, 0, sampleWidth, sampleHeight);
    const scaleX = photoBox.width / sampleWidth;
    const scaleY = photoBox.height / sampleHeight;
    const cap = viewport.width < 680 ? 2500 : 3900;

    for (let y = 2; y < sampleHeight - 2; y += 1) {
      for (let x = 2; x < sampleWidth - 2; x += 1) {
        const here = pixelScore(data, sampleWidth, sampleHeight, x, y);
        if (!here.foreground) continue;

        const left = pixelScore(data, sampleWidth, sampleHeight, x - 2, y);
        const right = pixelScore(data, sampleWidth, sampleHeight, x + 2, y);
        const top = pixelScore(data, sampleWidth, sampleHeight, x, y - 2);
        const bottom = pixelScore(data, sampleWidth, sampleHeight, x, y + 2);
        const exteriorCount = [left, right, top, bottom].filter((point) => !point.foreground).length;
        const gradientX = right.value - left.value;
        const gradientY = bottom.value - top.value;
        const gradientLength = Math.max(Math.hypot(gradientX, gradientY), 1);
        const edge = clamp((Math.abs(gradientX) + Math.abs(gradientY)) / 154 + exteriorCount * .12, 0, 1);

        if (exteriorCount === 0 && edge < .48) continue;
        const keepChance = exteriorCount > 0 ? .72 : .10;
        if (Math.random() > keepChance * (.68 + edge * .55)) continue;

        addParticle({
          x: photoBox.x + (x + .5) * scaleX,
          y: photoBox.y + (y + .5) * scaleY,
          normalX: -gradientX / gradientLength,
          normalY: -gradientY / gradientLength,
          r: here.r,
          g: here.g,
          b: here.b,
          edge,
          brightness: here.value,
          depth: .6 + edge * 4.4 + Math.random() * 2.2
        });
      }
    }

    for (let index = particles.length - 1; index > cap; index -= 1) {
      const swapIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * (index + 1));
      [particles[index], particles[swapIndex]] = [particles[swapIndex], particles[index]];
    }
    if (particles.length > cap) particles.length = cap;

    canvas.dataset.ready = 'true';
    canvas.dataset.particles = String(particles.length);
    status.textContent = `实体照片已就位，外轮廓共有 ${particles.length} 个彩色粒子。`;
  }

  function drawDiamond(x, y, size) {
    context.beginPath();
    context.moveTo(x, y - size);
    context.lineTo(x + size, y);
    context.lineTo(x, y + size);
    context.lineTo(x - size, y);
    context.closePath();
    context.fill();
  }

  function updateParticle(particle, delta, now) {
    const recent = pointer.inside && now - pointer.movedAt < 150 && pointer.speed > .4 && !reducedMotion?.matches;
    if (recent) {
      const dx = particle.x - pointer.x;
      const dy = particle.y - pointer.y;
      const distance = Math.max(Math.hypot(dx, dy), 1);
      const radius = clamp(photoBox.width * .38, 125, 186);
      const normalized = distance / radius;
      const influence = clamp(2 * normalized * Math.exp(-normalized * normalized * 1.4), 0, 1);
      if (influence > .012) {
        const force = influence * (.35 + Math.min(pointer.speed, 46) * .072);
        const tangent = Math.sin(particle.seed + now * .002) * influence * .34;
        particle.vx += (dx / distance * force + pointer.vx * influence * .035 - dy / distance * tangent) * delta;
        particle.vy += (dy / distance * force + pointer.vy * influence * .035 + dx / distance * tangent) * delta;
        particle.vz += influence * (1 + pointer.speed * .035) * delta;
      }
    }

    particle.vx += (particle.homeX - particle.x) * .098 * delta;
    particle.vy += (particle.homeY - particle.y) * .098 * delta;
    particle.vz += (particle.baseZ - particle.z) * .11 * delta;
    particle.vx *= Math.pow(.72, delta);
    particle.vy *= Math.pow(.72, delta);
    particle.vz *= Math.pow(.7, delta);
    particle.x += particle.vx * delta;
    particle.y += particle.vy * delta;
    particle.z += particle.vz * delta;
  }

  function render(now) {
    const delta = Math.min((now - lastFrame) / 16.667, 1.8);
    lastFrame = now;
    context.clearRect(0, 0, viewport.width, viewport.height);

    const recentMotion = pointer.inside && now - pointer.movedAt < 170 && !reducedMotion?.matches;
    canvas.dataset.motion = recentMotion ? 'active' : 'idle';
    viewMotion.targetX = recentMotion ? clamp((pointer.y / viewport.height - .5) * -2.2, -1.3, 1.3) : 0;
    viewMotion.targetY = recentMotion ? clamp((pointer.x / viewport.width - .5) * 2.4, -1.5, 1.5) : 0;
    viewMotion.x += (viewMotion.targetX - viewMotion.x) * .06;
    viewMotion.y += (viewMotion.targetY - viewMotion.y) * .06;
    viewMotion.lightX += ((recentMotion ? pointer.x / viewport.width * 100 : 50) - viewMotion.lightX) * .05;
    viewMotion.lightY += ((recentMotion ? pointer.y / viewport.height * 100 : 46) - viewMotion.lightY) * .05;
    portraitShell.style.transform = `perspective(1200px) rotateX(${viewMotion.x.toFixed(3)}deg) rotateY(${viewMotion.y.toFixed(3)}deg)`;
    portraitShell.style.setProperty('--light-x', `${viewMotion.lightX.toFixed(2)}%`);
    portraitShell.style.setProperty('--light-y', `${viewMotion.lightY.toFixed(2)}%`);

    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    for (const particle of particles) {
      updateParticle(particle, delta, now);
      const depth = particle.z / 6;
      const x = particle.x + viewMotion.y * depth * 1.2;
      const y = particle.y - viewMotion.x * depth * 1.2;
      context.fillStyle = `rgba(${particle.r}, ${particle.g}, ${particle.b}, ${particle.alpha * .12})`;
      const haloSize = particle.size * (2.4 + depth * .5);
      context.fillRect(x - haloSize * .5, y - haloSize * .5, haloSize, haloSize);
    }

    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    for (const particle of particles) {
      const depth = particle.z / 6;
      const x = particle.x + viewMotion.y * depth * 1.2;
      const y = particle.y - viewMotion.x * depth * 1.2;
      context.fillStyle = `rgba(${particle.r}, ${particle.g}, ${particle.b}, ${particle.alpha})`;
      if (particle.shard) drawDiamond(x, y, particle.size);
      else context.fillRect(x - particle.size * .5, y - particle.size * .5, particle.size, particle.size);
    }
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

    pointer.vx *= .82;
    pointer.vy *= .82;
    pointer.speed = Math.hypot(pointer.vx, pointer.vy);
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }

  function movePointer(event) {
    const rect = experience.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
    if (!pointer.inside) {
      pointer.lastX = x;
      pointer.lastY = y;
      pointer.inside = true;
    }
    pointer.vx = clamp(x - pointer.lastX, -46, 46);
    pointer.vy = clamp(y - pointer.lastY, -46, 46);
    pointer.speed = Math.hypot(pointer.vx, pointer.vy);
    pointer.x = x;
    pointer.y = y;
    pointer.lastX = x;
    pointer.lastY = y;
    pointer.movedAt = performance.now();
  }

  function leavePointer() {
    pointer.inside = false;
    pointer.x = -1e6;
    pointer.y = -1e6;
    pointer.lastX = -1e6;
    pointer.lastY = -1e6;
  }

  experience.addEventListener('pointermove', movePointer, { passive: true });
  experience.addEventListener('pointerdown', movePointer, { passive: true });
  experience.addEventListener('pointerleave', leavePointer, { passive: true });
  experience.addEventListener('pointercancel', leavePointer, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(resizeFrame);
    resizeFrame = requestAnimationFrame(sizeCanvas);
  }, { passive: true });

  window.__entityPhotoParticleDebug = {
    getState() {
      const displacement = particles.reduce((summary, particle) => {
        const distance = Math.hypot(particle.x - particle.homeX, particle.y - particle.homeY);
        summary.total += distance;
        summary.max = Math.max(summary.max, distance);
        return summary;
      }, { total: 0, max: 0 });
      return {
        imageReady,
        particleCount: particles.length,
        photoOpacity: Number.parseFloat(getComputedStyle(portraitImage).opacity),
        photoNaturalSize: [portraitImage.naturalWidth, portraitImage.naturalHeight],
        averageDisplacement: particles.length ? displacement.total / particles.length : 0,
        maxDisplacement: displacement.max,
        pointerInside: pointer.inside
      };
    }
  };

  portraitImage.addEventListener('load', () => {
    imageReady = true;
    sizeCanvas();
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }, { once: true });
  portraitImage.addEventListener('error', () => {
    status.textContent = '实体照片载入失败。';
  }, { once: true });
  if (portraitImage.complete && portraitImage.naturalWidth > 0) portraitImage.dispatchEvent(new Event('load'));
})();

  <script>
    (() => {
      'use strict';
      const $ = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector);
      const endpoint = '/api/film-studio/v1';
      const state = { recording: false, recorder: null, display: null, microphone: null, mixer: null, chunks: [], startedAt: 0, libraries: { emotion: [], action: [] }, selected: null, pendingDelete: null, source: null, start: null, rect: null };
      const formatBytes = (value) => { const bytes = Number(value || 0); return bytes < 1024 * 1024 ? `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB` : `${(bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`; };
      const formatDate = (value) => { const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '时间未知' : date.toLocaleString('zh-CN'); };
      const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[character]));
      const setStatus = (message, active) => { const status = $('#capture-status'); status.textContent = message; status.classList.toggle('active', Boolean(active)); };
      const toast = (message) => { const item = $('#toast'); item.textContent = message; item.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(window.__emotionToast); window.__emotionToast = window.setTimeout(() => item.classList.remove('show'), 3200); };
      const open = (dialog) => { if (!dialog.open) dialog.showModal(); }; const close = (dialog) => { if (dialog.open) dialog.close(); };
      const stopTracks = (stream) => { if (stream) stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop()); };
      const chooseMime = () => ['video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus', 'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus', 'video/webm'].find((mime) => window.MediaRecorder && MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mime)) || '';
      const resetStreams = () => { stopTracks(state.display); stopTracks(state.microphone); state.display = null; state.microphone = null; if (state.mixer) state.mixer.close().catch(() => {}); state.mixer = null; };
      async function displayStream() { if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getDisplayMedia) throw new Error('请使用新版 Edge 或 Chrome 进行屏幕捕获。'); return navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ video: { frameRate: { ideal: 30, max: 30 } }, audio: true, selfBrowserSurface: 'exclude' }); }
      async function combinedStream(display) { const stream = new MediaStream(); const video = display.getVideoTracks()[0]; if (!video) throw new Error('没有取得视频画面。'); stream.addTrack(video); if ($('#microphone').checked) { try { state.microphone = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, autoGainControl: true } }); } catch { throw new Error('麦克风未获授权，未开始录制。'); } } const sources = [display, state.microphone].filter(Boolean).filter((item) => item.getAudioTracks().length); if (!sources.length) return stream; try { state.mixer = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); const destination = state.mixer.createMediaStreamDestination(); sources.forEach((item) => state.mixer.createMediaStreamSource(item).connect(destination)); destination.stream.getAudioTracks().forEach((track) => stream.addTrack(track)); } catch { sources.forEach((item) => item.getAudioTracks().forEach((track) => stream.addTrack(track))); } return stream; }
      async function upload(kind, blob) { const response = await fetch(`${endpoint}/upload/${kind}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': blob.type || (kind === 'emotion' ? 'video/webm' : 'image/png') }, body: blob }); if (!response.ok) { const detail = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); throw new Error(detail.error || '保存失败'); } return response.json(); }
      async function refresh() { try { const response = await fetch(`${endpoint}/libraries`, { cache: 'no-store' }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(); const data = await response.json(); state.libraries.emotion = Array.isArray(data.emotion) ? data.emotion : []; state.libraries.action = Array.isArray(data.action) ? data.action : []; drawLibrary('emotion'); drawLibrary('action'); $('#emotion-count').textContent = String(state.libraries.emotion.length); $('#action-count').textContent = String(state.libraries.action.length); } catch { ['emotion', 'action'].forEach((kind) => { $(`#${kind}-list`).innerHTML = '<div class="empty">资料库暂时不可用。</div>'; }); } }
      function drawLibrary(kind) { const list = $(`#${kind}-list`); const items = state.libraries[kind]; list.innerHTML = ''; if (!items.length) { list.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${kind === 'emotion' ? 'Emotion. 暂无视频。' : 'Action. 暂无截图。'}</div>`; return; } items.forEach((item) => list.appendChild(assetRow(kind, item))); }
      function assetRow(kind, item) { const row = document.createElement('article'); row.className = 'asset'; const preview = document.createElement('button'); preview.type = 'button'; preview.className = 'asset-preview'; preview.title = '预览'; preview.setAttribute('aria-label', `预览 ${item.name}`); if (kind === 'emotion') { const video = document.createElement('video'); video.src = item.url; video.muted = true; video.preload = 'metadata'; preview.appendChild(video); } else { const image = document.createElement('img'); image.src = item.url; image.alt = ''; preview.appendChild(image); } const meta = document.createElement('div'); meta.className = 'asset-meta'; meta.innerHTML = `<div class="asset-name" title="${escapeHtml(item.name)}">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</div><div class="asset-detail">${escapeHtml(formatBytes(item.size))} · ${escapeHtml(formatDate(item.modifiedAt))}</div>`; const actions = document.createElement('div'); actions.className = 'asset-actions'; const view = document.createElement('button'); view.className = 'icon'; view.type = 'button'; view.textContent = '↗'; view.title = '查看'; const remove = document.createElement('button'); remove.className = 'icon delete'; remove.type = 'button'; remove.textContent = '⌫'; remove.title = '移到回收站'; preview.addEventListener('click', () => previewAsset(kind, item)); view.addEventListener('click', () => previewAsset(kind, item)); remove.addEventListener('click', () => requestDelete(kind, item)); actions.append(view, remove); row.append(preview, meta, actions); return row; }
      function previewAsset(kind, item) { state.selected = { kind, item }; const container = $('#preview-media'); container.innerHTML = ''; const media = document.createElement(kind === 'emotion' ? 'video' : 'img'); media.src = item.url; if (kind === 'emotion') { media.controls = true; media.autoplay = true; } else media.alt = item.name; container.appendChild(media); $('#preview-title').textContent = kind === 'emotion' ? 'Emotion. 视频' : 'Action. 截图'; $('#download').href = item.url; $('#download').download = item.name; open($('#preview-dialog')); }
      function requestDelete(kind, item) { state.pendingDelete = { kind, item }; $('#delete-copy').textContent = `“${item.name}”将移到 Windows 回收站，可以从回收站恢复。`; open($('#delete-dialog')); }
      async function deleteConfirmed() { const pending = state.pendingDelete; if (!pending) return; $('#delete-confirm').disabled = true; try { const response = await fetch(`${endpoint}/delete/${pending.kind}/${encodeURIComponent(pending.item.name)}`, { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'x-film-studio-confirm': 'recycle-bin' } }); if (!response.ok) { const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); throw new Error(data.error || '无法移到回收站'); } close($('#delete-dialog')); close($('#preview-dialog')); state.pendingDelete = null; toast('已移到 Windows 回收站。'); await refresh(); } catch (error) { toast(error.message || '无法移到回收站。'); } finally { $('#delete-confirm').disabled = false; } }
      async function record() { if (state.recording) return; if (!window.MediaRecorder) { toast('当前浏览器不支持视频录制。'); return; } try { setStatus('正在请求录制权限…'); state.display = await displayStream(); const stream = await combinedStream(state.display); state.chunks = []; const mime = chooseMime(); state.recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, mime ? { mimeType: mime } : undefined); state.recorder.ondataavailable = (event) => { if (event.data?.size) state.chunks.push(event.data); }; state.recorder.onstop = async () => { const blob = new Blob(state.chunks, { type: state.recorder.mimeType || 'video/webm' }); resetStreams(); state.recording = false; $('#record').disabled = false; $('#stop').disabled = true; if (!blob.size) { setStatus('未生成视频'); return; } try { setStatus('正在保存到 Emotion.…'); await upload('emotion', blob); setStatus('已保存到 Emotion.'); $('#capture-note').textContent = $('#microphone').checked ? '视频已保存，包含麦克风。' : '视频已保存到 Emotion.'; await refresh(); } catch (error) { setStatus('视频保存失败'); toast(error.message || '视频保存失败。'); } }; state.display.getVideoTracks()[0].addEventListener('ended', () => { if (state.recording) stop(); }, { once: true }); state.startedAt = Date.now(); state.recording = true; state.recorder.start(1000); $('#record').disabled = true; $('#stop').disabled = false; setStatus($('#microphone').checked ? '正在录制 · 麦克风开启' : '正在录制', true); $('#capture-note').textContent = $('#microphone').checked ? '屏幕外说话会录入视频。' : '录制视频将保存到 Emotion.'; } catch (error) { resetStreams(); setStatus('等待操作'); toast(error.message || '未获得录制权限。'); } }
      function stop() { if (!state.recording || !state.recorder) return; $('#stop').disabled = true; setStatus('正在保存…', true); if (state.recorder.state !== 'inactive') state.recorder.stop(); }
      function blobFor(canvas) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => canvas.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error('截图编码失败')), 'image/png')); }
      async function sourceCanvas() { const stream = await displayStream(); const video = document.createElement('video'); video.srcObject = stream; video.muted = true; video.playsInline = true; try { await video.play(); await new Promise((resolve) => video.readyState >= 2 ? resolve() : video.addEventListener('loadeddata', resolve, { once: true })); await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 80)); const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0]; const size = track?.getSettings?.() || {}; const width = video.videoWidth || size.width || 0; const height = video.videoHeight || size.height || 0; if (!width || !height) throw new Error('没有取得可截图的画面。'); const canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = width; canvas.height = height; canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0, width, height); return canvas; } finally { stopTracks(stream); video.srcObject = null; } }
      async function saveShot(canvas) { const blob = await blobFor(canvas); setStatus('正在保存到 Action.…'); await upload('action', blob); setStatus('已保存到 Action.'); $('#capture-note').textContent = '截图已保存到 Action.'; await refresh(); }
      async function fullShot() { try { setStatus('正在请求截图权限…'); await saveShot(await sourceCanvas()); } catch (error) { setStatus('等待操作'); toast(error.message || '未获得截图权限。'); } }
      function redrawSelection() { const display = $('#selection-canvas'); const source = state.source; if (!source) return; display.width = source.width; display.height = source.height; const context = display.getContext('2d'); context.drawImage(source, 0, 0); const rect = state.rect; if (!rect) return; context.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)'; context.fillRect(0, 0, display.width, display.height); context.clearRect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height); context.drawImage(source, rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height, rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height); context.strokeStyle = '#78d5cf'; context.lineWidth = Math.max(2, display.width / 1000); context.strokeRect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height); }
      function selectionPoint(event) { const display = $('#selection-canvas'); const bounds = display.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: Math.max(0, Math.min(display.width, (event.clientX - bounds.left) * display.width / bounds.width)), y: Math.max(0, Math.min(display.height, (event.clientY - bounds.top) * display.height / bounds.height)) }; }
      async function partialShot() { try { setStatus('正在请求局部截图权限…'); state.source = await sourceCanvas(); state.start = null; state.rect = null; redrawSelection(); open($('#selection-dialog')); setStatus('拖动选择区域'); } catch (error) { setStatus('等待操作'); toast(error.message || '未获得截图权限。'); } }
      async function finishSelection() { const rect = state.rect; const source = state.source; if (!rect || !source || rect.width < 12 || rect.height < 12) { toast('请选择更大的区域。'); return; } const crop = document.createElement('canvas'); crop.width = Math.round(rect.width); crop.height = Math.round(rect.height); crop.getContext('2d').drawImage(source, rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height); close($('#selection-dialog')); state.source = null; state.rect = null; await saveShot(crop); }
      $('#record').addEventListener('click', record); $('#stop').addEventListener('click', stop); $('#full-shot').addEventListener('click', fullShot); $('#partial-shot').addEventListener('click', partialShot); document.querySelectorAll('[data-refresh]').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => { void refresh(); })); $('#preview-close').addEventListener('click', () => close($('#preview-dialog'))); $('#preview-delete').addEventListener('click', () => state.selected && requestDelete(state.selected.kind, state.selected.item)); $('#delete-close').addEventListener('click', () => close($('#delete-dialog'))); $('#delete-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => close($('#delete-dialog'))); $('#delete-confirm').addEventListener('click', deleteConfirmed); const cancelSelection = () => { state.source = null; state.start = null; state.rect = null; close($('#selection-dialog')); setStatus('等待操作'); }; $('#selection-close').addEventListener('click', cancelSelection); $('#selection-cancel').addEventListener('click', cancelSelection);
      $('#selection-canvas').addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => { const point = selectionPoint(event); state.start = point; state.rect = { x: point.x, y: point.y, width: 0, height: 0 }; event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); redrawSelection(); }); $('#selection-canvas').addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => { if (!state.start) return; const point = selectionPoint(event); state.rect = { x: Math.min(state.start.x, point.x), y: Math.min(state.start.y, point.y), width: Math.abs(point.x - state.start.x), height: Math.abs(point.y - state.start.y) }; redrawSelection(); }); $('#selection-canvas').addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => { if (!state.start) return; state.start = null; event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture?.(event.pointerId); void finishSelection(); });
      window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => { if (state.recorder?.state === 'recording') state.recorder.stop(); else resetStreams(); }); window.setInterval(() => { if (!state.recording) void refresh(); }, 15000); void refresh();
    })();
  </script>
</body>

    (()=>{
      const KEY='mezip.film-studio.v3.effects';
      const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
      const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'null')||{movieTitle:'',movieDuration:120,subtitleText:'',highlights:[],look:'original',intensity:100,glow:false,prism:false,grain:false};
      const esc=v=>String(v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
      const toast=m=>{const t=$('#toast');if(!t)return;t.textContent=m;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(window.__filmV3Toast);window.__filmV3Toast=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2800)};
      const save=()=>localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(saved));
      const toSeconds=s=>{const x=String(s).replace(',', '.').trim().split(':').map(Number);if(x.some(Number.isNaN))return null;if(x.length===3)return x[0]*3600+x[1]*60+x[2];if(x.length===2)return x[0]*60+x[1];return null};
      const tc=s=>{s=Math.max(0,Math.round(s));return `${String(Math.floor(s/3600)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(Math.floor(s%3600/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s%60).padStart(2,'0')}`};
      function parseCues(text){const chunks=String(text||'').replace(/\r/g,'').split(/\n\s*\n/);const cues=[];for(const chunk of chunks){const lines=chunk.split('\n').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);const at=lines.findIndex(x=>x.includes('-->'));if(at<0)continue;const [a,b]=lines[at].split('-->').map(x=>x.trim().split(/\s+/)[0]);const start=toSeconds(a),end=toSeconds(b);const body=lines.slice(at+1).join(' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').trim();if(start!==null&&end!==null&&body)cues.push({start,end,text:body})}return cues}
      const keyTerms=/真相|秘密|告白|决战|牺牲|重逢|离开|再见|选择|发现|救|回家|自由|梦想|转折|高潮|记住|为什么|我爱|不能|最后|醒来|promise|truth|love|fight|run|save|goodbye/gi;
      function score(cue,index,total){const terms=(cue.text.match(keyTerms)||[]).length;const density=Math.min(3,Math.ceil(cue.text.length/24));const edge=(index===0||index===total-1)?0:1;return terms*4+density+edge}
      function renderHighlights(){const box=$('#highlight-results');if(!box)return;if(!saved.highlights.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="highlight-empty">没有候选高光。请确认字幕含时间码（SRT/VTT）并重新分析；不会把猜测当成已检出的场景。</div>';return}box.innerHTML=saved.highlights.map((h,i)=>`<article class="highlight-card"><strong>${esc(h.title)} <span class="highlight-score">${h.score} 分</span></strong><p>${esc(h.text)}</p><div class="highlight-time">${tc(h.start)} — ${tc(h.end)}</div><div style="margin-top:9px"><button class="btn primary" data-highlight="${i}">标记时间线</button><button class="btn" data-look-highlight="${i}">套用电影暖调</button></div></article>`).join('');$$('[data-highlight]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const h=saved.highlights[Number(b.dataset.highlight)];const duration=Number($('#movie-duration').value)||120;const percent=Math.min(100,h.start/(duration*60)*100);const ph=$('#playhead');if(ph)ph.style.left=percent+'%';const p=$('#program-time');if(p)p.textContent=tc(h.start);if(typeof window.__filmV3AddMarker==='function')window.__filmV3AddMarker(`${h.title} · ${tc(h.start)} 高光`);toast(`已定位高光：${tc(h.start)}，并移到时间线`) });$$('[data-look-highlight]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{applyLook('cinema');toast('已将电影暖调套用到当前预览')})}
      function analyze(){const title=$('#movie-title').value.trim();const duration=Number($('#movie-duration').value)||120;saved.movieTitle=title;saved.movieDuration=duration;if(!title){toast('请先输入电影名称');return}if(!saved.subtitleText){saved.highlights=[];renderHighlights();$('#highlight-note').textContent='已建立“'+title+'”的分析任务，但当前没有本地字幕/章节时间码；请导入 SRT、VTT 或带时间码文本后再分析。';save();return}const cues=parseCues(saved.subtitleText);if(!cues.length){saved.highlights=[];renderHighlights();$('#highlight-note').textContent='文件已读取，但未找到可用时间码。请使用“00:12:34 --> 00:13:10”格式的字幕或章节文件。';save();return}const ranked=cues.map((c,i)=>({...c,score:score(c,i,cues.length),title:title+' · 高光候选'})).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.start-b.start);const picked=[];for(const c of ranked){if(picked.every(p=>Math.abs(p.start-c.start)>18)&&picked.length<6)picked.push(c)}saved.highlights=picked.sort((a,b)=>a.start-b.start);renderHighlights();$('#highlight-note').textContent=`已在本机分析 ${cues.length} 条字幕，生成 ${picked.length} 个候选；结果来自关键词/对白密度启发式，不是外部影片数据库。`;save();toast(`已生成 ${picked.length} 个高光候选`)}
      function applyLook(look){saved.look=look;$$('.look-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.look===look));$$('.viewer').forEach(v=>{v.classList.remove('look-cinema','look-noir','look-neon','look-dream','look-sunset');if(look!=='original')v.classList.add('look-'+look);v.classList.toggle('fx-glow',saved.glow);v.classList.toggle('fx-prism',saved.prism);v.classList.toggle('fx-grain',saved.grain)});const s=$('#look-state');if(s)s.textContent=({original:'原片',cinema:'电影暖调',noir:'黑白纪实',neon:'霓虹炫彩',dream:'柔光梦境',sunset:'日落金色'}[look]||'原片')+' · '+saved.intensity+'%';const p=$('#look-preview');if(p){p.classList.toggle('active',saved.prism||saved.glow);p.style.filter=`saturate(${.65+saved.intensity/180}) contrast(${.82+saved.intensity/560})`}save()}
      function syncEffects(){const intensity=$('#look-intensity');if(intensity){saved.intensity=Number(intensity.value);$('#out-look-intensity').textContent=saved.intensity+'%'}applyLook(saved.look)}
      $('#movie-title').value=saved.movieTitle;$('#movie-duration').value=saved.movieDuration;$('#analyze-highlights').onclick=analyze;$('#highlight-file').onchange=e=>{const file=e.target.files&&e.target.files[0];if(!file)return;const reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=()=>{saved.subtitleText=String(reader.result||'');$('#highlight-source-state').textContent=file.name+' · 已读取';$('#highlight-note').textContent='已读取本地文件：'+file.name+'。点击“分析高光”开始本机检出。';save();toast('字幕 / 章节已载入本机')};reader.readAsText(file);e.target.value=''};
      $$('.look-btn').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>applyLook(b.dataset.look));$('#look-intensity').value=saved.intensity;$('#look-intensity').oninput=syncEffects;['glow','prism','grain'].forEach(name=>{const input=$('#fx-'+name);input.checked=!!saved[name];input.onchange=()=>{saved[name]=input.checked;applyLook(saved.look)}});$('#clear-look').onclick=()=>{saved.look='original';saved.intensity=100;saved.glow=saved.prism=saved.grain=false;$('#look-intensity').value=100;['glow','prism','grain'].forEach(n=>$('#fx-'+n).checked=false);applyLook('original');toast('已清除滤镜与炫彩效果')};window.__filmV3AddMarker=label=>{const note=$('#markers');if(note)note.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',`<div class="row"><b>${esc(label)}</b><span style="color:var(--warn)">高光</span></div>`)};renderHighlights();applyLook(saved.look)
    })();

      const openDB=()=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const request=indexedDB.open(DB_NAME,DB_VERSION);request.onupgradeneeded=()=>{const database=request.result;const store=database.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE)?request.transaction.objectStore(STORE):database.createObjectStore(STORE,{keyPath:'id'});if(!store.indexNames.contains('kind'))store.createIndex('kind','kind');if(!store.indexNames.contains('createdAt'))store.createIndex('createdAt','createdAt')};request.onsuccess=()=>{db=request.result;resolve(db)};request.onerror=()=>reject(request.error)});
      const transaction=(mode,run)=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const tx=db.transaction(STORE,mode);const request=run(tx.objectStore(STORE));request.onsuccess=()=>resolve(request.result);request.onerror=()=>reject(request.error);tx.onerror=()=>reject(tx.error)});

      const putAsset=asset=>transaction('readwrite',store=>store.put(asset));

      const uid=()=>crypto.randomUUID?crypto.randomUUID():'capture-'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(16).slice(2);
      function resetPreview(){const video=$('#capture-preview');video.pause();video.removeAttribute('srcObject');video.hidden=true;$('#stage-placeholder').hidden=false;$('#capture-stage').classList.remove('video-on')}
      function stopTracks(stream){if(stream)stream.getTracks().forEach(track=>track.stop())}
      function releaseStreams(){stopTracks(activeStream);stopTracks(micStream);activeStream=null;micStream=null;if(audioContext){audioContext.close().catch(()=>{});audioContext=null}resetPreview()}
      function attachPreview(stream){const video=$('#capture-preview');video.srcObject=stream;video.hidden=false;$('#stage-placeholder').hidden=true;$('#capture-stage').classList.add('video-on');return video.play().catch(()=>{})}
      function chooseMime(){return ['video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus','video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus','video/webm'].find(type=>window.MediaRecorder&&MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(type))||''}
      async function getDisplayStream(){if(!navigator.mediaDevices?.getDisplayMedia)throw new Error('此浏览器不支持屏幕捕获 API。请使用新版 Edge 或 Chrome。');const stream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({video:{frameRate:{ideal:30,max:30}},audio:true,preferCurrentTab:false,selfBrowserSurface:'exclude'});return stream}
      async function buildRecordedStream(display){const out=new MediaStream();const videoTrack=display.getVideoTracks()[0];if(videoTrack)out.addTrack(videoTrack);const wantsMic=$('#mic-enabled').checked;if(wantsMic){try{micStream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:{echoCancellation:true,noiseSuppression:true,autoGainControl:true}})}catch(error){throw new Error('麦克风未获授权，已取消开始录制。请允许麦克风后再试。')}}const sourceAudio=[...display.getAudioTracks(),...(micStream?[...micStream.getAudioTracks()]:[])];if(sourceAudio.length){try{audioContext=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();const destination=audioContext.createMediaStreamDestination();[display,micStream].filter(Boolean).forEach(stream=>{if(stream.getAudioTracks().length)audioContext.createMediaStreamSource(stream).connect(destination)});destination.stream.getAudioTracks().forEach(track=>out.addTrack(track))}catch(error){sourceAudio.forEach(track=>out.addTrack(track))}}return out}
      async function startRecording(){if(state.isRecording)return;if(!window.MediaRecorder){toast('当前浏览器不支持 MediaRecorder，无法假装已录制。');return}try{setStatus('正在请求屏幕录制权限…');activeStream=await duration=Math.max(1,Math.round((Date.now()-startedAt)/1000));const blob=new Blob(chunks,{type:recorder.mimeType||'video/webm'});const '+($('#mic-enabled').checked?'麦克风已开启':'麦克风关闭'),true);toast('已开始录制。可从浏览器顶部停止共享，视频会自动保存。')}catch(error){releaseStreams();state.isRecording=false;$('#start-record').disabled=false;$('#stop-record').disabled=true;setStatus('未开始录制');toast(error?.message||'没有获得屏幕录制权限。')}}
      function stopRecording(cancel=false){if(!state.isRecording||!recorder)return;if(cancel){chunks=[]}if(recorder.state!=='inactive')recorder.stop()}
      async function takeScreenshot(){try{let temporary=false;if(!activeStream){setStatus('正在请求截图权限…');activeStream=await getDisplayStream();temporary=true;await attachPreview(activeStream)}const video=$('#capture-preview');if(video.readyState<2)await new Promise(resolve=>video.addEventListener('loadeddata',resolve,{once:true}));const track=activeStream?.getVideoTracks()[0];const settings=track?.getSettings?.()||{};const width=video.videoWidth||settings.width||1280,height=video.videoHeight||settings.height||720;if(!width||!height)throw new Error('尚未取得可截图的画面。');const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=width;canvas.height=height;canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video,0,0,width,height);const blob=await new Promise(resolve=>canvas.toBlob(resolve,'image/png'));if(!blob)throw new Error('截图编码失败。');const asset={id:uid(),kind:'image',title:$('#capture-title').value.trim()||'Action 截图 '+new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN'),blob,mime:'image/png',size:blob.size,createdAt:Date.now(),duration:0,hasMic:false};await putAsset(asset);await renderLibraries();toast('截图已保存到 Action：'+formatBytes(blob.size));if(temporary){releaseStreams();setStatus('已保存截图到 Action')}}catch(error){console.error(error);setStatus('截图未保存');toast(error?.message||'未获得截图权限。')}}
      function assetCard(asset){const node=document.createElement('article');node.className='asset';const url=URL.createObjectURL(asset.blob);node.innerHTML=`<div class="asset-preview">${asset.kind==='image'?`<img alt="${escapeHtml(asset.title)}" src="${url}">`:'▶'}</div><div class="asset-meta"><strong title="${escapeHtml(asset.title)}">${escapeHtml(asset.title)}</strong><small>${asset.kind==='video'?`${formatDuration(asset.duration)} · ${asset.hasMic?'含麦克风':'无麦克风'} · `:''}${formatBytes(asset.size)} · ${formatDate(asset.createdAt)}</small></div><div class="asset-actions"><button class="icon-btn" title="预览" aria-label="预览">⌕</button><button class="icon-btn delete" title="删除" aria-label="删除">⌫</button></div>`;const [open,del]=node.querySelectorAll('button');open.onclick=()=>openPreview(asset);del.onclick=()=>deleteAsset(asset);node._url=url;return node}

      async function deleteAsset(asset){if(!confirm(`确定从本地${asset.kind==='video'?'视频资料库':'Action'}中删除“${asset.title}”吗？此操作不会影响原始影片或网页。`))return;await removeAsset(asset.id);if(selectedAsset?.id===asset.id)closePreview();await renderLibraries();toast('已从本地资料库删除该素材。')}

      function setView(view){$$('.nav [data-view]').forEach(button=>button.classList.toggle('active',button.dataset.view===view));$('#crumb').textContent=({capture:'观影录制',videos:'视频资料库',action:'Action 截图资料库'})[view]||'观影录制';if(view==='capture')$('#capture-view').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});else $(view==='videos'?'#videos-library':'#action-library').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})}
      $('#start-record').onclick=startRecording;$('#stop-record').onclick=()=>stopRecording();$('#screenshot').onclick=takeScreenshot;$('#dock-record').onclick=()=>state.isRecording?stopRecording():startRecording();$('#dock-shot').onclick=takeScreenshot;$('#mic-enabled').onchange=()=>{$('#mic-state').textContent=$('#mic-enabled').checked?'麦克风待授权':'麦克风关闭';if(!state.isRecording)setStatus($('#mic-enabled').checked?'已开启麦克风，开始时会请求授权':'未录制')};$('#focus-stage').onclick=()=>$('#capture-stage').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});$('#nav-screenshot').onclick=takeScreenshot;$('#nav-library').onclick=()=>setView('videos');$$('.nav [data-view]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>setView(button.dataset.view));$('#close-preview').onclick=closePreview;$('#preview-modal').onclick=event=>{if(event.target===$('#preview-modal'))closePreview()};$('#delete-preview').onclick=()=>selectedAsset&&deleteAsset(selectedAsset);$('#download-preview').onclick=()=>{if(!selectedAsset)return;const url=URL.createObjectURL(selectedAsset.blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=selectedAsset.kind==='video'?`${selectedAsset.title}.webm`:`${selectedAsset.title}.png`;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);toast('已请求下载本地副本。')};window.addEventListener('beforeunload',()=>{if(state.isRecording&&recorder?.state==='recording')recorder.stop();else releaseStreams()});

        <div><p class="eyebrow">ME.zip · WATCH CAPTURE V5</p><h1 id="page-title">观影录制</h1><p>录制视频进入 Emotion.，截图进入 Action.。两类素材分开保存、预览与管理。</p></div>
      </section>

      <section class="surface capture" aria-labelledby="capture-title">
        <div class="capture-header"><div><h2 id="capture-title">录制与截图</h2><p>视频保存时可选择录制麦克风；截图可选全屏或局部区域。</p></div><div class="status" id="capture-status" aria-live="polite">等待操作</div></div>
        <div class="controls"><input class="title-input" id="asset-title" maxlength="80" placeholder="本次素材名称（可选）" aria-label="本次素材名称" /><label class="toggle"><input id="microphone-enabled" type="checkbox" />录制麦克风</label></div>
        <div class="action-row"><button class="btn primary" id="record-button" type="button">开始录制</button><button class="btn rose" id="stop-button" type="button" disabled>停止并保存</button><button class="btn amber" id="full-shot-button" type="button">全屏截图</button><button class="btn ghost" id="partial-shot-button" type="button">局部截图</button></div>
        <div class="capture-summary"><div class="stat"><span>当前状态</span><strong id="recording-state">待机</strong></div><div class="stat"><span>Emotion.</span><strong class="aqua" id="emotion-count">0</strong></div><div class="stat"><span>Action.</span><strong class="amber" id="action-count">0</strong></div></div>
      </section>

      <section class="libraries" aria-label="本地资料库">
        <section class="surface library" id="emotion-library" aria-labelledby="emotion-title"><div class="library-header"><div class="library-title"><h2 id="emotion-title">Emotion.</h2><span>观影视频录制</span></div><button class="btn ghost" data-refresh="emotion" type="button">刷新</button></div><div class="library-list" id="emotion-list" aria-live="polite"><div class="empty">正在读取视频资料库…</div></div></section>
        <section class="surface library" id="action-library" aria-labelledby="action-title"><div class="library-header"><div class="library-title"><h2 id="action-title">Action.</h2><span>全屏与局部截图</span></div><button class="btn ghost" data-refresh="action" type="button">刷新</button></div><div class="library-list" id="action-list" aria-live="polite"><div class="empty">正在读取截图资料库…</div></div></section>
      </section>
      <p class="footer-note">删除素材时会移到 Windows 回收站；不会触碰电影源文件、网页或其他桌面内容。</p>
    </main>
  </div>

  <dialog id="preview-dialog"><div class="dialog-content"><div class="dialog-head"><h3 id="preview-title">素材预览</h3><button class="icon-button" id="preview-close" type="button" aria-label="关闭预览" title="关闭">×</button></div><div class="dialog-media" id="preview-media"></div><div class="dialog-actions"><a class="btn ghost" id="preview-download" href="#" download>下载副本</a><button class="btn rose" id="preview-delete" type="button">移到回收站</button></div></div></dialog>
  <dialog id="delete-dialog"><div class="dialog-content"><div class="dialog-head"><h3>移到回收站</h3><button class="icon-button" id="delete-cancel-top" type="button" aria-label="关闭删除提示" title="关闭">×</button></div><p class="delete-copy" id="delete-copy"></p><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="btn ghost" id="delete-cancel" type="button">取消</button><button class="btn rose" id="delete-confirm" type="button">确认移到回收站</button></div></div></dialog>
  <dialog id="selection-dialog"><div class="dialog-content"><div class="dialog-head"><h3>局部截图</h3><button class="icon-button" id="selection-cancel-top" type="button" aria-label="取消局部截图" title="取消">×</button></div><div class="selection-wrap"><canvas id="selection-canvas"></canvas></div><div class="dialog-actions"><button class="btn ghost" id="selection-cancel" type="button">取消</button></div></div></dialog>
  <div class="toast" id="toast" role="status"></div>

  <script>
    (() => {
      'use strict';
      const $ = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector);
      const state = { recording: false, recorder: null, display: null, microphone: null, mixer: null, chunks: [], startedAt: 0, pendingDelete: null, selected: null, selectionSource: null, selectionStart: null, selectionRect: null, libraries: { emotion: [], action: [] } };
      const api = '/api/film-studio/v1';
      const formatBytes = (value) => { const bytes = Number(value || 0); if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB`; if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB`; return `${(bytes / 1024 / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} GB`; };
      const formatDate = (value) => { const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '时间未知' : date.toLocaleString('zh-CN'); };
      const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[character]));
      const setStatus = (message, active = false) => { $('#capture-status').textContent = message; $('#recording-state').textContent = active ? '录制中' : message === '等待操作' ? '待机' : '已完成'; $('#recording-state').style.color = active ? 'var(--rose)' : ''; };
      const toast = (message) => { const target = $('#toast'); target.textContent = message; target.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(window.__filmStudioToast); window.__filmStudioToast = window.setTimeout(() => target.classList.remove('show'), 3400); };
      const openDialog = (dialog) => { if (!dialog.open) dialog.showModal(); };
      const closeDialog = (dialog) => { if (dialog.open) dialog.close(); };
      const chooseMime = () => ['video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus', 'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus', 'video/webm'].find((type) => window.MediaRecorder && MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(type)) || '';
      const stopTracks = (stream) => { if (stream) stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop()); };
      const resetRecordingStreams = () => { stopTracks(state.display); stopTracks(state.microphone); state.display = null; state.microphone = null; if (state.mixer) state.mixer.close().catch(() => {}); state.mixer = null; };

      async function requestDisplayStream() {
        if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getDisplayMedia) throw new Error('当前浏览器不支持屏幕捕获。请使用新版 Edge 或 Chrome。');
        return navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ video: { frameRate: { ideal: 30, max: 30 } }, audio: true, selfBrowserSurface: 'exclude' });
      }

      async function makeRecordingStream(display) {
        const output = new MediaStream();
        const videoTrack = display.getVideoTracks()[0];
        if (!videoTrack) throw new Error('没有取得可录制的视频画面。');
        output.addTrack(videoTrack);
        if ($('#microphone-enabled').checked) {
          try { state.microphone = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, autoGainControl: true } }); }
          catch { throw new Error('麦克风未获授权，未开始录制。请允许麦克风权限后重试。'); }
        }
        const audioSources = [display, state.microphone].filter(Boolean).filter((stream) => stream.getAudioTracks().length > 0);
        if (!audioSources.length) return output;
        try {
          state.mixer = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
          const destination = state.mixer.createMediaStreamDestination();
          audioSources.forEach((stream) => state.mixer.createMediaStreamSource(stream).connect(destination));
          destination.stream.getAudioTracks().forEach((track) => output.addTrack(track));
        } catch { audioSources.forEach((stream) => stream.getAudioTracks().forEach((track) => output.addTrack(track))); }
        return output;
      }

      async function upload(kind, blob) {
        const response = await fetch(`${api}/upload/${kind}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': blob.type || (kind === 'emotion' ? 'video/webm' : 'image/png') }, body: blob });
        if (!response.ok) { const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); throw new Error(body.error || '素材保存失败'); }
        return response.json();
      }

      async function loadLibraries() {
        try {
          const response = await fetch(`${api}/libraries`, { cache: 'no-store' });
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error('本地资料库不可用');
          const payload = await response.json();
          state.libraries.emotion = Array.isArray(payload.emotion) ? payload.emotion : [];
          state.libraries.action = Array.isArray(payload.action) ? payload.action : [];
          renderLibrary('emotion'); renderLibrary('action');
          $('#emotion-count').textContent = String(state.libraries.emotion.length);
          $('#action-count').textContent = String(state.libraries.action.length);
          $('#connection-state').textContent = '已连接';
        } catch (error) {
          $('#connection-state').textContent = '不可用';
          ['emotion', 'action'].forEach((kind) => { $(`#${kind}-list`).innerHTML = '<div class="empty">无法读取本地资料库，页面没有显示演示素材。</div>'; });
        }
      }

      function renderLibrary(kind) {
        const list = $(`#${kind}-list`); const items = state.libraries[kind]; list.innerHTML = '';
        if (!items.length) { list.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${kind === 'emotion' ? 'Emotion. 还没有保存的视频。' : 'Action. 还没有保存的截图。'}</div>`; return; }
        items.forEach((item) => list.appendChild(createAsset(kind, item)));
      }

      function createAsset(kind, item) {
        const article = document.createElement('article'); article.className = 'asset';
        const preview = document.createElement('button'); preview.type = 'button'; preview.className = 'asset-preview'; preview.title = '预览'; preview.setAttribute('aria-label', `预览 ${item.name}`);
        if (kind === 'emotion') { const video = document.createElement('video'); video.src = item.url; video.muted = true; video.preload = 'metadata'; video.playsInline = true; preview.appendChild(video); } else { const image = document.createElement('img'); image.src = item.url; image.alt = ''; preview.appendChild(image); }
        const meta = document.createElement('div'); meta.className = 'asset-meta'; meta.innerHTML = `<div class="asset-name" title="${escapeHtml(item.name)}">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</div><div class="asset-detail">${escapeHtml(formatBytes(item.size))} · ${escapeHtml(formatDate(item.modifiedAt))}</div>`;
        const actions = document.createElement('div'); actions.className = 'asset-actions';
        const open = document.createElement('button'); open.type = 'button'; open.className = 'icon-button'; open.textContent = '↗'; open.title = '查看'; open.setAttribute('aria-label', `查看 ${item.name}`);
        const remove = document.createElement('button'); remove.type = 'button'; remove.className = 'icon-button delete'; remove.textContent = '⌫'; remove.title = '移到回收站'; remove.setAttribute('aria-label', `移到回收站 ${item.name}`);
        preview.addEventListener('click', () => openPreview(kind, item)); open.addEventListener('click', () => openPreview(kind, item)); remove.addEventListener('click', () => promptDelete(kind, item));
        actions.append(open, remove); article.append(preview, meta, actions); return article;
      }

      function openPreview(kind, item) {
        state.selected = { kind, item }; const media = $('#preview-media'); media.innerHTML = '';
        const element = document.createElement(kind === 'emotion' ? 'video' : 'img'); element.src = item.url; if (kind === 'emotion') { element.controls = true; element.autoplay = true; } else element.alt = item.name;
        media.appendChild(element); $('#preview-title').textContent = kind === 'emotion' ? 'Emotion. 视频预览' : 'Action. 图片预览'; $('#preview-download').href = item.url; $('#preview-download').download = item.name; openDialog($('#preview-dialog'));
      }

      function promptDelete(kind, item) { state.pendingDelete = { kind, item }; $('#delete-copy').textContent = `“${item.name}”将移到 Windows 回收站。它不会永久删除，也不会影响原始电影或网页。`; openDialog($('#delete-dialog')); }
      async function confirmDelete() {
        const pending = state.pendingDelete; if (!pending) return;
        $('#delete-confirm').disabled = true;
        try {
          const response = await fetch(`${api}/delete/${pending.kind}/${encodeURIComponent(pending.item.name)}`, { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'x-film-studio-confirm': 'recycle-bin' } });
          if (!response.ok) { const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); throw new Error(body.error || '无法移到回收站'); }
          closeDialog($('#delete-dialog')); closeDialog($('#preview-dialog')); state.pendingDelete = null; toast('素材已移到 Windows 回收站。'); await loadLibraries();
        } catch (error) { toast(error.message || '无法移到回收站。'); }
        finally { $('#delete-confirm').disabled = false; }
      }

      async function startRecording() {
        if (state.recording) return;
        if (!window.MediaRecorder) { toast('当前浏览器不支持视频录制。'); return; }
        try {
          setStatus('正在请求录制权限…'); state.display = await requestDisplayStream(); const stream = await makeRecordingStream(state.display); state.chunks = [];
          const mime = chooseMime(); state.recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, mime ? { mimeType: mime } : undefined);
          state.recorder.ondataavailable = (event) => { if (event.data?.size) state.chunks.push(event.data); };
          state.recorder.onerror = () => { toast('录制出现错误，未显示为已保存。'); };
          state.recorder.onstop = async () => {
            const duration = Math.max(1, Math.round((Date.now() - state.startedAt) / 1000)); const blob = new Blob(state.chunks, { type: state.recorder.mimeType || 'video/webm' }); resetRecordingStreams(); state.recording = false; $('#record-button').disabled = false; $('#stop-button').disabled = true;
            if (!blob.size) { setStatus('录制未生成视频'); toast('没有生成可保存的视频。'); return; }
            try { setStatus('正在保存到 Emotion.…'); await upload('emotion', blob); setStatus('已保存到 Emotion.'); toast(`视频已保存 ${formatBytes(blob.size)} · ${duration} 秒`); await loadLibraries(); }
            catch (error) { setStatus('视频保存失败'); toast(error.message || '视频保存失败。'); }
          };
          state.display.getVideoTracks()[0].addEventListener('ended', () => { if (state.recording) stopRecording(); }, { once: true });
          state.startedAt = Date.now(); state.recording = true; state.recorder.start(1000); $('#record-button').disabled = true; $('#stop-button').disabled = false; setStatus($('#microphone-enabled').checked ? '正在录制 · 麦克风开启' : '正在录制', true);
        } catch (error) { resetRecordingStreams(); state.recording = false; $('#record-button').disabled = false; $('#stop-button').disabled = true; setStatus('等待操作'); toast(error.message || '未获得录制权限。'); }
      }

      function stopRecording() { if (!state.recording || !state.recorder) return; $('#stop-button').disabled = true; setStatus('正在结束录制…', true); if (state.recorder.state !== 'inactive') state.recorder.stop(); }
      function canvasBlob(canvas) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => canvas.toBlob((blob) => blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error('截图编码失败')), 'image/png')); }
      async function captureDisplayCanvas() {
        const stream = await requestDisplayStream(); const video = document.createElement('video'); video.srcObject = stream; video.muted = true; video.playsInline = true;
        try { await video.play(); await new Promise((resolve) => video.readyState >= 2 ? resolve() : video.addEventListener('loadeddata', resolve, { once: true })); await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 80)); const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0]; const settings = track?.getSettings?.() || {}; const width = video.videoWidth || settings.width || 0; const height = video.videoHeight || settings.height || 0; if (!width || !height) throw new Error('没有获取到可截图的画面。'); const canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = width; canvas.height = height; canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0, width, height); return canvas; }
        finally { stopTracks(stream); video.srcObject = null; }
      }
      async function saveScreenshot(canvas) { const blob = await canvasBlob(canvas); setStatus('正在保存到 Action.…'); await upload('action', blob); setStatus('已保存到 Action.'); toast(`截图已保存 ${formatBytes(blob.size)}`); await loadLibraries(); }
      async function fullScreenshot() { try { setStatus('正在请求截图权限…'); const canvas = await captureDisplayCanvas(); await saveScreenshot(canvas); } catch (error) { setStatus('等待操作'); toast(error.message || '未获得截图权限。'); } }

      function renderSelection() {
        const canvas = $('#selection-canvas'); const source = state.selectionSource; if (!source) return; canvas.width = source.width; canvas.height = source.height; const context = canvas.getContext('2d'); context.drawImage(source, 0, 0);
        const rect = state.selectionRect; if (!rect) return; context.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.48)'; context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); context.clearRect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height); context.drawImage(source, rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height, rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height); context.strokeStyle = '#73d8d0'; context.lineWidth = Math.max(2, canvas.width / 1000); context.strokeRect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height);
      }
      function pointForSelection(event) { const canvas = $('#selection-canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width, (event.clientX - rect.left) * canvas.width / rect.width)), y: Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height, (event.clientY - rect.top) * canvas.height / rect.height)) }; }
      async function partialScreenshot() { try { setStatus('正在请求局部截图权限…'); state.selectionSource = await captureDisplayCanvas(); state.selectionStart = null; state.selectionRect = null; renderSelection(); openDialog($('#selection-dialog')); setStatus('拖动选择截图区域'); } catch (error) { setStatus('等待操作'); toast(error.message || '未获得截图权限。'); } }
      async function finishSelection() {
        const rect = state.selectionRect; const source = state.selectionSource; if (!rect || !source || rect.width < 12 || rect.height < 12) { toast('请选择更大的截图区域。'); return; }
        const crop = document.createElement('canvas'); crop.width = Math.round(rect.width); crop.height = Math.round(rect.height); crop.getContext('2d').drawImage(source, rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height, 0, 0, crop.width, crop.height); closeDialog($('#selection-dialog')); state.selectionSource = null; state.selectionRect = null; await saveScreenshot(crop);
      }

      $('#record-button').addEventListener('click', startRecording); $('#stop-button').addEventListener('click', stopRecording); $('#full-shot-button').addEventListener('click', fullScreenshot); $('#partial-shot-button').addEventListener('click', partialScreenshot);
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-refresh]').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => { void loadLibraries(); }));
      $('#preview-close').addEventListener('click', () => closeDialog($('#preview-dialog'))); $('#preview-delete').addEventListener('click', () => state.selected && promptDelete(state.selected.kind, state.selected.item));
      $('#delete-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => closeDialog($('#delete-dialog'))); $('#delete-cancel-top').addEventListener('click', () => closeDialog($('#delete-dialog'))); $('#delete-confirm').addEventListener('click', confirmDelete);
      $('#selection-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => { state.selectionSource = null; closeDialog($('#selection-dialog')); setStatus('等待操作'); }); $('#selection-cancel-top').addEventListener('click', () => { state.selectionSource = null; closeDialog($('#selection-dialog')); setStatus('等待操作'); });
      $('#selection-canvas').addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => { const point = pointForSelection(event); state.selectionStart = point; state.selectionRect = { x: point.x, y: point.y, width: 0, height: 0 }; event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); renderSelection(); });
      $('#selection-canvas').addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => { if (!state.selectionStart) return; const point = pointForSelection(event); state.selectionRect = { x: Math.min(state.selectionStart.x, point.x), y: Math.min(state.selectionStart.y, point.y), width: Math.abs(point.x - state.selectionStart.x), height: Math.abs(point.y - state.selectionStart.y) }; renderSelection(); });
      $('#selection-canvas').addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => { if (!state.selectionStart) return; state.selectionStart = null; event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture?.(event.pointerId); void finishSelection(); });
      window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => { if (state.recorder?.state === 'recording') state.recorder.stop(); else resetRecordingStreams(); });
      window.setInterval(() => { if (!state.recording) void loadLibraries(); }, 15000);
      void loadLibraries();
    })();
  </script>
</body>

(() => {
  'use strict';
  const KEY = 'mezip.finance.center.v1';
  const EXPENSE_CATEGORIES = ['餐饮美食','购物消费','交通出行','生活日用','住房','娱乐休闲','医疗健康','学习教育','旅行','数码','宠物','订阅服务','人情往来','其他'];
  const INCOME_CATEGORIES = ['工资','奖金','兼职','投资','退款','红包','其他收入'];
  const ACCOUNTS = [
    { key:'ALIPAY', label:'支付宝', tone:'alipay', status:'账单文件导入' },
    { key:'WECHAT_PAY', label:'微信支付', tone:'wechat', status:'账单文件导入' },

  const parseDelimited = (text) => { const rows=[];let row=[],field='',quoted=false;for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){const ch=text[i],next=text[i+1];if(ch==='"'&&quoted&&next==='"'){field+='"';i++;continue;}if(ch==='"'){quoted=!quoted;continue;}if(ch===','&&!quoted){row.push(field);field='';continue;}if((ch==='\n'||ch==='\r')&&!quoted){if(ch==='\r'&&next==='\n')i++;row.push(field);field='';if(row.some((value)=>value.trim()))rows.push(row);row=[];continue;}field+=ch;}if(field||row.length){row.push(field);if(row.some((value)=>value.trim()))rows.push(row);}return rows; };

};
  const addImport = () => { const rows=(importDraft.rows||[]).filter((item)=>!item.duplicate);if(!rows.length)return;const batch={id:'batch-'+Date.now(),ownerId:'local-owner',source:importDraft.source,fileName:importDraft.fileName,recordCount:rows.length,duplicateCount:importDraft.duplicates,errorCount:importDraft.errors,status:'COMPLETE',createdAt:new Date().toISOString()};state.transactions.push(...rows.map((item)=>({...item,importBatchId:batch.id,createdAt:batch.createdAt,updatedAt:batch.createdAt})));state.importBatches.push(batch);save();document.querySelector('#import-modal').hidden=true;render(); };
  const download = (name,content,type) => {const blob=new Blob([content],{type});const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download=name;link.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),300);};
  const rollback = (id) => {const batch=state.importBatches.find((item)=>item.id===id);if(!batch)return;const linked=state.transactions.filter((item)=>item.importBatchId===id);const edited=linked.some((item)=>item.updatedAt&&item.updatedAt!==item.createdAt);if(edited&&!window.confirm('这批账单中有已修改记录，撤销会移除这些记录。继续吗？'))return;state.transactions=state.transactions.filter((item)=>item.importBatchId!==id);batch.status='ROLLED_BACK';save();render();};
  const submit = (event) => {event.preventDefault();const form=event.target;if(form.id==='composer-form'){const type=form.querySelector('#composer-type').value;const cents=inputCents(form.querySelector('#composer-amount').value);if(cents<=0){window.alert('请输入大于 0 的金额。');return;}if(splitRows.length&&splitRows.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+row.amountCents,0)!==cents){window.alert('拆分总和必须严格等于原金额。');return;}const file=form.querySelector('#composer-receipt').files&&form.querySelector('#composer-receipt').files[0];const transaction={id:draft.id||'manual-'+Date.now(),type,amountCents:cents,category:type==='TRANSFER'?'账户转账':form.querySelector('#composer-category').value,account:form.querySelector('#composer-account').value,destinationAccount:type==='TRANSFER'?form.querySelector('#composer-destination').value:'',merchant:form.querySelector('#composer-merchant').value.trim(),occurredAt:form.querySelector('#composer-date').value?new Date(form.querySelector('#composer-date').value).toISOString():new Date().toISOString(),note:form.querySelector('#composer-note').value.trim(),tags:form.querySelector('#composer-tags').value.trim(),receiptName:file?file.name:(draft.receiptName||''),source:'MANUAL',createdAt:draft.createdAt||new Date().toISOString(),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};if(draft.id){const index=state.transactions.findIndex((item)=>item.id===draft.id);if(index>=0)state.transactions[index]={...state.transactions[index],...transaction};}else state.transactions.push(transaction);save();document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=true;render();return;}if(form.id==='budget-form'){state.budgets.totalCents=inputCents(form.querySelector('#total-budget').value);save();render();return;}if(form.id==='category-budget-form'){state.budgets.categories[form.querySelector('#budget-category').value]=inputCents(form.querySelector('#budget-amount').value);save();render();return;}if(form.id==='subscription-form'){state.subscriptions.push({id:'sub-'+Date.now(),name:form.querySelector('#sub-name').value.trim(),amountCents:inputCents(form.querySelector('#sub-amount').value),period:form.querySelector('#sub-period').value,nextDate:form.querySelector('#sub-date').value,account:form.querySelector('#sub-account').value});save();document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=true;render();}};
  const filterTx = () => {const query=(document.querySelector('#tx-search')?.value||'').toLowerCase();const account=document.querySelector('#tx-account')?.value||'';const type=document.querySelector('#tx-type')?.value||'';const category=document.querySelector('#tx-category')?.value||'';const items=state.transactions.filter((item)=>[item.merchant,item.note,item.tags,item.category].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(query)&&(!account||item.account===account)&&(!type||item.type===type)&&(!category||item.category===category));const target=document.querySelector('#tx-table');if(target)target.innerHTML=table(items);};
  const wire = () => {document.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach((element)=>element.addEventListener('click',()=>{const action=element.dataset.action;if(action==='open-composer')openComposer();if(action==='open-import')openImport(element.dataset.source==='WECHAT_PAY'?'WECHAT':'ALIPAY');if(action==='close-modal')document.querySelector('#'+element.dataset.modal).hidden=true;if(action==='detail')showDetail(element.dataset.id);if(action==='edit'){document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=true;openComposer(element.dataset.id);}if(action==='delete'){if(window.confirm('确认删除这条本机账单吗？')){state.transactions=state.transactions.filter((item)=>item.id!==element.dataset.id);save();document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=true;render();}}if(action==='add-split'){splitRows.push({category:EXPENSE_CATEGORIES[0],amountCents:0});renderComposerRows();}if(action==='remove-split'){splitRows.splice(Number(element.dataset.index),1);renderComposerRows();}if(action==='confirm-import')addImport();if(action==='open-subscription')openSubscription();if(action==='confirm-subscription')openSubscription({name:element.dataset.merchant,amountCents:Number(element.dataset.amount),account:element.dataset.account});if(action==='remove-subscription'){state.subscriptions=state.subscriptions.filter((item)=>item.id!==element.dataset.id);save();render();}if(action==='rollback-batch')rollback(element.dataset.id);if(action==='export-csv'){const rows=['id,type,amountCents,category,account,merchant,occurredAt,note,tags,source'].concat(state.transactions.map((item)=>[item.id,item.type,item.amountCents,item.category,item.account,item.merchant,item.occurredAt,item.note,item.tags,item.source].map((value)=>'"'+String(value||'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(',')));download('mezip-finance-transactions.csv',rows.join('\n'),'text/csv;charset=utf-8');}if(action==='export-json')download('mezip-finance-backup.json',JSON.stringify(state,null,2),'application/json');}));document.querySelectorAll('[data-range]').forEach((button)=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{range=button.dataset.range;render();}));document.querySelector('#hide-amounts')?.addEventListener('change',(event)=>{state.privacy.hideAmounts=event.target.checked;save();render();});document.querySelector('#tx-search')?.addEventListener('input',filterTx);['#tx-account','#tx-type','#tx-category'].forEach((selector)=>document.querySelector(selector)?.addEventListener('change',filterTx));document.querySelector('#composer-form')?.addEventListener('submit',submit);document.querySelector('#budget-form')?.addEventListener('submit',submit);document.querySelector('#category-budget-form')?.addEventListener('submit',submit);document.querySelector('#subscription-form')?.addEventListener('submit',submit);};
  const renderComposerRows = () => {const rows=document.querySelector('#split-rows');if(!rows)return;rows.innerHTML=splitRows.map((row,index)=>'<div class="split-row"><select data-split-category="'+index+'">'+catOptions('EXPENSE',row.category)+'</select><input data-split-amount="'+index+'" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="'+row.amountCents/100+'" placeholder="金额" /><button type="button" data-action="remove-split" data-index="'+index+'">×</button></div>').join('');wire();document.querySelectorAll('[data-split-category]').forEach((select)=>select.addEventListener('change',(event)=>{splitRows[Number(event.target.dataset.splitCategory)].category=event.target.value;}));document.querySelectorAll('[data-split-amount]').forEach((input)=>input.addEventListener('input',(event)=>{splitRows[Number(event.target.dataset.splitAmount)].amountCents=inputCents(event.target.value);}));};
  window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{route=(location.hash.replace('#','')||'overview').split('?')[0]||'overview';render();});
  render();
})();

      (() => {
