style="font-size:12px">拆分账单（可选）</strong><button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-action="add-split">'+(splitRows.length?'继续添加拆分':'启用拆分')+'</button><span class="muted">拆分总和必须严格等于原金额。</span></div><div id="split-rows"></div></div><div class="modal-foot"><button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-action="close-modal" data-modal="composer-modal">取消</button><button class="btn primary" type="submit">'+(id?'保存修改':'保存到账本')+'</button></div></form></div>';document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=false;wire();document.querySelector('#composer-type').addEventListener('change',(event)=>{document.querySelector('#composer-category').innerHTML=catOptions(event.target.value==='INCOME'?'INCOME':'EXPENSE',null);document.querySelector('#destination-wrap').classList.toggle('hidden',event.target.value!=='TRANSFER');}); };
  const showDetail = (id) => { const item=state.transactions.find((row)=>row.id===id); if(!item)return;document.querySelector('#composer-modal').innerHTML='<div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><p class="eyebrow">TRANSACTION DETAIL</p><h2>'+esc(item.merchant||'未命名交易')+'</h2><p class="muted">'+typeName(item.type)+' · '+accountName(item.account)+' · '+dateText(item.occurredAt)+'</p></div><button class="modal-close" data-action="close-modal" data-modal="composer-modal">×</button></div><div class="grid" style="gap:10px"><div class="budget-line"><span>金额</span><strong>'+amount(item.amountCents)+'</strong></div><div class="budget-line"><span>分类</span><strong>'+esc(item.category||'未分类')+'</strong></div><div class="budget-line"><span>来源</span><strong>'+esc(item.source||'MANUAL')+'</strong></div><div class="budget-line"><span>备注</span><strong>'+esc(item.note||'—')+'</strong></div><div class="budget-line"><span>标签</span><strong>'+esc(item.tags||'—')+'</strong></div><div class="budget-line"><span>凭证</span><strong>'+esc(item.receiptName||'未添加')+'</strong></div></div><div class="modal-foot"><button class="btn ghost" data-action="edit" data-id="'+esc(item.id)+'">编辑</button><button class="btn danger" data-action="delete" data-id="'+esc(item.id)+'">删除</button><button class="btn primary" data-action="close-modal" data-modal="composer-modal">完成</button></div></div>';document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=false;wire(); };
  const openSubscription = (seed={}) => { document.querySelector('#composer-modal').innerHTML='<div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><p class="eyebrow">CONFIRMED SUBSCRIPTION</p><h2>添加订阅</h2><p class="muted">确认后才会计入订阅中心，不会自动订阅或扣款。</p></div><button class="modal-close" data-action="close-modal" data-modal="composer-modal">×</button></div><form id="subscription-form"><div class="form-grid"><label>订阅名称<input id="sub-name" required value="'+esc(seed.name||'')+'" placeholder="例如：ChatGPT Plus" /></label><label>每期金额（元）<input id="sub-amount" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" required value="'+(seed.amountCents?seed.amountCents/100:'')+'" /></label><label>周期<select id="sub-period"><option>月</option><option>年</option></select></label><label>下次扣款日<input id="sub-date" type="date" /></label><label class="form-full">付款账户<select id="sub-account">'+accountOptions(seed.account||'CASH')+'</select></label></div><div class="modal-foot"><button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-action="close-modal" data-modal="composer-modal">取消</button><button class="btn primary" type="submit">确认加入</button></div></form></div>';document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=false;wire(); };
  const parseDelimited = (text) => { const rows=[];let row=[],field='',quoted=false;for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){const ch=text[i],next=text[i+1];if(ch==='"'&&quoted&&next==='"'){field+='"';i++;continue;}if(ch==='"'){quoted=!quoted;continue;}if(ch===','&&!quoted){row.push(field);field='';continue;}if((ch==='\n'||ch==='\r')&&!quoted){if(ch==='\r'&&next==='\n')i++;row.push(field);field='';if(row.some((value)=>value.trim()))rows.push(row);row=[];continue;}field+=ch;}if(field||row.length){row.push(field);if(row.some((value)=>value.trim()))rows.push(row);}return rows; };
  const column = (headers,patterns) => headers.findIndex((header)=>patterns.some((pattern)=>pattern.test(String(header||''))));
  const parsedRows = (text,source) => { const lines=parseDelimited(text.replace(/^\uFEFF/,''));if(lines.length<2)return[];const headers=lines[0];const dateCol=column(headers,[/时间|日期|发生|date/i]);const amountCol=column(headers,[/金额|收支|amount|price/i]);const merchantCol=column(headers,[/商户|商家|商品|名称|merchant|title/i]);const typeCol=column(headers,[/类型|收\/支|收支|type/i]);const noteCol=column(headers,[/备注|说明|note|description/i]);return lines.slice(1).map((line,index)=>{const raw=amountCol>=0?line[amountCol]:line.find((value)=>/[￥¥]?[-+]?\d+[.,]?\d*/.test(value))||'';const rawCents=inputCents(raw);const typeText=typeCol>=0?line[typeCol]:'';const type=/转账|transfer/i.test(typeText)?'TRANSFER':/退款|refund/i.test(typeText)?'REFUND':/收入|收款|income/i.test(typeText)?'INCOME':rawCents<0?'EXPENSE':'INCOME';return{id:'import-'+Date.now()+'-'+index,amountCents:Math.abs(rawCents),type,category:'其他',account:source==='ALIPAY'?'ALIPAY':source==='WECHAT'?'WECHAT_PAY':'OTHER',merchant:merchantCol>=0?String(line[merchantCol]||'').trim():'',note:noteCol>=0?String(line[noteCol]||'').trim():'',occurredAt:(dateCol>=0?iso(line[dateCol]):new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10))+'T12:00:00',source:source==='ALIPAY'?'ALIPAY_FILE':source==='WECHAT'?'WECHAT_FILE':'IMPORT_FILE'};}).filter((item)=>item.amountCents>0); };
  const fp = (item) => [item.source, item.externalId||'',iso(item.occurredAt),item.amountCents,item.merchant||'',item.note||''].join('|').toLowerCase();
  const importPreview = () => { const target=document.querySelector('#import-preview');const confirmButton=document.querySelector('#confirm-import');if(!target)return;if(!importDraft.rows.length){target.innerHTML=empty(importDraft.status||'等待账单文件','选择 CSV / TSV 后显示可预览记录。');if(confirmButton)confirmButton.disabled=true;return;}const data=sums(importDraft.rows.filter((item)=>!item.duplicate));target.innerHTML='<div class="grid metrics" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)">'+metric('交易总数',importDraft.rows.length+' 笔','本次文件','⌘')+metric('收入数量',importDraft.rows.filter((item)=>item.type==='INCOME').length+' 笔','预览','↗','income')+metric('支出数量',importDraft.rows.filter((item)=>item.type==='EXPENSE').length+' 笔','预览','↘','expense')+metric('重复数量',importDraft.duplicates+' 笔','将跳过','↺')+metric('异常数量',importDraft.errors+' 笔','金额 / 日期无法识别','!')+'</div><p class="muted" style="margin:12px 0">时间范围：'+iso(importDraft.rows[0].occurredAt)+' → '+iso(importDraft.rows[importDraft.rows.length-1].occurredAt)+' · 本次可导入金额：'+amount(data.income+data.expense)+'</p><div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>商家</th><th>金额</th><th>类型</th><th>日期</th><th>状态</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+importDraft.rows.slice(0,20).map((item)=>'<tr><td>'+esc(item.merchant||'未命名')+'</td><td>'+amount(item.amountCents)+'</td><td>'+typeName(item.type)+'</td><td>'+iso(item.occurredAt)+'</td><td>'+(item.duplicate?'重复，将跳过':'待导入')+'</td></tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table></div>';if(confirmButton)confirmButton.disabled=false; };
  const openImport = (source='ALIPAY') => { importDraft={source,fileName:'',rows:[],duplicates:0,errors:0,status:'等待选择文件'};document.querySelector('#import-modal').innerHTML='<div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><p class="eyebrow">FINANCE IMPORT ADAPTER</p><h2>导入账单文件</h2><p class="muted">选择官方导出文件，先解析预览，再由你确认导入。</p></div><button class="modal-close" data-action="close-modal" data-modal="import-modal">×</button></div><div class="form-grid"><label>账单来源<select id="import-source"><option value="ALIPAY"'+(source==='ALIPAY'?' selected':'')+'>支付宝</option><option value="WECHAT"'+(source==='WECHAT'?' selected':'')+'>微信支付</option><option value="GENERIC">通用 CSV</option></select></label><label>账单文件<input id="import-file" type="file" accept=".csv,.txt,.tsv,.xlsx" /><small class="muted">CSV / TSV 可直接解析；XLSX 无解析器时会明确提示。</small></label></div><div id="import-preview" style="margin-top:16px">'+empty('等待账单文件','选择文件后显示记录总数、收入、支出、时间范围、重复与异常。')+'</div><div class="modal-foot"><button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-action="close-modal" data-modal="import-modal">取消</button><button class="btn primary" id="confirm-import" type="button" disabled>确认导入</button></div></div>';document.querySelector('#import-modal').hidden=false;document.querySelector('#import-file').addEventListener('change',async(event)=>{const file=event.target.files&&event.target.files[0];if(!file)return;importDraft.fileName=file.name;if(/\.xlsx$/i.test(file.name)){importDraft.status='XLSX 需要先在本机导出为 CSV / TSV；当前浏览器不会伪造解析成功。';importPreview();return;}const text=await file.text();importDraft.rows=parsedRows(text,importDraft.source);const existing=new Set(state.transactions.map(fp));const seen=new Set();importDraft.rows.forEach((item)=>{const key=fp(item);item.duplicate=existing.has(key)||seen.has(key);if(item.duplicate)importDraft.duplicates++;seen.add(key);});importDraft.status='已解析预览';importPreview();});document.querySelector('#import-source').addEventListener('change',(event)=>{importDraft.source=event.target.value;}); };
  const addImport = () => { const rows=(importDraft.rows||[]).filter((item)=>!item.duplicate);if(!rows.length)return;const batch={id:'batch-'+Date.now(),ownerId:'local-owner',source:importDraft.source,fileName:importDraft.fileName,recordCount:rows.length,duplicateCount:importDraft.duplicates,errorCount:importDraft.errors,status:'COMPLETE',createdAt:new Date().toISOString()};state.transactions.push(...rows.map((item)=>({...item,importBatchId:batch.id,createdAt:batch.createdAt,updatedAt:batch.createdAt})));state.importBatches.push(batch);save();document.querySelector('#import-modal').hidden=true;render(); };
  const download = (name,content,type) => {const blob=new Blob([content],{type});const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download=name;link.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),300);};
  const rollback = (id) => {const batch=state.importBatches.find((item)=>item.id===id);if(!batch)return;const linked=state.transactions.filter((item)=>item.importBatchId===id);const edited=linked.some((item)=>item.updatedAt&&item.updatedAt!==item.createdAt);if(edited&&!window.confirm('这批账单中有已修改记录，撤销会移除这些记录。继续吗？'))return;state.transactions=state.transactions.filter((item)=>item.importBatchId!==id);batch.status='ROLLED_BACK';save();render();};
  const submit = (event) => {event.preventDefault();const form=event.target;if(form.id==='composer-form'){const type=form.querySelector('#composer-type').value;const cents=inputCents(form.querySelector('#composer-amount').value);if(cents<=0){window.alert('请输入大于 0 的金额。');return;}if(splitRows.length&&splitRows.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+row.amountCents,0)!==cents){window.alert('拆分总和必须严格等于原金额。');return;}const file=form.querySelector('#composer-receipt').files&&form.querySelector('#composer-receipt').files[0];const transaction={id:draft.id||'manual-'+Date.now(),type,amountCents:cents,category:type==='TRANSFER'?'账户转账':form.querySelector('#composer-category').value,account:form.querySelector('#composer-account').value,destinationAccount:type==='TRANSFER'?form.querySelector('#composer-destination').value:'',merchant:form.querySelector('#composer-merchant').value.trim(),occurredAt:form.querySelector('#composer-date').value?new Date(form.querySelector('#composer-date').value).toISOString():new Date().toISOString(),note:form.querySelector('#composer-note').value.trim(),tags:form.querySelector('#composer-tags').value.trim(),receiptName:file?file.name:(draft.receiptName||''),source:'MANUAL',createdAt:draft.createdAt||new Date().toISOString(),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};if(draft.id){const index=state.transactions.findIndex((item)=>item.id===draft.id);if(index>=0)state.transactions[index]={...state.transactions[index],...transaction};}else state.transactions.push(transaction);save();document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=true;render();return;}if(form.id==='budget-form'){state.budgets.totalCents=inputCents(form.querySelector('#total-budget').value);save();render();return;}if(form.id==='category-budget-form'){state.budgets.categories[form.querySelector('#budget-category').value]=inputCents(form.querySelector('#budget-amount').value);save();render();return;}if(form.id==='subscription-form'){state.subscriptions.push({id:'sub-'+Date.now(),name:form.querySelector('#sub-name').value.trim(),amountCents:inputCents(form.querySelector('#sub-amount').value),period:form.querySelector('#sub-period').value,nextDate:form.querySelector('#sub-date').value,account:form.querySelector('#sub-account').value});save();document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=true;render();}};
  const filterTx = () => {const query=(document.querySelector('#tx-search')?.value||'').toLowerCase();const account=document.querySelector('#tx-account')?.value||'';const type=document.querySelector('#tx-type')?.value||'';const category=document.querySelector('#tx-category')?.value||'';const items=state.transactions.filter((item)=>[item.merchant,item.note,item.tags,item.category].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(query)&&(!account||item.account===account)&&(!type||item.type===type)&&(!category||item.category===category));const target=document.querySelector('#tx-table');if(target)target.innerHTML=table(items);};
  const wire = () => {document.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach((element)=>element.addEventListener('click',()=>{const action=element.dataset.action;if(action==='open-composer')openComposer();if(action==='open-import')openImport(element.dataset.source==='WECHAT_PAY'?'WECHAT':'ALIPAY');if(action==='close-modal')document.querySelector('#'+element.dataset.modal).hidden=true;if(action==='detail')showDetail(element.dataset.id);if(action==='edit'){document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=true;openComposer(element.dataset.id);}if(action==='delete'){if(window.confirm('确认删除这条本机账单吗？')){state.transactions=state.transactions.filter((item)=>item.id!==element.dataset.id);save();document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=true;render();}}if(action==='add-split'){splitRows.push({category:EXPENSE_CATEGORIES[0],amountCents:0});renderComposerRows();}if(action==='remove-split'){splitRows.splice(Number(element.dataset.index),1);renderComposerRows();}if(action==='confirm-import')addImport();if(action==='open-subscription')openSubscription();if(action==='confirm-subscription')openSubscription({name:element.dataset.merchant,amountCents:Number(element.dataset.amount),account:element.dataset.account});if(action==='remove-subscription'){state.subscriptions=state.subscriptions.filter((item)=>item.id!==element.dataset.id);save();render();}if(action==='rollback-batch')rollback(element.dataset.id);if(action==='export-csv'){const rows=['id,type,amountCents,category,account,merchant,occurredAt,note,tags,source'].concat(state.transactions.map((item)=>[item.id,item.type,item.amountCents,item.category,item.account,item.merchant,item.occurredAt,item.note,item.tags,item.source].map((value)=>'"'+String(value||'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(',')));download('mezip-finance-transactions.csv',rows.join('\n'),'text/csv;charset=utf-8');}if(action==='export-json')download('mezip-finance-backup.json',JSON.stringify(state,null,2),'application/json');}));document.querySelectorAll('[data-range]').forEach((button)=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{range=button.dataset.range;render();}));document.querySelector('#hide-amounts')?.addEventListener('change',(event)=>{state.privacy.hideAmounts=event.target.checked;save();render();});document.querySelector('#tx-search')?.addEventListener('input',filterTx);['#tx-account','#tx-type','#tx-category'].forEach((selector)=>document.querySelector(selector)?.addEventListener('change',filterTx));document.querySelector('#composer-form')?.addEventListener('submit',submit);document.querySelector('#budget-form')?.addEventListener('submit',submit);document.querySelector('#category-budget-form')?.addEventListener('submit',submit);document.querySelector('#subscription-form')?.addEventListener('submit',submit);};
  const renderComposerRows = () => {const rows=document.querySelector('#split-rows');if(!rows)return;rows.innerHTML=splitRows.map((row,index)=>'<div class="split-row"><select data-split-category="'+index+'">'+catOptions('EXPENSE',row.category)+'</select><input data-split-amount="'+index+'" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="'+row.amountCents/100+'" placeholder="金额" /><button type="button" data-action="remove-split" data-index="'+index+'">×</button></div>').join('');wire();document.querySelectorAll('[data-split-category]').forEach((select)=>select.addEventListener('change',(event)=>{splitRows[Number(event.target.dataset.splitCategory)].category=event.target.value;}));document.querySelectorAll('[data-split-amount]').forEach((input)=>input.addEventListener('input',(event)=>{splitRows[Number(event.target.dataset.splitAmount)].amountCents=inputCents(event.target.value);}));};
  window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{route=(location.hash.replace('#','')||'overview').split('?')[0]||'overview';render();});
  render();
})();

'仅接受官方账单文件导入' : '可通过“记一笔”记录'}</div></article>`; }).join('')}</div>`; };
        const linePoints = (items, type, width=640, height=180) => { if (!items.length) return ''; const values=items.map((item)=>item[type]); const max=Math.max(1,...values); return values.map((value,index)=>`${(index/(Math.max(1,values.length-1)))*width},${height-(value/max)*(height-22)-8}`).join(' '); };
        const trendData = (items) => { const rangeBounds=bounds(); const days=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((rangeBounds.to-rangeBounds.from)/86400000)+1); const limit=Math.min(days,31); return Array.from({length:limit},(_,index)=>{ const day=new Date(rangeBounds.from.getTime()+index*86400000); const iso=day.toISOString().slice(0,10); const dayItems=items.filter((item)=>isoDate(item.occurredAt)===iso); const data=totals(dayItems); return { label:`${String(day.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(day.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`, income:data.income/100, expense:data.expense/100 }; }); };
        const renderTrend = (items) => { const data=trendData(items); if (!items.length) return empty('还没有收支趋势','添加或导入账单后，这里会按日期显示收入与支出。'); const width=640,height=180; const labels=data.filter((_,i)=>i===0||i===data.length-1||i%Math.max(1,Math.floor(data.length/5))===0).map((item,i)=>`<text class="chart-axis" x="${(data.indexOf(item)/(Math.max(1,data.length-1)))*width}" y="204" text-anchor="middle">${item.label}</text>`).join(''); return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} 215" role="img" aria-label="收入与支出趋势"><line class="chart-grid" x1="0" y1="28" x2="${width}" y2="28"/><line class="chart-grid" x1="0" y1="78" x2="${width}" y2="78"/><line class="chart-grid" x1="0" y1="128" x2="${width}" y2="128"/><line class="chart-grid" x1="0" y1="178" x2="${width}" y2="178"/><polyline class="line-income" points="${linePoints(data,'income',width,height)}"/><polyline class="line-expense" points="${linePoints(data,'expense',width,height)}"/>${labels}</svg><div class="legend"><span>收入</span><span class="expense">支出</span></div>`; };
        const categoryData = (items) => { const map=new Map(); items.filter((item)=>item.type==='EXPENSE').forEach((item)=>map.set(item.category,(map.get(item.category)||0)+item.amountCents)); return [...map.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]); };
        const renderCategories = (items) => { const rows=categoryData(items); if (!rows.length) return empty('还没有分类占比','导入或记下一笔支出后，这里会自动归类。'); const total=rows.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item[1],0); const colors=['#8758ef','#ed7c48','#4f8ff7','#59c27b','#ee5e77','#31b7b7','#f3bf4c','#a3a5b7']; let cursor=0; const slices=rows.map(([,value],index)=>{const start=cursor;cursor+=(value/total)*100;return `${colors[index%colors.length]} ${start}% ${cursor}%`;}).join(','); return `<div class="donut-wrap"><div class="donut" style="background:conic-gradient(${slices})"><div class="donut-label">${money(total)}<small>总支出</small></div></div><div class="category-list">${rows.slice(0,8).map(([name,value],index)=>`<div class="category-row"><i style="background:${colors[index%colors.length]}"></i><span>${escapeHtml(name)}</span><strong>${pct((value/total)*100)} · ${money(value)}</strong></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`; };
        const renderBudgetSummary = (items) => { const total=totals(items); const budget=Number(state.budgets.totalCents)||0; const ratio=budget?total.expense/budget:0; return `<div class="budget-summary">${budget?`<div class="budget-line"><span>本期已使用</span><strong>${money(total.expense)} / ${money(budget)}</strong></div><div class="progress ${ratio>=.85?'warn':''}"><span style="width:${Math.min(100,ratio*100)}%"></span></div><div class="budget-line"><span>${ratio>=1?'已超过预算':ratio>=.85?'接近预算':'预算剩余'}</span><strong>${money(Math.max(0,budget-total.expense))}</strong></div>`:empty('还没有总预算','设置一个月度总预算后，这里会实时显示使用率。','budgets','设置预算')}</div>`; };
        const renderRecent = (items) => { const rows=[...items].sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.occurredAt)-new Date(a.occurredAt)).slice(0,7); if (!rows.length) return empty('还没有账单','可以手动记一笔，或从支付宝 / 微信导入官方账单。','open-import','导入账单'); return `<div class="recent-list">${rows.map((item)=>`<button class="recent" data-action="detail" data-id="${item.id}"><span class="recent-icon">${item.type==='INCOME'?'↗':item.type==='TRANSFER'?'⇄':'•'}</span><span class="recent-main"><strong>${escapeHtml(item.merchant||item.category||'未命名交易')}</strong><span>${accountLabel(item.account)} · ${escapeHtml(item.category||'未分类')} · ${fmtDate(item.occurredAt)}</span></span><span class="recent-amount ${item.type==='INCOME'?'amount-income':item.type==='TRANSFER'?'amount-transfer':'amount-expense'}">${item.type==='INCOME'?'+':item.type==='TRANSFER'?'': '-'}${number(item.amountCents)}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`; };
        const renderOverview = () => { const items=currentItems(); const data=totals(items); const budget=Number(state.budgets.totalCents)||0; const savings=data.income?data.balance/data.income:0; return `<div class="grid metrics">${metric('总收入',money(data.income),'当前时间范围','↗','income')}${metric('总支出',money(data.expense),'退款已从支出净额扣除','↘','expense')}${metric('结余',money(data.balance),'收入 - 支出净额','▣','balance')}${metric('储蓄率',data.income?pct(savings*100):'—','收入为 0 时显示 —','◔')}${metric('交易笔数',`${items.length} 笔`,'转账仍保留但不计入收支','⌘')}${metric('预算使用率',budget?pct((data.expense/budget)*100):'—',budget?`${money(data.expense)} / ${money(budget)}`:'请先设置预算','▤')}</div><div class="grid dashboard"><section class="panel chart"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>收支趋势</h2><p>按当前时间范围聚合真实记录</p></div><a class="link" href="#reports">查看报告 →</a></div>${renderTrend(items)}</section><section class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>支出分类占比</h2><p>退款与转账不会伪装成普通支出</p></div><a class="link" href="#transactions">查看账单 →</a></div>${renderCategories(items)}</section></div>${renderChannelCards()}<div class="grid dashboard"><section class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>最近账单</h2><p>点击进入详情、编辑分类、添加备注或删除</p></div><a class="link" href="#transactions">全部账单 →</a></div>${renderRecent(items)}</section><div class="side-stack"><section class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>预算进度</h2><p>提醒阈值：70% / 85% / 100%</p></div><a class="link" href="#budgets">管理 →</a></div>${renderBudgetSummary(items)}</section><section class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>数据边界</h2><p>这不是模拟同步</p></div></div><p class="muted" style="line-height:1.7">支付宝和微信当前按官方账单文件导入处理；只有用户确认保存的记录才会进入汇总。所有数据默认保存在本浏览器。</p></section></div></div>`; };
        const renderChannelPage = (source) => { const account=ACCOUNTS.find((item)=>item.key===source); const items=state.transactions.filter((item)=>item.account===source && inRange(item)); const data=totals(items); return `<div class="grid metrics">${metric(`${account.label}支出`,money(data.expense),'当前时间范围','↘','expense')}${metric(`${account.label}收入`,money(data.income),'退款单独处理','↗','income')}${metric('结余',money(data.balance),'收入 - 支出净额','▣','balance')}${metric('交易笔数',`${items.length} 笔`,'只统计此渠道','⌘')}</div><div class="grid page-grid" style="margin-top:12px"><section class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>${account.label}账单</h2><p>${account.status} · 不读取登录凭证，不爬取支付页面</p></div><button class="btn primary" data-action="open-import" data-source="${source}">导入官方账单</button></div>${items.length?renderRecent(items):empty(`还没有${account.label}账单`,`选择官方导出文件后先预览，确认后才会进入本机流水。`,'open-import','选择账单文件')}<div class="panel" style="margin-top:12px;background:#0d121c"><div class="panel-head"><div><h3>连接状态</h3><p>真实能力边界</p></div><span class="channel-status">NOT_CONNECTED</span></div><p class="muted">当前不显示“已连接”。如未来官方个人账单 API 明确开放，再单独接入真实 Provider。</p></div></section><aside class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>导入规则</h2><p>FinanceImportAdapter</p></div></div><ul class="muted" style="display:grid;gap:10px;padding-left:18px;line-height:1.6"><li>只接受用户主动选择的账单文件。</li><li>导入前展示记录数、收入、支出、时间范围、重复与异常。</li><li>优先使用 externalTransactionId；缺失时使用指纹去重。</li><li>整批导入可撤销；已编辑记录会先提示影响。</li></ul></aside></div>`; };
        const renderTransactions = () => { const all=[...state.transactions].sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.occurredAt)-new Date(a.occurredAt)); return `<section class="panel" id="transactions-page"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>全部账单</h2><p>支付宝、微信、现金、银行卡、信用卡和手动记录统一汇总；转账保留但不重复计入收支。</p></div><div class="inline"><button class="btn" data-action="open-import">导入账单</button><button class="btn primary" data-action="open-composer">＋ 记一笔</button></div></div><div class="form-grid" style="margin-bottom:15px"><label>搜索商家 / 备注 / 标签<input id="tx-search" placeholder="例如：星巴克、旅行、发票" /></label><label>账户<select id="tx-account"><option value="">全部账户</option>${accountOptions('')}</select></label><label>类型<select id="tx-type"><option value="">全部类型</option><option value="EXPENSE">支出</option><option value="INCOME">收入</option><option value="TRANSFER">转账</option><option value="REFUND">退款</option></select></label><label>分类<select id="tx-category"><option value="">全部分类</option>${[...EXPENSE_CATEGORIES,...INCOME_CATEGORIES].map((item)=>`<option>${item}</option>`).join('')}</select></label></div><div id="tx-table">${renderTransactionTable(all)}</div></section>`; };
        const renderTransactionTable = (items) => { if(!items.length) return empty('还没有账单','手动记账或导入后，所有渠道会出现在这里。','open-composer','记一笔'); return `<div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>商家 / 备注</th><th>金额</th><th>类型</th><th>分类</th><th>账户</th><th>发生时间</th><th>来源</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${items.slice(0,200).map((item)=>`<tr><td><strong>${escapeHtml(item.merchant||'未命名交易')}</strong><br><span class="muted">${escapeHtml(item.note||'')}</span></td><td class="${item.type==='INCOME'?'amount-income':item.type==='TRANSFER'?'amount-transfer':'amount-expense'}">${item.type==='INCOME'?'+':item.type==='TRANSFER'?'':'-'}${number(item.amountCents)}</td><td>${transactionTypeLabel(item.type)}</td><td><span class="pill">${escapeHtml(item.category||'未分类')}</span></td><td>${accountLabel(item.account)}</td><td>${fmtDate(item.occurredAt)}</td><td>${item.source==='MANUAL'?'手动':item.source==='ALIPAY_FILE'?'支付宝文件':item.source==='WECHAT_FILE'?'微信文件':'导入文件'}</td><td><button class="btn ghost" data-action="detail" data-id="${item.id}">详情</button></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>${items.length>200?'<p class="muted" style="margin-top:12px">当前只渲染前 200 条，后续可继续分页加载。</p>':''}</div>`; };
        const renderBudgets = () => { const items=currentItems(); const data=totals(items); const total=Number(state.budgets.totalCents)||0; const rows=Object.entries(state.budgets.categories||{}); return `<div class="grid page-grid"><section class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>总预算</h2><p>当前时间范围：${money(data.expense)} 支出净额</p></div></div><form id="budget-form" class="inline"><label style="flex:1">每月总预算（元）<input id="total-budget" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="${total?total/100:''}" placeholder="例如 8000" /></label><button class="btn primary" type="submit">保存预算</button></form><div style="margin-top:24px">${total?`<div class="budget-line"><span>使用率</span><strong>${pct(data.expense/total*100)}</strong></div><div class="progress ${data.expense/total>=.85?'warn':''}" style="margin-top:9px"><span style="width:${Math.min(100,data.expense/total*100)}%"></span></div><p class="muted" style="margin-top:9px">剩余 ${money(Math.max(0,total-data.expense))} · 超过 70% / 85% / 100% 时显示提醒。</p>`:empty('还没有总预算','先设置每月额度，首页才能显示预算使用率。')}</div></section><aside class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>分类预算</h2><p>已使用的分类不会直接删除</p></div></div><form id="category-budget-form"><label>分类<select id="budget-category">${EXPENSE_CATEGORIES.map((item)=>`<option>${item}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label style="margin-top:10px">预算金额（元）<input id="budget-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="例如 2000" /></label><button class="btn primary" type="submit" style="margin-top:11px">保存分类预算</button></form></aside></div><section class="panel" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>分类预算进度</h2><p>仅按支出记录计算；退款会抵减支出。</p></div></div>${rows.length?`<div class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))">${rows.map(([category,budget])=>{const used=categoryData(items).find(([name])=>name===category)?.[1]||0; };
        const reportData = (yearly=false) => { const now=new Date(); const end=new Date(yearly?now.getFullYear():now.getFullYear(), yearly?11:now.getMonth()+1,0,23,59,59); const start=new Date(yearly?now.getFullYear():now.getFullYear(), yearly?0:now.getMonth(),1); const current=state.transactions.filter((item)=>{const time=new Date(item.occurredAt);return time>=start&&time<=end;}); const prevStart=new Date(yearly?now.getFullYear()-1:now.getFullYear(),yearly?0:now.getMonth()-1,1); const prevEnd=new Date(yearly?now.getFullYear()-1:now.getFullYear(),yearly?11:now.getMonth(),0,23,59,59); const previous=state.transactions.filter((item)=>{const time=new Date(item.occurredAt);return time>=prevStart&&time<=prevEnd;}); return { current, previous, totals:totals(current), previousTotals:totals(previous), start, end }; };
        const renderReports = () => {
          const annual=new URLSearchParams(location.hash.split('?')[1]||'').get('year')==='1';
          const report=reportData(annual);
          const rows=categoryData(report.current);
          const merchantTotals=new Map();
          report.current.forEach((item)=>{
            const merchant=String(item.merchant||item.description||'未命名交易').trim()||'未命名交易';
            const totalsForMerchant=merchantTotals.get(merchant)||{ income:0, expense:0, refunds:0 };
            const amount=Number(item.amountCents)||0;
            if(item.type==='INCOME') totalsForMerchant.income+=amount;
            else if(item.type==='EXPENSE') totalsForMerchant.expense+=amount;
            else if(item.type==='REFUND') totalsForMerchant.refunds+=amount;
            merchantTotals.set(merchant,totalsForMerchant);
          });
          const merchantRows=[...merchantTotals.entries()].map(([merchant,values])=>{
            const netExpense=Math.max(0,values.expense-values.refunds);
            return { merchant,...values,netExpense,balance:values.income-netExpense };
          });
          const topExpenseMerchant=merchantRows.filter((item)=>item.netExpense>0).sort((a,b)=>b.netExpense-a.netExpense)[0];
          const topIncomeMerchant=merchantRows.filter((item)=>item.income>0).sort((a,b)=>b.income-a.income)[0];
          const topBalanceMerchant=merchantRows.filter((item)=>item.income>0||item.netExpense>0).sort((a,b)=>b.balance-a.balance)[0];

          const delta=report.previousTotals.expense?((report.totals.expense-report.previousTotals.expense)/report.previousTotals.expense)*100:null;
          const merchantSummary=`<section class="merchant-summary" aria-label="本期商家收支排行"><div class="merchant-summary-head"><div><h2>本期商家收支</h2><p>按当前${annual?'年度':'月度'}已保存账单汇总；退款会抵减支出，转账不计入收支。</p></div><span class="merchant-count">${merchantRows.length} 个商家</span></div><div class="merchant-summary-grid">${merchantRank('支出最多',topExpenseMerchant,topExpenseMerchant?.netExpense||0,'支出合计','expense')}${merchantRank('收入最多',topIncomeMerchant,topIncomeMerchant?.income||0,'收入合计','income')}${merchantRank('结余最高',topBalanceMerchant,topBalanceMerchant?.balance||0,'收入 - 支出净额','balance')}</div></section>`;
          return `<div class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>${annual?'年度':'月度'}报告</h2><p>报告数字完全由当前浏览器中已保存的交易计算，不调用 AI 编造数据。</p></div><div class="inline"><a class="btn ${annual?'':'primary'}" href="#reports">月度</a><a class="btn ${annual?'primary':''}" href="#reports?year=1">年度</a></div></div>${report.current.length?`<div class="grid report-grid">${metric('总收入',money(report.totals.income),'报告周期','↗','income')}${metric('总支出',money(report.totals.expense),'退款已抵减','↘','expense')}${metric('结余',money(report.totals.balance),'收入 - 支出净额','▣','balance')}${metric('储蓄率',report.totals.income?pct(report.totals.balance/report.totals.income*100):'—','收入为 0 时显示 —','◔')}${metric('最大消费分类',rows[0]?escapeHtml(rows[0][0]):'—',rows[0]?money(rows[0][1]):'还没有支出','◉')}${metric('最多消费商家',topExpenseMerchant?escapeHtml(topExpenseMerchant.merchant):'—',topExpenseMerchant?money(topExpenseMerchant.netExpense):'还没有支出','⌁')}</div>${merchantSummary}<div class="grid dashboard" style="margin-top:12px"><section class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>自动生成的观察</h2><p>只使用可追溯的汇总数据</p></div></div><ul class="muted" style="display:grid;gap:11px;padding-left:18px;line-height:1.7"><li>本周期结余为 <strong style="color:#e7ddff">${money(report.totals.balance)}</strong>。</li><li>${delta===null?'上个周期暂无可比较的支出数据。':`支出相比上个周期${delta>=0?'增加':'减少'} ${Math.abs(delta).toFixed(1)}%。`}</li><li>${state.budgets.totalCents?`预算剩余 ${money(Math.max(0,state.budgets.totalCents-report.totals.expense))}。`:'尚未设置总预算。'}</li></ul></section><section class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>分类明细</h2><p>点击“全部账单”可继续筛选</p></div></div>${renderCategories(report.current)}</section></div>`:empty(`${annual?'今年':'本月'}还没有账单`,`完成手动记账或导入后，系统会生成真实报告。`,'open-composer','记一笔')}</div>`;
        };
        const detectSubscriptions = () => { const byMerchant=new Map(); state.transactions.filter((item)=>item.type==='EXPENSE').forEach((item)=>{const key=(item.merchant||'').trim().toLowerCase();if(!key)return;const list=byMerchant.get(key)||[];list.push(item);byMerchant.set(key,list);}); return [...byMerchant.entries()].flatMap(([merchant,items])=>{const amounts=new Set(items.map((item)=>item.amountCents));if(items.length<2||amounts.size>1)return [];return [{ merchant, amountCents:items[0].amountCents, count:items.length, latest:items.sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.occurredAt)-new Date(a.occurredAt))[0] }];}); };

        const render = () => { updateTop(); if(route==='alipay') app.innerHTML=renderChannelPage('ALIPAY'); else if(route==='wechat') app.innerHTML=renderChannelPage('WECHAT_PAY'); else if(route==='transactions') app.innerHTML=renderTransactions(); else if(route==='budgets') app.innerHTML=renderBudgets(); else if(route==='reports') app.innerHTML=renderReports(); else if(route==='subscriptions') app.innerHTML=renderSubscriptions(); else if(route==='settings') app.innerHTML=renderSettings(); else app.innerHTML=renderOverview(); wire(); };
        const openComposer = (id=null, seed=null) => { composerDraft = id ? { ...state.transactions.find((item)=>item.id===id) } : { type:seed?.type||'EXPENSE', amountCents:seed?.amountCents||0, category:seed?.category||EXPENSE_CATEGORIES[0], account:seed?.account||'CASH', destinationAccount:'BANK', merchant:seed?.merchant||'', occurredAt:seed?.occurredAt||new Date().toISOString().slice(0,16), note:'', tags:'', receiptName:'', id:id||null }; splitRows=[]; renderComposer(); };
        const renderComposer = () => { const draft=composerDraft||{}; const editing=Boolean(draft.id); const split=splitRows.length>0; document.querySelector('#composer-modal').innerHTML=`<div class="form-full">备注<textarea id="composer-note" placeholder="可选：记录这笔钱的原因、关联 Life Entry 等">${escapeHtml(draft.note||'')}</textarea></label><label>标签<input id="composer-tags" value="${escapeHtml(draft.tags||'')}" placeholder="旅行, 生日礼物" /></label><label>图片凭证<input id="composer-receipt" type="file" accept="image/*,.pdf" /><small class="muted">默认 PRIVATE；本地版本先保存文件名，不上传。</small></label></div><div style="margin-top:14px"><div class="inline"><strong style="font-size:12px">拆分账单（可选）</strong><button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-action="add-split">${split?'继续添加拆分':'启用拆分'}</button><span class="muted">拆分总和必须严格等于原金额。</span></div><div id="split-rows">${split?splitRows.map((row,index)=>`<div class="split-row"><select         const openImport = (source='ALIPAY') => { importDraft={ source, fileName:'', rows:[], duplicates:0, errors:0, status:'等待选择文件' }; document.querySelector('#import-modal').innerHTML=`<div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><div><p class="eyebrow">FINANCE IMPORT ADAPTER</p><h2>导入账单文件</h2><p class="muted">选择官方导出文件，先解析预览，再由你确认导入。</p></div><button class="modal-close" data-action="close-modal" data-modal="import-modal">×</button></div><div class="form-grid"><label>账单来源<select id="import-source"><option value="ALIPAY"${source==='ALIPAY'?' selected':''}>支付宝</option><option value="WECHAT"${source==='WECHAT'?' selected':''}>微信支付</option><option value="GENERIC">通用 CSV</option></select></label><label>账单文件<input id="import-file" type="file" accept=".csv,.txt,.tsv,.xlsx" /><small class="muted">CSV / TSV 可直接解析；XLSX 若浏览器无法解析会明确提示，不会伪造成功。</small></label></div><div id="import-preview" style="margin-top:16px">${empty('等待账单文件','选择文件后显示记录总数、收入、支出、时间范围、重复与异常。')}</div><div class="modal-foot"><button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-action="close-modal" data-modal="import-modal">取消</button><button class="btn primary" id="confirm-import" type="button" disabled>确认导入</button></div></div>`; const modal=document.querySelector('#import-modal'); modal.hidden=false; document.querySelector('#import-file').addEventListener('change', (event)=>prepareImport(event.target.files?.[0])); document.querySelector('#import-source').addEventListener('change',(event)=>{importDraft.source=event.target.value;}); };
        const parseDelimited = (text) => { const lines=[]; let row=[], field='', quoted=false; for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){const ch=text[i],next=text[i+1];if(ch==='"'&&quoted&&next==='"'){field+='"';i++;continue;}if(ch==='"'){quoted=!quoted;continue;}if(ch===','&&!quoted){row.push(field);field='';continue;}if((ch==='\n'||ch==='\r')&&!quoted){if(ch==='\r'&&next==='\n')i++;row.push(field);field='';if(row.some((value)=>value.trim()))lines.push(row);row=[];continue;}field+=ch;}if(field||row.length){row.push(field);if(row.some((value)=>value.trim()))lines.push(row);}return lines; };
        const findColumn = (headers, patterns) => headers.findIndex((header)=>patterns.some((pattern)=>pattern.test(String(header||''))));
        const normalizeType = (raw, amount) => { const value=String(raw||'').toLowerCase(); if(/转账|transfer/.test(value)) return 'TRANSFER'; if(/退款|refund/.test(value)) return 'REFUND'; if(/收入|收款|income|工资/.test(value)) return 'INCOME'; return amount<0?'EXPENSE':'INCOME'; };
        const parseImportRows = (text, source) => { const lines=parseDelimited(text.replace(/^\uFEFF/,'')); if(lines.length<2)return []; const headers=lines[0]; const dateCol=findColumn(headers,[/时间|日期|发生|date/i]); const amountCol=findColumn(headers,[/金额|收支|amount|price/i]); const merchantCol=findColumn(headers,[/商户|商家|商品|名称|merchant|title/i]); const typeCol=findColumn(headers,[/类型|收/支|收支|type/i]); const idCol=findColumn(headers,[/订单|交易号|流水号|id|编号/i]); const noteCol=findColumn(headers,[/备注|说明|note|description/i]); const categoryCol=findColumn(headers,[/分类|category/i]); return lines.slice(1).map((line,index)=>{const rawAmount=amountCol>=0?line[amountCol]:line.find((value)=>/[￥¥]?[-+]?\d+[.,]?\d*/.test(value))||''; const cents=Math.abs(centsFromInput(rawAmount)); const occurredAt=isoDate(dateCol>=0?line[dateCol]:new Date()); const merchant=(merchantCol>=0?line[merchantCol]:'').trim(); const note=(noteCol>=0?line[noteCol]:'').trim(); return { id:`import-${Date.now()}-${index}`, externalId:(idCol>=0?line[idCol]:'').trim(), amountCents:cents, type:normalizeType(typeCol>=0?line[typeCol]:'',centsFromInput(rawAmount)), category:(categoryCol>=0?line[categoryCol]:'').trim()||'其他', account:source==='ALIPAY'?'ALIPAY':source==='WECHAT'?'WECHAT_PAY':'OTHER', merchant, note, occurredAt:`${occurredAt}T12:00:00`, source:source==='ALIPAY'?'ALIPAY_FILE':source==='WECHAT'?'WECHAT_FILE':'IMPORT_FILE' }; }).filter((item)=>item.amountCents>0); };
        const fingerprint = (item) => [item.source,item.externalId||'',isoDate(item.occurredAt),item.amountCents,item.merchant||'',item.note||''].join('|').toLowerCase();
        const prepareImport = async (file) => { if(!file)return; importDraft.fileName=file.name; if(/\.xlsx$/i.test(file.name)){importDraft.status='XLSX 需要在本机先导出为 CSV / TSV；当前浏览器未启用二进制解析器。'; importDraft.rows=[]; renderImportPreview(); return;} const text=await file.text(); importDraft.rows=parseImportRows(text,importDraft.source); const existing=new Set(state.transactions.map(fingerprint)); const seen=new Set(); importDraft.duplicates=0; importDraft.errors=0; importDraft.rows=importDraft.rows.map((item)=>{const key=fingerprint(item);if(existing.has(key)||seen.has(key)){importDraft.duplicates++;item.duplicate=true;}else seen.add(key);return item;}); importDraft.status=importDraft.rows.length?'已解析预览':'文件没有可识别的交易行'; renderImportPreview(); };
        const renderImportPreview = () => { const target=document.querySelector('#import-preview'); const button=document.querySelector('#confirm-import'); if(!target)return; if(!importDraft.rows.length){target.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><div><strong>${escapeHtml(importDraft.status)}</strong><span>请检查导出的格式，或使用 CSV / TSV 再试一次。</span></div></div>`; if(button)button.disabled=true;return;} const amounts=totals(importDraft.rows.filter((item)=>!item.duplicate)); const dates=importDraft.rows.map((item)=>new Date(item.occurredAt)).sort((a,b)=>a-b); target.innerHTML=`<div class="grid metrics" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)">${metric('交易总数',`${importDraft.rows.length} 笔`,'本次文件','⌘')}${metric('收入数量',`${importDraft.rows.filter((item)=>item.type==='INCOME').length} 笔`,'预览','↗','income')}${metric('支出数量',`${importDraft.rows.filter((item)=>item.type==='EXPENSE').length} 笔`,'预览','↘','expense')}${metric('重复数量',`${importDraft.duplicates} 笔`,'将跳过','↺')}${metric('异常数量',`${importDraft.errors} 笔`,'金额 / 日期无法识别','!')}</div><p class="muted" style="margin:12px 0">时间范围：${dates[0]?.toISOString().slice(0,10)||'—'} → ${dates.at(-1)?.toISOString().slice(0,10)||'—'} · 本次可导入金额：${money(amounts.expense+amounts.income)}</p><div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>商家</th><th>金额</th><th>类型</th><th>日期</th><th>状态</th></tr></thead><tbody>${importDraft.rows.slice(0,20).map((item)=>`<tr><td>${escapeHtml(item.merchant||'未命名')}</td><td>${money(item.amountCents)}</td><td>${transactionTypeLabel(item.type)}</td><td>${isoDate(item.occurredAt)}</td><td>${item.duplicate?'重复，将跳过':'待导入'}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>${importDraft.rows.length>20?'<p class="muted" style="margin-top:10px">预览只展示前 20 行，导入仍按完整文件处理。</p>':''}`; if(button)button.disabled=false; };
        const confirmImport = () => { const rows=(importDraft?.rows||[]).filter((item)=>!item.duplicate); if(!rows.length)return; const batch={ id:`batch-${Date.now()}`, ownerId:'local-owner', source:importDraft.source, fileName:importDraft.fileName, recordCount:rows.length, duplicateCount:importDraft.duplicates, errorCount:importDraft.errors, status:'COMPLETE', createdAt:new Date().toISOString() }; state.transactions.push(...rows.map((item)=>({ ...item, importBatchId:batch.id, createdAt:batch.createdAt, updatedAt:batch.createdAt }))); state.importBatches.push(batch); save(); importDraft=null; document.querySelector('#import-modal').hidden=true; render(); };

} if(event.target.id==='budget-form'){event.preventDefault();state.budgets.totalCents=centsFromInput(event.target.querySelector('#total-budget').value);save();render();} if(event.target.id==='category-budget-form'){event.preventDefault();const category=event.target.querySelector('#budget-category').value;state.budgets.categories[category]=centsFromInput(event.target.querySelector('#budget-amount').value);save();render();} if(event.target.id==='subscription-form'){event.preventDefault();const form=event.target;state.subscriptions.push({id:`sub-${Date.now()}`,name:form.querySelector('#sub-name').value.trim(),amountCents:centsFromInput(form.querySelector('#sub-amount').value),period:form.querySelector('#sub-period').value,nextDate:form.querySelector('#sub-date').value,account:form.querySelector('#sub-account').value});save();document.querySelector('#composer-modal').hidden=true;render();} };
        const wireComposer = () => { const type=document.querySelector('#composer-type'); type?.addEventListener('change',()=>{const category=document.querySelector('#composer-category');const current=category.value;category.innerHTML=categoryOptions(type.value==='INCOME'?'INCOME':'EXPENSE',current);document.querySelector('#destination-wrap')?.classList.toggle('hidden',type.value!=='TRANSFER');}); document.querySelectorAll('[data-split-category]').forEach((select)=>select.addEventListener('change',(event)=>{splitRows[Number(event.target.dataset.splitCategory)].category=event.target.value;})); document.querySelectorAll('[data-split-amount]').forEach((input)=>input.addEventListener('input',(event)=>{splitRows[Number(event.target.dataset.splitAmount)].amountCents=centsFromInput(event.target.value);})); document.querySelector('#composer-form')?.addEventListener('submit',handleSubmit); };

  async function api(path, init = {}) {
    const headers = { ...(init.headers || {}) };
    if (init.body && !headers['Content-Type']) headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    const response = await fetch(`${BRIDGE}${path}`, { credentials: 'include', ...init, headers });
    const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(body.error?.message || '本地财务收件箱请求失败。');
    return body;
  }

  function loadLedger() {
    try { return Core.hydrateState(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FINANCE_KEY) || 'null') || Core.blankState()); } catch { return Core.blankState(); }
  }
  function saveLedger(state) { localStorage.setItem(FINANCE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); }
  function ledgerEntryExists(record) { return loadLedger().transactions.some((item) => item.id === ledgerId(record)); }
  function needsReentry(record) { return record.status === 'CONFIRMED_TO_DESKTOP' && !ledgerEntryExists(record); }
  function buildTransaction(record, fields) {
    const cents = Core.toCents(fields.amount);
    if (cents === null || cents <= 0) throw new Error('请填写大于 0 的金额，再确认入账。');
    const occurredAt = fields.occurredAt ? new Date(fields.occurredAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString();
    if (Number.isNaN(new Date(occurredAt).getTime())) throw new Error('发生时间无效，请重新选择。');
    const state = loadLedger();
    const id = ledgerId(record);
    const existing = state.transactions.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (existing) return { state, transaction: existing, created: false };
    const transaction = {
      id, ownerId: state.ownerId, accountId: fields.account, account: fields.account, destinationAccount: '', type: fields.type === 'INCOME' ? 'INCOME' : 'EXPENSE', amountCents: cents, currency: 'CNY', merchant: fields.merchant.trim() || '手机拍照凭证', counterparty: fields.merchant.trim(), description: '手机拍照凭证', category: fields.category, classificationBasis: 'USER_CONFIRMATION', paymentMethod: '', occurredAt, timezone: state.settings?.timezone || 'Asia/Shanghai', status: 'POSTED', note: fields.note.trim(), noteGrid: Array.isArray(record.noteGrid) ? record.noteGrid : [], tags: '手机凭证', receiptName: record.fileName, receiptRecordId: record.id, receiptCapturedAt: record.createdAt, source: 'MOBILE_CAMERA', originalTransactionId: '', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    transaction.fingerprint = Core.fingerprint(transaction);
    state.transactions.push(transaction);
    return { state, transaction, created: true };
  }

  }

  function syncReceiptReferences(records) {
    const state = loadLedger();
    let changed = false;
    records.filter((record) => record.status === 'CONFIRMED_TO_DESKTOP').forEach((record) => {
      const transaction = state.transactions.find((item) => item.id === ledgerId(record));
      if (!transaction) return;
      const remoteNoteGrid = Array.isArray(record.noteGrid) ? record.noteGrid : [];
      if (transaction.receiptRecordId !== record.id || transaction.receiptName !== record.fileName || transaction.receiptCapturedAt !== record.createdAt || JSON.stringify(transaction.noteGrid || []) !== JSON.stringify(remoteNoteGrid)) {
        transaction.receiptRecordId = record.id;
        transaction.receiptName = record.fileName;
        transaction.receiptCapturedAt = record.createdAt;
        transaction.noteGrid = remoteNoteGrid;
        transaction.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        changed = true;
      }
    });
    if (changed) saveLedger(state);
  }
  function filteredRecords() {
    const state = document.querySelector('#record-status')?.value || 'ALL';
    const query = (document.querySelector('#record-search')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return allRecords.filter((record) => {
      const matchesState = state === 'ALL' ? record.status !== 'REJECTED' : state === 'PENDING_REVIEW' ? record.status === 'PENDING_REVIEW' || needsReentry(record) : state === 'CONFIRMED_TO_DESKTOP' ? record.status === 'CONFIRMED_TO_DESKTOP' && !needsReentry(record) : record.status === state;
      const detailValues = Array.isArray(record.noteGrid) ? record.noteGrid.flatMap((row) => Object.values(row || {})) : [];
      return matchesState && (!query || [record.merchant, record.note, record.fileName, ...detailValues].filter((value) => value != null).join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(query));
    });
  }

  async function confirmRecord(record) {
    const button = detailElement.querySelector(`[data-record-id="${CSS.escape(record.id)}"] [data-confirm]`);
    const status = detailElement.querySelector(`[data-record-id="${CSS.escape(record.id)}"] [data-status]`);
    const before = localStorage.getItem(FINANCE_KEY);
    try {
      button.disabled = true; button.textContent = '正在确认…';
      const restoringDeletedEntry = needsReentry(record);
      if (restoringDeletedEntry) await api(`/v1/finance/mobile/receipts/${encodeURIComponent(record.id)}/reopen`, { method: 'POST' });
      const result = buildTransaction(record, formValues(record));
      if (result.created) saveLedger(result.state);
      await api(`/v1/finance/mobile/receipts/${encodeURIComponent(record.id)}/confirm`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ ledgerEntryId: result.transaction.id }) });
      status.textContent = '✓ 已确认写入本机账本。'; status.className = 'status confirmed'; button.textContent = '补写到本机账本';
      await loadInbox();
    } catch (error) {
      if (before !== null) localStorage.setItem(FINANCE_KEY, before);
      else localStorage.removeItem(FINANCE_KEY);
      status.textContent = error.message || '确认失败，请重试。'; status.className = 'status error';
      button.textContent = '确认写入本机账本';
    } finally { button.disabled = false; }
  }
  async function rejectRecord(record) {
    if (!window.confirm('拒收后，这张凭证不会写入本机账本，并会从默认列表隐藏。仍可通过“已拒收”筛选查看。确认拒收？')) return;
    const button = detailElement.querySelector('#reject-record');
    try {
      button.disabled = true; button.textContent = '正在拒收…';
      await api(`/v1/finance/mobile/receipts/${encodeURIComponent(record.id)}/reject`, { method: 'POST' });
      selectedRecordId = null;
      await loadInbox();
      setStatus('已拒收：未写入本机账本，默认列表已隐藏该凭证。');
    } catch (error) {
      setStatus(error.message || '拒收失败，请重试。', true);
      button.disabled = false; button.textContent = '拒收并隐藏';
    }
  }
  async function clearRecord(record) {
    if (!window.confirm('确定清除这一条收件箱记录吗？它会从实时接收列表中移除；若没有其他记录使用同一张照片，原图也会从本机收件箱删除。此操作不会删除任何仍保留在账本中的交易。')) return;
    const button = document.querySelector(`[data-clear="${CSS.escape(record.id)}"]`);
    try {
      if (button) { button.disabled = true; button.textContent = '正在清除…'; }
      if (needsReentry(record)) await api(`/v1/finance/mobile/receipts/${encodeURIComponent(record.id)}/reopen`, { method: 'POST' });
      await api(`/v1/finance/mobile/receipts/${encodeURIComponent(record.id)}/remove`, { method: 'POST' });
      selectedRecordId = null;
      await loadInbox();
      setStatus('已清除 1 条本地凭证记录；实时接收计数已同步减少。');
    } catch (error) {
      setStatus(error.message || '清除失败，请重试。', true);
      if (button) { button.disabled = false; button.textContent = '清除这条记录'; }
    }
  }
  async function createMobileLink() {
    try {
      document.querySelector('#make-link').disabled = true;
      await ensureDesktopSession();
      const invite = await api(`/v1/finance/mobile/invite?version=${captureVersion}`);
      if (!invite.mobileUrl) throw new Error('未检测到可用的局域网地址。请确认电脑已连接 Wi‑Fi 或网线。');
      inviteInput.value = invite.mobileUrl;
      document.querySelector('#copy-link').disabled = false;
      inviteState.textContent = `链接将在 ${new Date(invite.expiresAt).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })} 前用于首次配对。生成新链接会让旧手机配对失效。`;
    } catch (error) { inviteState.textContent = error.message || '无法生成链接。'; inviteState.style.color = '#ffb5c0'; }
    finally { document.querySelector('#make-link').disabled = false; }
  }
  function startRealtimeStream() {
    eventSource = new EventSource(`${BRIDGE}/v1/finance/mobile/events`, { withCredentials: true });
    eventSource.addEventListener('inbox', () => loadInbox());
    eventSource.onerror = () => { eventSource?.close(); eventSource = null; setStatus('实时连接中断，正在使用手动刷新。', true); };
  }
  document.querySelector('#make-link').addEventListener('click', createMobileLink);
  document.querySelector('#refresh').addEventListener('click', loadInbox);
  document.querySelector('#record-status').addEventListener('change', renderTable);
  document.querySelector('#record-search').addEventListener('input', renderTable);
  document.querySelector('#clear-filter').addEventListener('click', () => { document.querySelector('#record-status').value = 'ALL'; document.querySelector('#record-search').value = ''; renderTable(); });
  document.querySelector('#copy-link').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(inviteInput.value); inviteState.textContent = '手机拍照链接已复制。请在手机浏览器打开。'; } catch { inviteInput.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); inviteState.textContent = '手机拍照链接已复制。请在手机浏览器打开。'; }
  });
  loadInbox();
})();

===== FILE: standalone/mezip-local/apps/web/public/finance-receipt-inbox-v11/note-grid.js =====
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const iframe = document.querySelector('#v11-content');
  const STORAGE_KEY = 'mezip.finance.receipt.v11.note-grid';
  const FINANCE_KEY = 'mezip.finance.center.v2';
  const BRIDGE = 'http://127.0.0.1:4325';
  const FIELDS = ['sku', 'nameSpec', 'unit', 'quantity', 'unitPrice', 'amount', 'remark'];
  const HEADERS = ['货号', '名称及规格', '单位', '数量', '单价', '金额', '备注'];
  const bridgeFetch = (...args) => {
    const frameFetch = iframe?.contentWindow?.fetch;
    return typeof frameFetch === 'function' ? frameFetch.call(iframe.contentWindow, ...args) : fetch(...args);
  };

  const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/gu, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[character]));
  const readStore = () => {
    try { const value = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || '{}'); return value && typeof value === 'object' ? value : {}; } catch { return {}; }
  };
  const writeStore = (store) => { try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(store)); } catch { /* private mode may deny local storage */ } };
  const cleanRows = (rows) => (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).map((row) => Object.fromEntries(FIELDS.map((field) => [field, String(row?.[field] || '').trim().slice(0, field === 'remark' ? 220 : 120)]))).filter((row) => Object.values(row).some(Boolean));
  const defaultRows = (rows) => { const safe = cleanRows(rows); return safe.length ? safe : Array.from({ length: 5 }, () => Object.fromEntries(FIELDS.map((field) => [field, '']))); };
  const ledgerId = (recordId) => `mobile-receipt-${String(recordId).replace(/^receipt-/u, '')}`;

  function updateLedgerNote(recordId, note, rows) {
    try {
      const state = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FINANCE_KEY) || 'null');
      if (!state || !Array.isArray(state.transactions)) return;
      const transaction = state.transactions.find((item) => item.id === ledgerId(recordId));
      if (!transaction) return;
      transaction.note = note;
      transaction.noteGrid = rows;
      transaction.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      localStorage.setItem(FINANCE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
    } catch { /* keep the local grid usable when storage is unavailable */ }
  }

  async function remoteRecord(recordId) {
    try {
      const response = await bridgeFetch(`${BRIDGE}/v1/finance/mobile/receipts`, { credentials: 'include' });
      if (!response.ok) return null;
      const body = await response.json();
      return Array.isArray(body.records) ? body.records.find((record) => record.id === recordId) || null : null;
    } catch { return null; }
  }

  function financeCore() { return iframe?.contentWindow?.MEZipFinance || window.MEZipFinance || null; }
  function updateLedgerTransaction(recordId, fields, rows) {
    try {
      const state = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FINANCE_KEY) || 'null');
      if (!state || !Array.isArray(state.transactions)) return;
      const transaction = state.transactions.find((item) => item.id === ledgerId(recordId));
      if (!transaction) return;
      const core = financeCore();
      const amountCents = core?.toCents?.(fields.amount);
      if (Number.isInteger(amountCents) && amountCents > 0) transaction.amountCents = amountCents;
      transaction.type = fields.type === 'INCOME' ? 'INCOME' : 'EXPENSE';
      transaction.merchant = fields.merchant || '手机拍照凭证';
      transaction.counterparty = fields.merchant;
      transaction.occurredAt = fields.occurredAt;
      transaction.note = fields.note;
      transaction.noteGrid = rows;
      transaction.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      localStorage.setItem(FINANCE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
    } catch { /* keep the bridge update authoritative when local storage is unavailable */ }
  }

  async function saveEditedRecord(key, card, section, button, status) {
    const fields = Object.fromEntries(['amount', 'merchant', 'occurredAt', 'note', 'type'].map((field) => [field, String(card.querySelector(`[data-field="${field}"]`)?.value || '').trim()]));
    const core = financeCore();
    const amountCents = core?.toCents?.(fields.amount);
    if (!Number.isInteger(amountCents) || amountCents <= 0) throw new Error('金额必须是大于 0 的数字。');
    const occurredAt = fields.occurredAt ? new Date(fields.occurredAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString();
    if (Number.isNaN(new Date(occurredAt).getTime())) throw new Error('发生时间无效，请重新选择。');
    const rows = rowsFromSection(section);
    const response = await bridgeFetch(`${BRIDGE}/v1/finance/mobile/receipts/${encodeURIComponent(key)}`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      credentials: 'include',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ amount: fields.amount, merchant: fields.merchant, type: fields.type, occurredAt, note: fields.note, noteGrid: rows }),
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`保存失败（HTTP ${response.status}）`);
    updateLedgerTransaction(key, { ...fields, occurredAt }, rows);
    if (status) status.textContent = '已保存修改，并同步到 V2 中心';
    card.dataset.v11EditMode = 'false';
    button.textContent = '编辑账单';
    button.disabled = false;
  }

  function ensureEditActions(detail) {
    const card = detail.querySelector('.receipt[data-record-id]');
    const actions = card?.querySelector('.receipt-actions');
    const fields = card?.querySelector('.fields');
    if (!card || !actions || !fields || card.querySelector('[data-v11-edit]')) return;
    const status = actions.querySelector('[data-status]');
    const button = card.ownerDocument.createElement('button');
    button.type = 'button';
    button.className = 'button ghost';
    button.dataset.v11Edit = 'true';
    button.textContent = '编辑账单';
    button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (card.dataset.v11EditMode === 'true') {
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = '保存中…';
        try { await saveEditedRecord(card.dataset.recordId, card, detail.querySelector('.v11-note-grid'), button, status); }
        catch (error) { if (status) status.textContent = error.message || '保存失败，请重试。'; button.disabled = false; button.textContent = '保存修改'; }
        return;
      }
      card.dataset.v11EditMode = 'true';
      fields.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = '保存修改';
      card.querySelector('[data-field="amount"]')?.focus();

  function frameDocument() { return iframe?.contentDocument || null; }
  function selectedKey(detail) { return detail?.querySelector('[data-record-id]')?.dataset.recordId || ''; }
  function rowsFromSection(section) {

  }
  function remarksFromRows(rows) {
    return rows.map((row) => row.remark).filter(Boolean).join('；').slice(0, 600);
  }
  const persistTimers = new Map();
  async function syncBridge(key, section, noteField) {
    const rows = rowsFromSection(section);
    const note = String(noteField?.value || remarksFromRows(rows)).trim().slice(0, 600);
    const syncStatus = section.querySelector('.v11-grid-sync-status');
    try {
      const response = await bridgeFetch(`${BRIDGE}/v1/finance/mobile/receipts/${encodeURIComponent(key)}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        credentials: 'include',
        keepalive: true,
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ note, noteGrid: rows }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      if (syncStatus) syncStatus.textContent = '已同步到 V2 中心';
    } catch {
      if (syncStatus) syncStatus.textContent = '已保存本机；V2 中心等待连接';
    }
  }
  function queuePersist(key, section, noteField) {
    if (!key || !section) return;
    const rows = rowsFromSection(section);
    const note = String(noteField?.value || remarksFromRows(rows)).trim().slice(0, 600);
    const store = readStore(); store[key] = rows; writeStore(store);
    updateLedgerNote(key, note, rows);
    const syncStatus = section.querySelector('.v11-grid-sync-status');
    if (syncStatus) syncStatus.textContent = '同步到 V2 中心…';
    clearTimeout(persistTimers.get(key));
    persistTimers.set(key, setTimeout(async () => {
      persistTimers.delete(key);
      await syncBridge(key, section, noteField);
    }, 250));
  }

  function renderRows(section, rows, key, noteField) {
    const body = section.querySelector('tbody');
    body.innerHTML = '';
    const addRow = (row = {}) => {
      const tr = section.ownerDocument.createElement('tr');
      tr.dataset.v11GridRow = 'true';

      tr.querySelectorAll('input').forEach((input) => input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        if (input.dataset.v11GridField === 'remark' && noteField) noteField.value = remarksFromRows(rowsFromSection(section));
        queuePersist(key, section, noteField);
      }));

      body.append(tr);
    };
    defaultRows(rows).forEach(addRow);
    section.querySelector('.v11-grid-add').addEventListener('click', () => { addRow(); queuePersist(key, section, noteField); });
  }

  function ensureGrid(detail) {
    const key = selectedKey(detail);
    if (!key) return;
    let section = detail.querySelector('.v11-note-grid');
    if (!section) {
      section = detail.ownerDocument.createElement('section');
      section.className = 'v11-note-grid';

      detail.querySelector('.fields')?.after(section);
      const store = readStore();
      const noteField = detail.querySelector('[data-field="note"]');
      const storedRows = cleanRows(store[key] || []);
      const initialRows = storedRows.length ? storedRows : defaultRows([]);
      if (noteField?.value.trim()) initialRows[0].remark = noteField.value.trim();
      renderRows(section, initialRows, key, noteField);
      noteField?.addEventListener('input', () => {
        const firstRemark = section.querySelector('[data-v11-grid-row]:first-child [data-v11-grid-field="remark"]');
        if (firstRemark) firstRemark.value = noteField.value;
        queuePersist(key, section, noteField);
      });
      if (!section.dataset.v11SyncEvents) {
        section.dataset.v11SyncEvents = 'true';
        section.addEventListener('focusout', () => {
          clearTimeout(persistTimers.get(key));
          persistTimers.delete(key);
          void syncBridge(key, section, noteField);
        });
      }
      if (!storedRows.length) {
        void remoteRecord(key).then((record) => {
          if (!record?.noteGrid?.length || !section.isConnected || section.dataset.v11Key !== key || readStore()[key]?.length) return;
          renderRows(section, record.noteGrid, key, noteField);
          if (noteField && !noteField.value.trim() && record.note) {
            noteField.value = record.note;
          }
        });
      }
      ensureEditActions(detail);
      return;
    }
    if (section.dataset.v11Key !== key) { section.remove(); ensureGrid(detail); }
    ensureEditActions(detail);
  }

  function install() {
    const doc = frameDocument();
    if (!doc || doc.documentElement.dataset.v11NoteGridInstalled === 'true') return;
    doc.documentElement.dataset.v11NoteGridInstalled = 'true';
    const style = doc.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = `.v11-note-grid{margin-top:15px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #6b7c92;border-radius:13px;background:#3e4c60}.v11-grid-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:9px}.v11-grid-heading strong,.v11-grid-heading span,.v11-grid-sync-status{display:block}.v11-grid-heading strong{color:#e7eef5;font-size:14px}.v11-grid-heading span{margin-top:3px;color:#b8c8d9;font-size:10px}.v11-grid-sync-status{margin-top:4px;color:#c8d6e5;font-size:10px}.v11-grid-add{width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid #8092aa;border-radius:8px;color:#edf3fa;background:#4a5b70;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}.v11-grid-scroll{overflow:auto}.v11-note-grid table{width:100%;min-width:760px;border-collapse:collapse;background:#3e4c60}.v11-note-grid th,.v11-note-grid td{border:1px solid #6b7c92;padding:0}.v11-note-grid th{padding:8px 6px;color:#d8e4ef;background:#3a485d;font-size:12px}.v11-note-grid td input{width:100%;min-width:76px;padding:9px 7px;border:0;border-radius:0;color:#f2f5f9;background:transparent}.v11-note-grid td:nth-child(2) input,.v11-note-grid td:nth-child(7) input{min-width:145px}.v11-grid-delete{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:36px;border:0;color:#d1dceb;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.v11-grid-delete:hover{color:#ffbdc7;background:#522735}.v11-note-grid p{margin:9px 0 0;color:#b8c8d9;font-size:11px}@media(max-width:620px){.v11-note-grid{padding:10px}.v11-grid-scroll{margin-right:-3px}}`;
    doc.head.append(style);

    if (!detail) return;
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => ensureGrid(detail));
    observer.observe(detail, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    ensureGrid(detail);
  }

  iframe?.addEventListener('load', install);
  if (iframe?.contentDocument?.readyState === 'complete') install();
})();

      const intervals = byTime.slice(1).map((entry, index) => Math.abs(new Date(entry.transaction.occurredAt).getTime() - new Date(byTime[index].transaction.occurredAt).getTime()) / 86400000).filter(Number.isFinite);
      let income = 0; let expense = 0; let refunds = 0;
      group.entries.forEach(({ transaction }) => { const amount = Math.abs(Number(transaction.amountCents) || 0); if (transaction.type === 'INCOME') income += amount; else if (transaction.type === 'EXPENSE') expense += amount; else if (transaction.type === 'REFUND') refunds += amount; });
      const netExpense = Math.max(0, expense - refunds);
      const total = group.entries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + Math.abs(Number(entry.transaction.amountCents || 0)), 0);
      const averageDays = intervals.length ? intervals.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / intervals.length : null;
      return { ...group, total, income, expense: netExpense, refunds, balance: income - netExpense, averageDays, latest: byTime.at(-1)?.transaction.occurredAt || null, amounts: byTime.slice(-7).map((entry) => Math.abs(Number(entry.transaction.amountCents) || 0)) };
    }).sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
  }

  function merchantBarsHtml(group, className = 'sparkbars') {
    const max = Math.max(...group.amounts, 1);
    return `<div class="${className}" aria-label="${escapeAttr(group.name)} 金额走势">${group.amounts.map((amount, index) => `<div><span style="height:${Math.max(10, Math.round(amount / max * 100))}%"></span><small>${index + 1} · ${escapeHtml(money(amount))}</small></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  }

'尚不足两笔，暂不能计算周期' : `平均 ${group.averageDays.toFixed(group.averageDays < 10 ? 1 : 0)} 天出现一笔`}</p>${merchantBarsHtml(group, 'legacy-sparkbars')}</article>`).join('')}</div></section>`;

  function renderBills() {

    content.innerHTML = `<section class="panel table-panel"><div class="panel-inner panel-heading"><div><span class="eyebrow">ALL BILLS</span><h2>全部账单</h2><p>点击“明细备注”会打开对应的田字格卡片；发送/入账时间与账单实际时间分开显示。</p></div><button class="button subtle" type="button" data-action="go-merchants">按商家查看归纳</button></div><div class="table-toolbar"><input id="bill-search" placeholder="搜索商家、备注、商品名称…" /><select id="bill-kind"><option value="ALL">全部收支</option><option value="EXPENSE">支出</option><option value="INCOME">收入</option></select><button class="button subtle" type="button" id="reset-bill-filter">清除筛选</button></div><div id="bill-table-region"></div></section>`;

      const filtered = bills.filter(({ transaction }) => (kind === 'ALL' || transaction.type === kind) && (!query || `${transaction.merchant} ${transaction.note} ${transaction.description} ${(transaction.noteGrid || []).map((row) => Object.values(row).join(' ')).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(query)));

  function renderMerchants() {
    const groups = makeMerchantGroups();
    const incomeRanks = groups.filter((group) => group.income > 0).sort((a, b) => b.income - a.income || b.entries.length - a.entries.length).slice(0, 3);
    const expenseRanks = groups.filter((group) => group.expense > 0).sort((a, b) => b.expense - a.expense || b.entries.length - a.entries.length).slice(0, 3);
    const totalIncome = groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.income, 0);
    const totalExpense = groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.expense, 0);
    const rankCard = (group, rank, field, tone, label) => {
      if (!group) return `<article class="merchant-rank-card is-empty"><span class="rank-position">${rank}</span><span class="rank-label">${label}</span><h3>暂无商家</h3><strong class="rank-value ${tone}">—</strong><span class="rank-caption">后续入账后自动补位</span></article>`;
      return `<article class="merchant-rank-card" data-open-merchant="${escapeAttr(group.name)}" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="查看第 ${rank} 名${escapeAttr(group.name)}的具体账单"><div class="rank-card-heading"><span class="rank-position">${rank}</span><span class="rank-label">${label}</span></div><h3 title="${escapeAttr(group.name)}">${escapeHtml(group.name)}</h3><strong class="rank-value ${tone}">${escapeHtml(money(group[field]))}</strong><span class="rank-caption">点击查看 ${group.entries.length} 笔具体账单</span><div class="rank-breakdown"><span>收入 <b>${escapeHtml(money(group.income))}</b></span><span>支出 <b>${escapeHtml(money(group.expense))}</b></span><span>结余 <b>${escapeHtml(money(group.balance))}</b></span></div></article>`;
    };
    const rankSection = (title, ranks, field, tone, total) => `<section class="merchant-rank-section"><div class="merchant-rank-section-heading"><div><h3>${title}</h3><span>按全部已入账账单持续累计</span></div><strong class="rank-section-total ${tone}">总计 ${escapeHtml(money(total))}</strong></div><div class="merchant-rank-grid">${[0, 1, 2].map((index) => rankCard(ranks[index], index + 1, field, tone, title)).join('')}</div></section>`;
    const periodSummary = groups.length ? `<section class="merchant-period-summary"><div class="merchant-period-heading"><div><span class="eyebrow">ALL POSTED BILLS</span><h2>商家收支排名</h2><p>按全部已入账记录持续累计；退款抵减支出，内部转账不计入收入或支出。</p></div><div class="merchant-total-summary"><span>收入总额 <b class="income">${escapeHtml(money(totalIncome))}</b></span><span>支出总额 <b class="expense">${escapeHtml(money(totalExpense))}</b></span></div></div><div class="merchant-rank-sections">${rankSection('收入最多商家', incomeRanks, 'income', 'income', totalIncome)}${rankSection('支出最多商家', expenseRanks, 'expense', 'expense', totalExpense)}</div></section>` : '';
    content.innerHTML = `<section class="panel panel-inner"><div class="panel-heading"><div><span class="eyebrow">MERCHANT INTELLIGENCE</span><h2>商家归纳</h2><p>同一商家自动形成一个板块：总金额、订单频率与金额走势都会基于已入账账单计算。</p></div><span class="connection-state">${groups.length} 个商家</span></div>${periodSummary}${groups.length ? `<div class="merchant-grid">${groups.map((group) => { return `<article class="merchant-card"><div class="merchant-title"><div><h3>${escapeHtml(group.name)}</h3><span class="order-count">${group.entries.length} 笔已入账订单</span></div><button class="icon-button" type="button" data-open-merchant="${escapeAttr(group.name)}" aria-label="查看 ${escapeAttr(group.name)} 的订单">↗</button></div><button class="merchant-total" type="button" data-open-merchant="${escapeAttr(group.name)}">${escapeHtml(money(group.total))}</button><p class="interval">${group.averageDays === null ? '尚不足两笔，暂不能计算周期' : `平均 ${group.averageDays.toFixed(group.averageDays < 10 ? 1 : 0)} 天出现一笔`}</p><div class="merchant-breakdown"><span>收入 <b>${escapeHtml(money(group.income))}</b></span><span>支出 <b>${escapeHtml(money(group.expense))}</b></span><span>结余 <b>${escapeHtml(money(group.balance))}</b></span></div>${merchantBarsHtml(group)}<p class="analysis-note">金额图基于最近 ${group.amounts.length} 笔订单 · 最新 ${escapeHtml(formatTime(group.latest))}</p></article>`; }).join('')}</div>` : '<div class="empty"><strong>还没有已入账的商家记录</strong><p>确认第一笔手机凭证后，这里会自动按商家生成归纳板块。</p></div>'}</section>`;
    content.querySelectorAll('[data-open-merchant]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => openMerchant(button.dataset.openMerchant));
      if (button.getAttribute('role') === 'button') button.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') { event.preventDefault(); openMerchant(button.dataset.openMerchant); } });
