      const parsed = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE) || '{}');
      return { events: Array.isArray(parsed.events) ? parsed.events : [], content: Array.isArray(parsed.content) ? parsed.content : [], specialFavorites: Array.isArray(parsed.specialFavorites) ? parsed.specialFavorites : [], settings: { ...defaultSettings, ...(parsed.settings || {}) } };
    } catch { return { events: [], content: [], specialFavorites: [], settings: { ...defaultSettings } }; }
  }
  function saveState() { window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, JSON.stringify(state)); }
  function uid() { return window.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || `capture-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`; }
  function escapeHtml(value) { return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[character])); }
  function formatTime(value) { const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '时间未知' : date.toLocaleString('zh-CN', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }); }
  function relativeTime(value) { const diff = Date.now() - new Date(value).getTime(); if (diff < 60_000) return '刚刚'; if (diff < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60_000)} 分钟前`; if (diff < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3_600_000)} 小时前`; return formatTime(value); }
  function normalizeUrl(value) { const url = new URL(value); if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || !['x.com', 'www.x.com', 'twitter.com', 'www.twitter.com'].includes(url.hostname.toLowerCase())) throw new Error('只能保存 HTTPS X 链接。'); url.hash = ''; [...url.searchParams.keys()].forEach((key) => { if (key.toLowerCase().startsWith('utm_') || key === 's' || key === 't') url.searchParams.delete(key); }); return url.toString(); }
  function postId(value) { return /\/status\/(\d+)/u.exec(value)?.[1] || null; }
  function enabled(action) { const s = state.settings; if (!s.enabled) return false; if (action === 'like' || action === 'unlike') return s.captureLikes; if (action === 'bookmark' || action === 'unbookmark') return s.captureBookmarks; if (action === 'opened' || action === 'viewed') return s.captureViews; if (action === 'copied_link' || action === 'share_to_mezip' || action === 'manual_save') return s.captureSharedLinks; return true; }
  function localCapture(input) {
    const url = normalizeUrl(input.postUrl); if (!enabled(input.actionType)) return { event: null, disabled: true, deduplicated: false };
    const capturedAt = input.capturedAt || new Date().toISOString(); const bucket = Math.floor(new Date(capturedAt).getTime() / 30_000); const note = input.actionType === 'add_note' ? input.note || '' : '';
    const duplicate = state.events.find((event) => event.actionType === input.actionType && event.postUrl === url && Math.floor(new Date(event.capturedAt).getTime() / 30_000) === bucket && (input.actionType !== 'add_note' || (event.note || '') === note));
    if (duplicate) return { event: duplicate, disabled: false, deduplicated: true };
    const now = new Date().toISOString(); const event = { id: uid(), userId: 'browser-local', platform: 'X', actionType: input.actionType, postUrl: url, postId: input.postId || postId(url), authorHandle: input.authorHandle || null, pageTitle: state.settings.savePageMetadata ? input.pageTitle || null : null, capturedAt, source: input.source || 'LOCAL_CAPTURE', device: input.device || 'browser', browser: input.browser || (navigator.userAgent.includes('Edg/') ? 'Edge' : 'Browser'), note: input.note || null, tags: [...new Set((input.tags || []).map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean))], syncStatus: 'PENDING_ENRICHMENT', createdAt: now, updatedAt: now };
    state.events.unshift(event); if (state.settings.savePageMetadata) { const existing = state.content.find((item) => item.postUrl === url); const content = { id: existing?.id || uid(), userId: 'browser-local', postUrl: url, postId: event.postId, authorHandle: event.authorHandle, pageTitle: event.pageTitle, textExcerpt: existing?.textExcerpt || null, media: existing?.media || [], officialDataStatus: existing?.officialDataStatus || 'PENDING', officialUpdatedAt: existing?.officialUpdatedAt || null, createdAt: existing?.createdAt || now, updatedAt: now }; state.content = [content, ...state.content.filter((item) => item.postUrl !== url)]; } saveState(); return { event, disabled: false, deduplicated: false };
  }
  async function api(path, options = {}) { const response = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, { ...options, credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(options.headers || {}) } }); const payload = await response.json(); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload?.error?.message || '本地服务请求失败'); return payload.data; }
  async function capture(input) { try { const result = await api('/v1/x/local-capture/events', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(input) }); bridge.connected = true; bridge.checked = true; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result; } catch { bridge.connected = false; bridge.checked = true; return localCapture(input); } }
  async function hydrateFromBridge() { const [settings, stats, timeline, special] = await Promise.all([api('/v1/x/local-capture/settings'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/stats'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/timeline?limit=100'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/special-favorites')]); state.settings = { ...state.settings, ...settings }; state.events = timeline.events || []; state.content = timeline.content || []; state.specialFavorites = special.items || []; state.remoteStats = stats; saveState(); }
  async function probeBridge() { try { await api('/v1/x/local-capture/health'); await hydrateFromBridge(); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; } catch { bridge = { connected: false, checked: true }; } updateBridgeUi(); render(); }
  function counts(events) { const result = Object.fromEntries(ACTIONS.map((action) => [action, 0])); events.forEach((event) => { result[event.actionType] = (result[event.actionType] || 0) + 1; }); return result; }
  function eventIcon(action) { return LABELS[action]?.[0] || '•'; }
  function eventLabel(action) { return LABELS[action]?.[1] || action; }
  function contentFor(event) { return state.content.find((item) => item.postUrl === event.postUrl); }
  function specialFavoriteForUrl(url) { return state.specialFavorites.find((favorite) => favorite.postUrl === url); }
  function specialSourceFor(input) { return state.events.find((event) => event.postUrl === input.postUrl && (event.actionType === 'like' || event.actionType === 'bookmark') && (!input.sourceEventId || event.id === input.sourceEventId)); }
  function localAddSpecialFavorite(input) { const url = normalizeUrl(input.postUrl); const source = specialSourceFor({ ...input, postUrl: url }); if (!source) throw new Error('私人资料库只能添加已点赞或已收藏的 X 链接。'); const existing = specialFavoriteForUrl(url); if (existing) return { favorite: existing, deduplicated: true }; const now = new Date().toISOString(); const content = contentFor(source); const favorite = { id: uid(), userId: 'browser-local', postUrl: url, postId: input.postId || source.postId || content?.postId || postId(url), authorHandle: input.authorHandle || source.authorHandle || content?.authorHandle || null, pageTitle: input.pageTitle || source.pageTitle || content?.pageTitle || null, note: input.note ?? source.note ?? null, tags: [...new Set((input.tags || source.tags || []).map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean))], sourceEventId: source.id, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now }; state.specialFavorites.unshift(favorite); saveState(); return { favorite, deduplicated: false }; }
  function localRemoveSpecialFavorite(id) { const before = state.specialFavorites.length; state.specialFavorites = state.specialFavorites.filter((favorite) => favorite.id !== id); saveState(); return before !== state.specialFavorites.length; }
  async function saveSpecialFavorite(input) { try { const result = await api('/v1/x/local-capture/special-favorites', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(input) }); bridge.connected = true; bridge.checked = true; await hydrateFromBridge().catch(() => {}); return result; } catch { bridge.connected = false; bridge.checked = true; return localAddSpecialFavorite(input); } }
  async function removeSpecialFavorite(id) { try { const result = await api(`/v1/x/local-capture/special-favorites/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); bridge.connected = true; bridge.checked = true; await hydrateFromBridge().catch(() => {}); return result; } catch { bridge.connected = false; bridge.checked = true; return { deleted: localRemoveSpecialFavorite(id) }; } }
  function updateBridgeUi() { const text = bridge.connected ? '本地桥接已连接' : '浏览器本地模式'; const pill = document.querySelector('#bridge-status'); if (pill) { pill.textContent = text; pill.className = `pill ${bridge.connected ? 'pill-green' : 'pill-muted'}`; } const settingsPill = document.querySelector('#settings-bridge-pill'); if (settingsPill) { settingsPill.textContent = bridge.connected ? 'CONNECTED' : 'LOCAL ONLY'; settingsPill.className = `pill ${bridge.connected ? 'pill-green' : 'pill-muted'}`; } const copy = document.querySelector('#settings-bridge-copy'); if (copy) copy.textContent = bridge.connected ? '127.0.0.1:4319 · shared local owner' : '127.0.0.1:4319 不可用 · 当前浏览器私有存储'; }
  function render() { renderRoute(); renderMetrics(); renderWeek(); renderRecent(); renderTimeline(); renderSpecial(); renderInterest(); renderSettings(); updateBridgeUi(); }
  function renderRoute() { const route = (window.location.hash || '#overview').slice(1).split('?')[0]; document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach((view) => view.classList.toggle('hidden', view.dataset.view !== route)); document.querySelectorAll('[data-route]').forEach((link) => link.classList.toggle('active', link.dataset.route === route)); }
  function renderMetrics() { const c = counts(state.events); const items = [['今日点赞', state.events.filter((event) => event.actionType === 'like' && new Date(event.capturedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length, '本地事件'], ['今日收藏', state.events.filter((event) => event.actionType === 'bookmark' && new Date(event.capturedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length, '本地事件'], ['今日浏览', state.events.filter((event) => event.actionType === 'viewed' && new Date(event.capturedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length, '当前页面可见'], ['分享至 ME.zip', c.share_to_mezip + c.manual_save, '主动保存']]; document.querySelector('#metrics').innerHTML = items.map(([label, value, detail]) => `<article class="metric panel"><span>${label}</span><strong>${value || '0'}</strong><small>${detail}</small></article>`).join(''); const pending = state.events.filter((event) => event.syncStatus === 'PENDING_ENRICHMENT').length; const pendingEl = document.querySelector('#pending-count'); if (pendingEl) pendingEl.textContent = String(pending); const last = document.querySelector('#last-capture'); if (last) last.textContent = state.events[0] ? relativeTime(state.events[0].capturedAt) : '—'; const badge = document.querySelector('#official-badge'); if (badge) { const status = state.remoteStats?.officialApiStatus || 'UNKNOWN'; badge.textContent = status === 'CONNECTED' ? 'CONNECTED' : status === 'CREDITS_UNAVAILABLE' ? 'CREDITS UNAVAILABLE' : 'SEE X CENTER'; badge.className = `pill ${status === 'CONNECTED' ? 'pill-green' : 'pill-muted'}`; } }
  function renderWeek() { const chart = document.querySelector('#week-chart'); if (!chart) return; const days = []; for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i -= 1) { const date = new Date(); date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); date.setDate(date.getDate() - i); const key = date.toDateString(); const value = state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt).toDateString() === key).length; days.push({ label: `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`, value }); } const max = Math.max(1, ...days.map((day) => day.value)); chart.innerHTML = days.map((day) => `<div class="day-bar"><i style="height:${Math.max(3, day.value / max * 100)}%" title="${day.value} 条本地记录"></i><span>${day.value}</span><small>${day.label}</small></div>`).join(''); }
  function eventRow(event) { const content = contentFor(event); return `<div class="event-row"><span class="event-icon">${eventIcon(event.actionType)}</span><div class="event-main"><strong>${eventLabel(event.actionType)}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(event.authorHandle ? `@${event.authorHandle} · ` : '')}${escapeHtml(content?.pageTitle || event.pageTitle || event.postUrl)}</small></div><time class="event-time">${relativeTime(event.capturedAt)}</time></div>`; }
  function renderRecent() { const el = document.querySelector('#recent-events'); if (!el) return; const events = state.events.slice(0, 6); el.innerHTML = events.length ? events.map(eventRow).join('') : `<div class="empty"><strong>还没有本地记录</strong>打开 X 并明确点击操作，或先保存一条链接。</div>`; }
  function periodStart(period) { const now = new Date(); if (period === 'today') return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()); if (period === 'week') return new Date(now.getTime() - 6 * 86_400_000); if (period === 'month') return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1); if (period === 'year') return new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1); return null; }
  function interestEvents() { const viewed = new Set(state.events.filter((event) => event.actionType === 'viewed' || event.actionType === 'opened').map((event) => event.postUrl)); if (!interestMode) return state.events; if (interestMode === 'unvisited-bookmarks') return state.events.filter((event) => event.actionType === 'bookmark' && !viewed.has(event.postUrl)); if (interestMode === 'recent-month') return state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt) >= new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86_400_000)); if (interestMode === 'year-footprint') return state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt).getFullYear() === new Date().getFullYear()); if (interestMode.startsWith('tag:')) { const tag = interestMode.slice(4); return state.events.filter((event) => (event.tags || []).includes(tag)); } return state.events; }
  function filteredEvents() { const period = document.querySelector('#period-filter')?.value || 'all'; const query = (document.querySelector('#timeline-search')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim(); const from = periodStart(period); return interestEvents().filter((event) => { if (currentFilter !== 'all' && event.actionType !== currentFilter) return false; if (from && new Date(event.capturedAt) < from) return false; if (query && !`${event.postUrl} ${event.authorHandle || ''} ${event.pageTitle || ''} ${event.note || ''} ${(event.tags || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(query)) return false; return true; }); }
  function timelineCard(event) { const content = contentFor(event); const special = (event.actionType === 'like' || event.actionType === 'bookmark') ? specialFavoriteForUrl(event.postUrl) : null; const specialButton = (event.actionType === 'like' || event.actionType === 'bookmark') ? `<button class="button button-special special-toggle" data-url="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}" data-event-id="${escapeHtml(event.id)}" data-special-id="${escapeHtml(special?.id || '')}">${special ? '移出私人资料库' : '加入私人资料库'}</button>` : ''; return `<article class="timeline-card panel"><span class="event-icon">${eventIcon(event.actionType)}</span><div class="timeline-main"><strong>${eventLabel(event.actionType)}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(event.note || content?.pageTitle || event.pageTitle || '这条记录没有附加文字；原始链接仍然保留。')}</p><a href="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)} ↗</a><div class="timeline-meta">${(event.tags || []).map((tag) => `<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(tag)}</span>`).join('')}<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(event.syncStatus === 'ENRICHED' ? 'X API · 已补全' : event.source === 'SHARE_EXTENSION' ? 'SHARE EXTENSION' : 'LOCAL CAPTURE')}</span></div></div><div class="timeline-side"><time>${formatTime(event.capturedAt)}</time><span class="source-badge">${event.syncStatus === 'PENDING_ENRICHMENT' ? '待补全' : event.syncStatus}</span><div class="timeline-actions"><button class="button button-quiet copy-link" data-url="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}">复制链接</button>${specialButton}</div></div></article>`; }
  function renderTimeline() { const el = document.querySelector('#timeline-events'); if (!el) return; const events = filteredEvents(); el.innerHTML = events.length ? events.map(timelineCard).join('') : `<div class="empty panel"><strong>暂无符合条件的行为</strong>本地记录会从你启用 Capture 后开始累积，不会伪造过去的数据。</div>`; el.querySelectorAll('.copy-link').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', async () => { await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(button.dataset.url || ''); await capture({ actionType: 'copied_link', postUrl: button.dataset.url, source: 'LOCAL_CAPTURE' }); button.textContent = '已复制'; })); el.querySelectorAll('.special-toggle').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', async () => { button.disabled = true; try { if (button.dataset.specialId) await removeSpecialFavorite(button.dataset.specialId); else await saveSpecialFavorite({ postUrl: button.dataset.url, sourceEventId: button.dataset.eventId }); render(); } catch (error) { button.disabled = false; window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '私人资料库操作失败'); } })); }
  function specialCard(favorite, compact = false) { return `<article class="special-card panel${compact ? ' compact' : ''}"><div class="special-card-head"><span class="event-icon">★</span><time>${formatTime(favorite.createdAt)}</time></div><strong>${escapeHtml(favorite.pageTitle || favorite.authorHandle || '来自 X 的私人资料')}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(favorite.note || '你明确选择保留的链接。')}</p><a href="${escapeHtml(favorite.postUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">${escapeHtml(favorite.postUrl)} ↗</a><div class="special-card-foot"><span class="tag">私人资料库</span><button class="button button-quiet remove-special" data-special-id="${escapeHtml(favorite.id)}">移出</button></div></article>`; }
  function bindSpecialRemove(root) { root.querySelectorAll('.remove-special').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', async () => { button.disabled = true; await removeSpecialFavorite(button.dataset.specialId || ''); render(); })); }
  function renderSpecial() { const preview = document.querySelector('#special-preview'); if (preview) { const items = state.specialFavorites.slice(0, 3); preview.innerHTML = items.length ? items.map((favorite) => specialCard(favorite, true)).join('') : `<div class="empty"><strong>私人资料库还是空的</strong>在点赞或收藏记录旁点击「加入私人资料库」。</div>`; bindSpecialRemove(preview); } const full = document.querySelector('#special-favorites'); if (full) { full.innerHTML = state.specialFavorites.length ? state.specialFavorites.map((favorite) => specialCard(favorite)).join('') : `<div class="empty panel"><strong>还没有私人资料</strong>只有已点赞或已收藏的链接，经过你的再次选择后才会进入这里。</div>`; bindSpecialRemove(full); } }
  function renderInterest() { const tagCloud = document.querySelector('#tag-cloud'); const tagCounts = {}; state.events.forEach((event) => (event.tags || []).forEach((tag) => { tagCounts[tag] = (tagCounts[tag] || 0) + 1; })); const tags = Object.entries(tagCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]); if (tagCloud) tagCloud.innerHTML = tags.length ? tags.map(([tag, count]) => `<button type="button" class="tag tag-button" data-interest-mode="tag:${escapeHtml(tag)}">${escapeHtml(tag)} · ${count}</button>`).join('') : `<div class="empty" style="width:100%"><strong>还没有兴趣标签</strong>在保存链接时添加 AI、Coding、设计或你自己的分类。</div>`; const c = counts(state.events); const summary = document.querySelector('#interest-summary'); if (summary) summary.innerHTML = [['总记录', state.events.length, null], ['总点赞', c.like, 'like'], ['总收藏', c.bookmark, 'bookmark'], ['私人资料', state.specialFavorites.length, 'special'], ['总分享', c.share_to_mezip + c.manual_save, 'share_to_mezip'], ['带备注', state.events.filter((event) => event.note).length, 'notes']].map(([label, value, mode]) => mode ? `<button type="button" class="summary-row" data-interest-mode="${mode}"><span>${label}</span><strong>${value}</strong><small>点击查看</small></button>` : `<div class="summary-row summary-row-static"><span>${label}</span><strong>${value}</strong><small>累计</small></div>`).join(''); const insight = document.querySelector('#interest-insights'); if (!insight) return; const recentBookmarks = state.events.filter((event) => event.actionType === 'bookmark' && new Date(event.capturedAt) >= new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 86_400_000)); const topicCounts = {}; recentBookmarks.forEach((event) => (event.tags || []).forEach((tag) => { topicCounts[tag] = (topicCounts[tag] || 0) + 1; })); const topTopic = Object.entries(topicCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0]; const viewed = new Set(state.events.filter((event) => event.actionType === 'viewed' || event.actionType === 'opened').map((event) => event.postUrl)); const unvisited = state.events.filter((event) => event.actionType === 'bookmark' && !viewed.has(event.postUrl)).length; const recent = state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt) >= new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86_400_000)).length; const year = state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt).getFullYear() === new Date().getFullYear()).length; insight.innerHTML = `<button type="button" class="insight-card" data-interest-mode="${topTopic ? `tag:${escapeHtml(topTopic[0])}` : 'recent-month'}"><strong>本周收藏最多的主题</strong><span>${topTopic ? `${escapeHtml(topTopic[0])} · ${topTopic[1]} 条收藏` : '暂无带标签的本周收藏'}</span><small>点击查看对应记录</small></button><button type="button" class="insight-card" data-interest-mode="unvisited-bookmarks"><strong>收藏但一直未重访</strong><span>${unvisited} 条收藏</span><small>按链接筛出未浏览记录</small></button><button type="button" class="insight-card" data-interest-mode="recent-month"><strong>最近 30 天兴趣变化</strong><span>${recent} 条本地事件</span><small>按时间查看真实记录</small></button><button type="button" class="insight-card" data-interest-mode="year-footprint"><strong>年度互联网足迹</strong><span>${year} 条本年度事件</span><small>从启用当天开始累计</small></button>`; }
  function renderSettings() { const s = state.settings; ['enabled', 'captureLikes', 'captureBookmarks', 'captureViews', 'captureSharedLinks', 'savePageMetadata'].forEach((key) => { const input = document.querySelector(`#setting-${key}`); if (input) input.checked = s[key] !== false; }); }
  function openCaptureDialog() { const dialog = document.querySelector('#capture-dialog'); if (typeof dialog.showModal === 'function') dialog.showModal(); else dialog.setAttribute('open', ''); }
  async function submitCapture(event) { event.preventDefault(); const error = document.querySelector('#capture-error'); error.textContent = ''; try { const result = await capture({ actionType: document.querySelector('#capture-action').value, postUrl: document.querySelector('#capture-url').value.trim(), authorHandle: document.querySelector('#capture-author').value.trim() || null, pageTitle: document.querySelector('#capture-title').value.trim() || null, note: document.querySelector('#capture-note').value.trim() || null, tags: document.querySelector('#capture-tags').value.split(',').map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean), source: 'MANUAL_IMPORT' }); if (result.disabled) throw new Error('当前设置已关闭这类记录。'); document.querySelector('#capture-dialog').close(); event.target.reset(); render(); } catch (caught) { error.textContent = caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : '保存失败'; } }
  function downloadExport() { const payload = { exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(), mode: 'LOCAL_CAPTURE', events: state.events, content: state.content, specialFavorites: state.specialFavorites, settings: state.settings }; const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); link.download = `mezip-x-local-capture-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`; link.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href); }
  async function pasteCaptureUrl() { const error = document.querySelector('#capture-error'); try { const value = await navigator.clipboard.readText(); if (!value.trim()) throw new Error('剪贴板没有可用链接。'); document.querySelector('#capture-url').value = value.trim(); error.textContent = ''; } catch { error.textContent = '无法读取剪贴板，请手动粘贴 X 链接。'; } }

  function uid() { return window.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || `capture-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`; }
  function escapeHtml(value) { return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[character])); }
  function formatTime(value) { const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '时间未知' : date.toLocaleString('zh-CN', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }); }
  function relativeTime(value) { const diff = Date.now() - new Date(value).getTime(); if (diff < 60_000) return '刚刚'; if (diff < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60_000)} 分钟前`; if (diff < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3_600_000)} 小时前`; return formatTime(value); }
  function normalizeUrl(value) { const url = new URL(value); if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || !['x.com', 'www.x.com', 'twitter.com', 'www.twitter.com'].includes(url.hostname.toLowerCase())) throw new Error('只能保存 HTTPS X 链接。'); url.hash = ''; [...url.searchParams.keys()].forEach((key) => { if (key.toLowerCase().startsWith('utm_') || key === 's' || key === 't') url.searchParams.delete(key); }); return url.toString(); }
  function postId(value) { return /\/status\/(\d+)/u.exec(value)?.[1] || null; }
  function sourceKey(value, id) { return id || postId(value) || value; }
  function enabled(action) { const s = state.settings; if (!s.enabled) return false; if (action === 'like' || action === 'unlike') return s.captureLikes; if (action === 'bookmark' || action === 'unbookmark') return s.captureBookmarks; if (action === 'opened' || action === 'viewed') return s.captureViews; if (action === 'copied_link' || action === 'share_to_mezip' || action === 'manual_save') return s.captureSharedLinks; return true; }
  function savedLinkFromEvent(event) { return { id: event.id, sourceEventId: event.id, url: event.postUrl, purpose: event.note || '', title: event.pageTitle || '', tags: [...(event.tags || [])], createdAt: Date.parse(event.createdAt || event.capturedAt) || Date.now() }; }
  function mergeSavedLink(link) { const key = linkKey(link); if (deletedSavedLinks.includes(key)) return null; const index = state.savedLinks.findIndex((item) => linkKey(item) === key); if (index >= 0) { state.savedLinks[index] = { ...state.savedLinks[index], ...link, tags: [...new Set([...(state.savedLinks[index].tags || []), ...(link.tags || [])])] }; return state.savedLinks[index]; } state.savedLinks.unshift({ ...link, tags: [...new Set(link.tags || [])] }); return link; }
  function syncSavedLinksFromEvents() { state.events.filter((event) => event.actionType === 'copied_link' || event.actionType === 'manual_save').forEach((event) => mergeSavedLink(savedLinkFromEvent(event))); writeSavedLinks(); }
  function savedLinkSource(item) { const event = state.events.find((entry) => (item.sourceEventId && entry.id === item.sourceEventId) || (entry.postUrl === item.url && (entry.actionType === 'copied_link' || entry.actionType === 'manual_save'))); if (event) return event; return { id: item.sourceEventId || item.id, userId: 'browser-local', platform: 'X', actionType: 'copied_link', postUrl: item.url, postId: postId(item.url), authorHandle: null, pageTitle: item.title || null, capturedAt: new Date(item.createdAt || Date.now()).toISOString(), source: 'MANUAL_IMPORT', device: 'browser', browser: 'Browser', note: item.purpose || null, tags: item.tags || [], syncStatus: 'LOCAL_ONLY', createdAt: new Date(item.createdAt || Date.now()).toISOString(), updatedAt: new Date(item.createdAt || Date.now()).toISOString() }; }
  function localCapture(input) { const url = normalizeUrl(input.postUrl); if (!enabled(input.actionType)) return { event: null, disabled: true, deduplicated: false }; const capturedAt = input.capturedAt || new Date().toISOString(); const bucket = Math.floor(new Date(capturedAt).getTime() / 30_000); const duplicate = state.events.find((event) => event.actionType === input.actionType && event.postUrl === url && Math.floor(new Date(event.capturedAt).getTime() / 30_000) === bucket); if (duplicate) return { event: duplicate, disabled: false, deduplicated: true }; const now = new Date().toISOString(); const event = { id: uid(), userId: 'browser-local', platform: 'X', actionType: input.actionType, postUrl: url, postId: input.postId || postId(url), authorHandle: input.authorHandle || null, pageTitle: state.settings.savePageMetadata ? input.pageTitle || null : null, capturedAt, source: input.source || 'LOCAL_CAPTURE', device: input.device || 'browser', browser: input.browser || (navigator.userAgent.includes('Edg/') ? 'Edge' : 'Browser'), note: input.note || null, tags: [...new Set((input.tags || []).map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean))], syncStatus: 'PENDING_ENRICHMENT', createdAt: now, updatedAt: now }; state.events.unshift(event); if (event.actionType === 'copied_link' || event.actionType === 'manual_save') { deletedSavedLinks = deletedSavedLinks.filter((key) => key !== linkKey(savedLinkFromEvent(event))); mergeSavedLink(savedLinkFromEvent(event)); } saveState(); return { event, disabled: false, deduplicated: false }; }
  async function api(path, options = {}) { const response = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, { ...options, credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(options.headers || {}) } }); const payload = await response.json(); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload?.error?.message || '本地服务请求失败'); return payload.data; }
  async function hydrateFromBridge() { const [settings, stats, timeline, library, collections] = await Promise.all([api('/v1/x/local-capture/settings'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/stats'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/timeline?limit=100'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/collections')]); state.settings = { ...state.settings, ...settings }; state.events = timeline.events || []; state.content = timeline.content || []; state.privateLibrary = library.items || []; privateCollections = Array.isArray(collections?.items) ? collections.items : []; writeCollections(privateCollections); state.remoteStats = stats; state.watchItems = await api('/v1/watch/records?limit=100').then((result) => Array.isArray(result?.items) ? result.items : []).catch(() => []); syncSavedLinksFromEvents(); saveState(); }
  async function syncSavedLinksToBridge() { let synced = false; for (const item of state.savedLinks) { const exists = state.events.some((event) => (event.actionType === 'copied_link' || event.actionType === 'manual_save') && event.postUrl === item.url && (event.note || '') === (item.purpose || '') && (event.pageTitle || '') === (item.title || '')); if (exists) continue; try { await api('/v1/x/local-capture/events', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ actionType: 'copied_link', postUrl: item.url, pageTitle: item.title || null, note: item.purpose || null, tags: item.tags || [], source: 'MANUAL_IMPORT' }) }); synced = true; } catch { /* keep the shared browser record if the bridge is unavailable */ } } if (synced) await hydrateFromBridge(); }
  async function probeBridge() { try { await api('/v1/x/local-capture/health'); await hydrateFromBridge(); await syncSavedLinksToBridge(); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; } catch { bridge = { connected: false, checked: true }; } updateBridgeUi(); render(); }
  async function capture(input) { try { const result = await api('/v1/x/local-capture/events', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(input) }); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result; } catch { bridge = { connected: false, checked: true }; return localCapture(input); } }
  function contentFor(event) { return state.content.find((item) => item.postUrl === event.postUrl); }
  function libraryForUrl(url) { return state.privateLibrary.find((item) => item.sourceUrl === url); }
  function localAddLibrary(input) { const url = normalizeUrl(input.postUrl); const source = state.events.find((event) => event.postUrl === url && (event.actionType === 'like' || event.actionType === 'bookmark' || event.actionType === 'copied_link' || event.actionType === 'manual_save') && (!input.sourceEventId || event.id === input.sourceEventId)) || state.savedLinks.map(savedLinkSource).find((event) => event.postUrl === url && (!input.sourceEventId || event.id === input.sourceEventId)); if (!source) throw new Error('私人资料库只能添加已点赞、已收藏或已保存的 X 链接。'); const key = sourceKey(url, input.postId || source.postId); const existing = state.privateLibrary.find((item) => item.sourceId === key || item.sourceUrl === url); if (existing) return { item: existing, deduplicated: true }; const content = contentFor(source); const now = new Date().toISOString(); const item = { id: uid(), ownerId: 'browser-local', userId: 'browser-local', sourceType: 'X_POST', sourcePlatform: 'X', sourceId: key, sourceUrl: url, title: input.pageTitle || source.pageTitle || content?.pageTitle || null, content: content?.textExcerpt || null, authorName: null, authorHandle: input.authorHandle || source.authorHandle || content?.authorHandle || null, authorAvatar: null, media: content?.media || [], thumbnail: null, publishedAt: null, savedAt: now, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, tags: [...new Set((input.tags || source.tags || []).map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean))], note: input.note ?? source.note ?? null, collectionId: input.collectionId || null, privacy: 'PRIVATE', metadata: { sourceEventId: source.id, sourceAction: source.actionType } }; state.privateLibrary.unshift(item); saveState(); return { item, deduplicated: false }; }
  async function addLibrary(input) { try { const result = await api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(input) }); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result; } catch { bridge = { connected: false, checked: true }; return localAddLibrary(input); } }
  async function addLibraryBatch(inputs) { try { const result = await api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/batch', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ items: inputs }) }); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result.items; } catch { return inputs.map((input) => localAddLibrary(input)); } }
  function localRemoveLibrary(id) { const before = state.privateLibrary.length; state.privateLibrary = state.privateLibrary.filter((item) => item.id !== id); saveState(); return before !== state.privateLibrary.length; }
  async function removeLibrary(id) { try { const result = await api(`/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result; } catch { bridge = { connected: false, checked: true }; return { deleted: localRemoveLibrary(id) }; } }
  async function patchLibrary(id, patch) { try { const result = await api(`/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify(patch) }); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result; } catch { const index = state.privateLibrary.findIndex((item) => item.id === id); if (index < 0) throw new Error('私人资料不存在。'); state.privateLibrary[index] = { ...state.privateLibrary[index], ...patch, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }; saveState(); return state.privateLibrary[index]; } }
  function updateBridgeUi() { const pill = document.querySelector('#bridge-status'); if (pill) { pill.textContent = bridge.connected ? '本地桥接已连接' : '浏览器本地模式'; pill.className = `pill ${bridge.connected ? 'pill-green' : 'pill-muted'}`; } const settingsPill = document.querySelector('#settings-bridge-pill'); if (settingsPill) { settingsPill.textContent = bridge.connected ? 'CONNECTED' : 'LOCAL ONLY'; settingsPill.className = `pill ${bridge.connected ? 'pill-green' : 'pill-muted'}`; } }
  function runGlobalSearch(value) { const query = String(value || '').trim(); if (!query) return; const needle = query.toLowerCase(); const includes = (item) => `${item.sourceUrl || item.url || item.postUrl || ''} ${item.title || item.pageTitle || ''} ${item.content || item.note || item.purpose || ''} ${item.authorHandle || item.creator || ''} ${(item.tags || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(needle); if (state.watchItems.some(includes)) { window.location.href = `./watch.html?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`; return; } if (state.privateLibrary.some(includes)) { librarySearch = query; window.location.hash = '#special'; renderLibrary(); return; } currentFilter = 'all'; interestMode = null; const timelineSearch = document.querySelector('#timeline-search'); if (timelineSearch) timelineSearch.value = query; window.location.hash = '#timeline'; renderTimeline(); }
  function counts(events) { const result = Object.fromEntries(ACTIONS.map((action) => [action, 0])); events.forEach((event) => { result[event.actionType] = (result[event.actionType] || 0) + 1; }); return result; }
  function eventIcon(action) { return LABELS[action]?.[0] || '•'; } function eventLabel(action) { return LABELS[action]?.[1] || action; }
  function render() { renderRoute(); renderMetrics(); renderWeek(); renderRecent(); renderTimeline(); renderLibrary(); renderSavedLinks(); renderInterestWithSavedLinks(); renderSettings(); updateBridgeUi(); }
  function renderRoute() { const route = (window.location.hash || '#overview').slice(1).split('?')[0]; document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach((view) => view.classList.toggle('hidden', view.dataset.view !== route)); document.querySelectorAll('[data-route]').forEach((link) => link.classList.toggle('active', link.dataset.route === route)); }
  function renderMetrics() { const c = counts(state.events); const items = [['今日点赞', state.events.filter((e) => e.actionType === 'like' && new Date(e.capturedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length, '本地事件'], ['今日收藏', state.events.filter((e) => e.actionType === 'bookmark' && new Date(e.capturedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length, '本地事件'], ['今日浏览', state.events.filter((e) => e.actionType === 'viewed' && new Date(e.capturedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length, '当前页面可见'], ['私人资料', state.privateLibrary.length, '再次确认保留']]; const el = document.querySelector('#metrics'); if (el) el.innerHTML = items.map(([label, value, detail]) => `<article class="metric panel"><span>${label}</span><strong>${value || '0'}</strong><small>${detail}</small></article>`).join(''); const pending = document.querySelector('#pending-count'); if (pending) pending.textContent = String(state.events.filter((event) => event.syncStatus === 'PENDING_ENRICHMENT').length); const last = document.querySelector('#last-capture'); if (last) last.textContent = state.events[0] ? relativeTime(state.events[0].capturedAt) : '—'; const badge = document.querySelector('#official-badge'); if (badge) badge.textContent = state.remoteStats?.officialApiStatus || 'SEE X CENTER'; }
  function renderWeek() { const chart = document.querySelector('#week-chart'); if (!chart) return; const days = []; for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i -= 1) { const date = new Date(); date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); date.setDate(date.getDate() - i); const value = state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt).toDateString() === date.toDateString()).length; days.push({ label: `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`, value }); } const max = Math.max(1, ...days.map((day) => day.value)); chart.innerHTML = days.map((day) => `<div class="day-bar"><i style="height:${Math.max(3, day.value / max * 100)}%" title="${day.value} 条本地记录"></i><span>${day.value}</span><small>${day.label}</small></div>`).join(''); }
  function eventRow(event) { const content = contentFor(event); return `<div class="event-row"><span class="event-icon">${eventIcon(event.actionType)}</span><div class="event-main"><strong>${eventLabel(event.actionType)}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(event.authorHandle ? `@${event.authorHandle} · ` : '')}${escapeHtml(content?.pageTitle || event.pageTitle || event.postUrl)}</small></div><time class="event-time">${relativeTime(event.capturedAt)}</time></div>`; }
  function renderRecent() { const el = document.querySelector('#recent-events'); if (el) el.innerHTML = state.events.length ? state.events.slice(0, 6).map(eventRow).join('') : `<div class="empty"><strong>还没有本地记录</strong>打开 X 并明确点击操作，或先保存一条链接。</div>`; }
  function periodStart(period) { const now = new Date(); if (period === 'today') return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()); if (period === 'week') return new Date(now.getTime() - 6 * 86_400_000); if (period === 'month') return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1); if (period === 'year') return new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1); return null; }
  function filteredEvents() { const period = document.querySelector('#period-filter')?.value || 'all'; const query = (document.querySelector('#timeline-search')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim(); const from = periodStart(period); return state.events.filter((event) => { if (currentFilter !== 'all' && event.actionType !== currentFilter) return false; if (from && new Date(event.capturedAt) < from) return false; if (query && !`${event.postUrl} ${event.authorHandle || ''} ${event.pageTitle || ''} ${event.note || ''} ${(event.tags || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(query)) return false; if (interestMode === 'unvisited-bookmarks' && event.actionType !== 'bookmark') return false; if (interestMode?.startsWith('tag:') && !(event.tags || []).includes(interestMode.slice(4))) return false; return true; }); }
  function timelineCard(event) { const eligible = event.actionType === 'like' || event.actionType === 'bookmark' || event.actionType === 'copied_link' || event.actionType === 'manual_save'; const library = eligible ? libraryForUrl(event.postUrl) : null; const content = contentFor(event); const action = eligible ? `<label class="library-select-wrap"><input class="library-select" type="checkbox" data-url="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}" data-event-id="${escapeHtml(event.id)}" ${library ? 'checked disabled' : ''} aria-label="选择加入私人资料库"></label><button class="button button-special special-toggle" data-url="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}" data-event-id="${escapeHtml(event.id)}" data-library-id="${escapeHtml(library?.id || '')}">${library ? '✓ 已加入私人资料库' : '再次收藏到私人资料库'}</button>` : ''; return `<article class="timeline-card panel"><span class="event-icon">${eventIcon(event.actionType)}</span><div class="timeline-main"><strong>${eventLabel(event.actionType)}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(event.note || content?.textExcerpt || content?.pageTitle || event.pageTitle || '这条记录没有附加文字；原始链接仍然保留。')}</p><a href="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)} ↗</a><div class="timeline-meta">${(event.tags || []).map((tag) => `<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(tag)}</span>`).join('')}<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(event.source === 'SHARE_EXTENSION' ? 'SHARE EXTENSION' : 'LOCAL CAPTURE')}</span></div></div><div class="timeline-side"><time>${formatTime(event.capturedAt)}</time><span class="source-badge">${event.syncStatus === 'PENDING_ENRICHMENT' ? '待补全' : event.syncStatus}</span><div class="timeline-actions"><button class="button button-quiet copy-link" data-url="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}">复制链接</button>${action}</div></div></article>`; }
  function renderTimeline() { const el = document.querySelector('#timeline-events'); if (!el) return; const events = filteredEvents(); el.innerHTML = `<div class="library-batch-bar panel"><span>已选择 <strong id="library-selected-count">0</strong> 条</span><button class="button button-primary" id="batch-library" disabled>批量加入私人资料库</button></div>${events.length ? events.map(timelineCard).join('') : `<div class="empty panel"><strong>暂无符合条件的行为</strong>本地记录会从你启用 Capture 后开始累积，不会伪造过去的数据。</div>`}`; el.querySelectorAll('.copy-link').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', async () => { await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(button.dataset.url || ''); await capture({ actionType: 'copied_link', postUrl: button.dataset.url, source: 'LOCAL_CAPTURE' }); button.textContent = '已复制'; })); el.querySelectorAll('.special-toggle').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', async () => { button.disabled = true; try { if (button.dataset.libraryId) await removeLibrary(button.dataset.libraryId); else await addLibrary({ postUrl: button.dataset.url, sourceEventId: button.dataset.eventId }); render(); } catch (error) { button.disabled = false; window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '私人资料库操作失败'); } })); const updateCount = () => { const count = el.querySelectorAll('.library-select:checked:not(:disabled)').length; el.querySelector('#library-selected-count').textContent = String(count); el.querySelector('#batch-library').disabled = count === 0; }; el.querySelectorAll('.library-select').forEach((input) => input.addEventListener('change', updateCount)); el.querySelector('#batch-library').addEventListener('click', async () => { const inputs = [...el.querySelectorAll('.library-select:checked:not(:disabled)')].map((input) => ({ postUrl: input.dataset.url, sourceEventId: input.dataset.eventId })); await addLibraryBatch(inputs); render(); }); updateCount(); }
  function libraryCategory(item) { const type = String(item.sourceType || '').toUpperCase(); const platform = String(item.sourcePlatform || '').toUpperCase(); const text = `${JSON.stringify(item.media || [])} ${item.title || ''} ${item.content || ''} ${item.note || ''} ${(item.tags || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase(); const url = String(item.sourceUrl || '').toLowerCase(); if (platform === 'X' || type === 'X_POST') return 'x'; if (type === 'MOVIE' || type === 'EPISODE' || (platform === 'WATCH' && /电影|movie|film/.test(text))) return 'movie'; if (type === 'VIDEO' || type === 'WATCH_ITEM' || platform === 'WATCH' || platform === 'YOUTUBE' || platform === 'BILIBILI' || /video|\.mp4|\.webm|\.mov/.test(text)) return 'video'; if (type === 'ARTICLE' || /article|文章|长文/.test(text)) return 'article'; if (type === 'IMAGE' || /image|图片|\.png|\.jpe?g|\.gif|\.webp/.test(text)) return 'image'; if (type === 'CODE' || /github|代码|snippet|sql|python|typescript|javascript/.test(`${url} ${text}`)) return 'code'; if (type === 'WEBPAGE' || type === 'WEB' || /^https?:/.test(url)) return 'web'; return 'other'; }
  function libraryKind(item) { const category = libraryCategory(item); if (category === 'movie' || category === 'video') return 'video'; if (category === 'image') return 'image'; return 'text'; }
  function libraryCategoryLabel(category) { return ({ all: '全部', x: 'X', movie: '电影', video: '视频', web: '网页', article: '文章', image: '图片', code: '代码', other: '其他' })[category] || '其他'; }
  function libraryCard(item, compact = false) { const category = libraryCategory(item); const sourceLabel = item.sourcePlatform === 'WATCH' ? `观看记录 / ${libraryCategoryLabel(category)}` : libraryCategoryLabel(category); const folder = collectionName(item.collectionId); return `<article class="special-card panel${compact ? ' compact' : ''}"><div class="special-card-head"><span class="event-icon">★</span><time>加入于 ${formatTime(item.savedAt)}</time></div><strong>${escapeHtml(item.title || item.authorHandle || `来自 ${sourceLabel} 的私人资料`)}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(item.content || item.note || '你明确选择保留的资料。')}</p>${item.authorHandle ? `<small>@${escapeHtml(item.authorHandle)}</small>` : ''}<a href="${escapeHtml(item.sourceUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">打开原始链接 ↗</a><div class="special-card-foot"><span class="tag">${sourceLabel} · 私人</span>${folder ? `<span class="tag">📁 ${escapeHtml(folder)}</span>` : ''}${(item.tags || []).map((tag) => `<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(tag)}</span>`).join('')}<button class="button button-quiet edit-library" data-library-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">标签 / 主要作用</button><button class="button button-quiet edit-collection" data-library-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">资料夹</button><button class="button button-quiet remove-library" data-library-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">移出</button></div></article>`; }
  function filteredLibrary() { const query = librarySearch.toLowerCase().trim(); return state.privateLibrary.filter((item) => { if (libraryFilter !== 'all' && libraryCategory(item) !== libraryFilter) return false; return !query || `${item.sourceUrl} ${item.title || ''} ${item.content || ''} ${item.authorHandle || ''} ${item.note || ''} ${(item.tags || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(query); }); }
  function editLibrary(item) { const note = window.prompt('主要作用（仅本地保存）', item.note || ''); if (note === null) return; const tags = window.prompt('标签（用逗号分隔）', (item.tags || []).join(', ')); if (tags === null) return; void patchLibrary(item.id, { note: note.trim() || null, tags: tags.split(',').map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean) }).then(render); }
  async function editCollection(item) { const collections = privateCollections; const names = collections.map((entry) => entry.name).join('、'); const answer = window.prompt(`资料夹名称（留空取消；输入“新建”创建）${names ? `\n已有：${names}` : ''}`, collectionName(item.collectionId)); if (answer === null) return; if (answer.trim() === '新建') { const created = await createCollection(); if (!created) return; await patchLibrary(item.id, { collectionId: created.id }); } else if (!answer.trim()) { await patchLibrary(item.id, { collectionId: null }); } else { const target = collections.find((entry) => entry.name.toLowerCase() === answer.trim().toLowerCase()) || createCollectionLocal(answer.trim()); await patchLibrary(item.id, { collectionId: target.id }); } render(); }

return update(button.dataset.id || '', { liked: !item?.liked }); }))); $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-bookmark').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void bindAction(button, () => { const item = state.items.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.id); return update(button.dataset.id || '', { bookmarked: !item?.bookmarked }); }))); $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-copy').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void bindAction(button, async () => { const item = state.items.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.id); await navigator.clipboard.writeText(item?.url || ''); button.textContent = '已复制链接'; }))); $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-private').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void bindAction(button, async () => { const item = state.items.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.id); if (!item) return; try { await api(`/v1/resources/records/${encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.id || '')}/private-library`, { method: 'POST' }); } catch { const now = new Date().toISOString(); state.library = [...state.library, { id: uid(), ownerId: 'browser-local', userId: 'browser-local', sourceType: item.resourceType, sourcePlatform: 'OTHER', sourceId: item.id, sourceUrl: item.url, title: item.title, content: item.description, authorName: item.author, authorHandle: null, authorAvatar: null, media: [], thumbnail: null, publishedAt: null, savedAt: now, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, tags: item.tags || [], note: item.note || null, collectionId: null, privacy: 'PRIVATE', metadata: { resourceRecordId: item.id, resourceType: item.resourceType, platform: item.platform, status: item.status, progressPercent: item.currentProgressPercent } }]; writeLocalLibrary(); } await load(); }))); $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-delete').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void bindAction(button, async () => { if (!window.confirm('删除这条资源记录？私人资料库中的独立资料不会被删除。')) return; try { await api(`/v1/resources/records/${encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.id || '')}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); } catch { state.items = state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== button.dataset.id); writeLocal(); state.localOnly = true; } state.items = state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== button.dataset.id); render(); }))); }
  async function load() { state.loading = true; state.error = null; render(); try { const [records, library] = await Promise.all([api('/v1/resources/records'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library')]); state.items = Array.isArray(records?.items) ? records.items.map(normalize) : []; state.library = Array.isArray(library?.items) ? library.items : []; state.localOnly = false; } catch (error) { state.items = readLocal(); state.library = readLocalLibrary(); state.localOnly = true; state.error = state.items.length ? null : (error instanceof Error ? error.message : '本地桥接不可用'); } finally { state.loading = false; render(); } }
  $('#resource-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const message = $('#resource-form-message'); message.textContent = '正在保存…'; const input = { resourceType: $('#resource-type').value, title: $('#resource-title').value.trim(), platform: $('#resource-platform').value.trim() || undefined, author: $('#resource-author').value.trim() || null, url: $('#resource-url').value.trim(), description: $('#resource-description').value.trim() || null, currentProgressPercent: Number($('#resource-progress').value || 0), tags: $('#resource-tags').value.split(',').map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean) }; try { const result = await api('/v1/resources/records', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(input) }); state.items = [...state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== result.record.id), normalize(result.record)]; state.localOnly = false; } catch { const existing = state.items.find((item) => item.resourceType === input.resourceType && item.url === input.url); const record = normalize({ ...(existing || {}), ...input }); state.items = [record, ...state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== record.id)]; writeLocal(); state.localOnly = true; } event.target.reset(); $('#resource-progress').value = '0'; message.textContent = state.localOnly ? '已保存到浏览器本地资源记录。' : '已保存到本机资源记录。'; render(); });
  $('#resource-filters').addEventListener('click', (event) => { const button = event.target.closest('[data-filter]'); if (!button) return; state.filter = button.dataset.filter || 'all'; $('#resource-filters').querySelectorAll('button').forEach((item) => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button)); render(); });
  $('#resource-search').addEventListener('input', (event) => { state.query = event.target.value || ''; render(); });
  $('#resource-retry').addEventListener('click', () => void load());
  void load();
})();

===== FILE: standalone/mezip-local/apps/web/public/x-local-capture-v4/watch-app.js =====
(() => {
  const API = window.localStorage.getItem('mezip.x.local.capture.api') || 'http://127.0.0.1:4319';
  const state = { items: [], library: [], filter: 'recent', query: new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('q') || '', loading: true, error: null };
  const $ = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector);
  const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[character]));
  const formatTime = (seconds) => { const value = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(seconds) || 0)); const h = Math.floor(value / 3600); const m = Math.floor((value % 3600) / 60); const s = value % 60; return h ? `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}` : `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`; };
  const formatDate = (value) => { const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '时间未知' : date.toLocaleString('zh-CN', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }); };
  async function api(path, options = {}) { const response = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, { credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(options.headers || {}) }, ...options }); const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload?.error?.message || `本地服务错误（${response.status}）`); return payload.data; }
  function isPrivate(item) { return state.library.some((entry) => entry.sourcePlatform === 'WATCH' && (entry.sourceId === item.contentKey || entry.metadata?.contentKey === item.contentKey)); }
  function filteredItems() { const query = state.query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase(); return state.items.filter((item) => { if (state.filter === 'continue' && item.status === 'COMPLETED') return false; if (state.filter === 'completed' && item.status !== 'COMPLETED') return false; if (state.filter === 'movie' && !['MOVIE', 'EPISODE'].includes(item.contentType)) return false; if (state.filter === 'video' && ['MOVIE', 'EPISODE'].includes(item.contentType)) return false; return !query || `${item.title} ${item.subtitle || ''} ${item.creator || ''} ${item.platform} ${item.domain} ${item.url}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query); }); }
  function empty(text, detail = '') { return `<div class="empty panel"><strong>${escapeHtml(text)}</strong>${detail ? `<span>${escapeHtml(detail)}</span>` : ''}</div>`; }
  function resumeUrl(item) {
    const raw = String(item.url || '');
    const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(item.currentTimeSeconds) || 0));
    if (!raw || item.status === 'COMPLETED' || seconds <= 0) return raw;
    try {
      const url = new URL(raw);
      if (/youtube\.com$|youtu\.be$/iu.test(url.hostname)) url.searchParams.set('t', `${seconds}s`);
      else if (/bilibili\.com$|b23\.tv$/iu.test(url.hostname)) url.searchParams.set('t', String(seconds));
      else url.hash = `t=${seconds}`;
      return url.toString();
    } catch { return raw; }
  }
  function card(item) { const percent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Number(item.progressPercent) || 0)); const image = item.poster || item.thumbnail; const privateState = isPrivate(item); const primary = item.status === 'COMPLETED' ? '重新打开' : '继续观看'; return `<article class="watch-card panel"><div class="watch-poster${image ? '' : ' placeholder'}">${image ? `<img class="watch-poster" src="${escapeHtml(image)}" alt="${escapeHtml(item.title)}">` : '▶'}</div><div class="watch-main"><h3>${escapeHtml(item.title)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(item.subtitle || '真实播放记录')} · ${escapeHtml(item.platform)} · ${escapeHtml(item.domain)}</p><div class="watch-meta"><span class="tag">${item.contentType === 'MOVIE' || item.contentType === 'EPISODE' ? '电影' : '视频'}</span>${item.creator ? `<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(item.creator)}</span>` : ''}<span class="tag">${item.status === 'COMPLETED' ? '已看完' : item.status === 'IN_PROGRESS' ? '继续观看' : '已开始'}</span></div><div class="watch-progress-row"><div class="watch-progress" aria-label="观看进度"><span style="width:${percent}%"></span></div><strong>${Math.round(percent)}%</strong></div><div class="watch-times">${formatTime(item.currentTimeSeconds)} / ${item.durationSeconds > 0 ? formatTime(item.durationSeconds) : '时长未知'} · 实际观看 ${formatTime(item.totalWatchSeconds)}</div></div><div class="watch-side"><time>最近观看：${escapeHtml(formatDate(item.lastWatchedAt))}</time><div class="watch-actions"><a class="button button-quiet" href="${escapeHtml(resumeUrl(item))}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">${primary}</a><a class="button button-quiet" href="./watch-detail.html?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">详情</a><button class="button button-special watch-private" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}" ${privateState ? 'disabled' : ''}>${privateState ? '✓ 已入私人资料库' : '★ 加入私人资料库'}</button><button class="button button-quiet watch-delete" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">删除记录</button></div></div></article>`; }
  function render() { $('#watch-loading').classList.toggle('hidden', !state.loading); $('#watch-error').classList.toggle('hidden', state.error === null); $('#watch-error').innerHTML = state.error ? `<strong>观看记录读取失败</strong><span>${escapeHtml(state.error)}</span><button id="retry-watch-inline" class="button button-quiet">重试</button>` : ''; if (state.loading || state.error) { $('#watch-list').classList.add('hidden'); return; } const items = filteredItems(); $('#watch-count').textContent = `${items.length} 条`; $('#watch-list').classList.remove('hidden'); $('#watch-list').innerHTML = items.length ? items.map(card).join('') : empty(state.items.length ? '没有符合当前筛选的记录' : '还没有观看记录', '请在 Edge 中真实播放一个视频；仅打开页面不会创建记录。'); $('#watch-list').querySelectorAll('.watch-private').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void addPrivate(button))); $('#watch-list').querySelectorAll('.watch-delete').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void deleteRecord(button))); $('#retry-watch-inline')?.addEventListener('click', () => void load()); }
  async function addPrivate(button) { button.disabled = true; const item = state.items.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.id); if (!item) return; try { await api(`/v1/watch/records/${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}/private-library`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ tags: [item.contentType === 'MOVIE' || item.contentType === 'EPISODE' ? '电影' : '视频'] }) }); await load(); } catch (error) { button.disabled = false; window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '加入私人资料库失败'); } }
  async function deleteRecord(button) { const id = button.dataset.id; if (!id || !window.confirm('删除这条观看记录？私人资料库中的独立资料不会被删除。')) return; button.disabled = true; try { await api(`/v1/watch/records/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); state.items = state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== id); render(); } catch (error) { button.disabled = false; window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '删除观看记录失败'); } }
  async function load() { state.loading = true; state.error = null; render(); try { const [watch, library] = await Promise.all([api('/v1/watch/records?limit=100'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library')]); state.items = Array.isArray(watch?.items) ? watch.items : []; state.library = Array.isArray(library?.items) ? library.items : []; $('#watch-status').textContent = '本地桥接已连接'; $('#watch-status').className = 'pill pill-green'; } catch (error) { state.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : '本地桥接不可用'; $('#watch-status').textContent = '本地桥接不可用'; $('#watch-status').className = 'pill pill-red'; } finally { state.loading = false; render(); } }
  $('#watch-filters').addEventListener('click', (event) => { const button = event.target.closest('[data-filter]'); if (!button) return; state.filter = button.dataset.filter || 'recent'; $('#watch-filters').querySelectorAll('button').forEach((item) => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button)); render(); });
  $('#watch-search').addEventListener('input', (event) => { state.query = event.target.value || ''; render(); });
  $('#retry-watch').addEventListener('click', () => void load());
  $('#watch-search').value = state.query;
  void load();
})();

  async function load() {

    render(await api(`/v1/watch/records/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`));
  }
  void load().catch((error) => { $('#detail-loading').classList.add('hidden'); $('#detail-error').classList.remove('hidden'); $('#detail-error').innerHTML = `<strong>观看详情读取失败</strong><span>${escapeHtml(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '本地桥接不可用')}</span><a class="button button-quiet" href="./watch.html">返回观看记录</a>`; $('#detail-status').textContent = '读取失败'; $('#detail-status').className = 'pill pill-red'; });
})();
