  const ACTIONS = ['like', 'unlike', 'bookmark', 'unbookmark', 'follow', 'unfollow', 'opened', 'viewed', 'copied_link', 'share_to_mezip', 'manual_save', 'add_note'];
  const LABELS = { like: ['❤️', '点赞'], unlike: ['💔', '取消点赞'], bookmark: ['🔖', '收藏'], unbookmark: ['🔖', '取消收藏'], opened: ['↗', '打开'], viewed: ['👁', '浏览'], copied_link: ['🔗', 'X 链接收集'], share_to_mezip: ['📤', '分享至 ME.zip'], manual_save: ['✦', '手动保存'], add_note: ['✎', '添加备注'], follow: ['＋', '关注'], unfollow: ['−', '取消关注'] };
  const defaultSettings = { userId: 'browser-local', enabled: true, captureLikes: true, captureBookmarks: true, captureViews: true, captureSharedLinks: true, watchCapture: true, savePageMetadata: true, autoSync: false, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  let deletedSavedLinks = readDeletedSavedLinks(); let state = loadState(); let privateCollections = readCollections(); let bridge = { connected: false, checked: false }; let currentFilter = 'all'; let interestMode = null; let libraryFilter = 'all'; let librarySearch = '';
  let noteContext = null, noteBusy = false;
  function validSavedLink(item) { return item && typeof item.id === 'string' && typeof item.url === 'string' && typeof item.purpose === 'string'; }
  function readDeletedSavedLinks() { try { const value = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(DELETED_SAVED_LINKS_STORAGE) || '[]'); return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((item) => typeof item === 'string') : []; } catch { return []; } }
  function linkKey(item) { return item.sourceEventId || `${item.url}|${item.purpose}|${item.title || ''}`; }
  function readSavedLinks() { try { const shared = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(SAVED_LINKS_STORAGE) || '[]'); const legacy = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_SAVED_LINKS_STORAGE) || '[]'); const all = [...(Array.isArray(shared) ? shared : []), ...(Array.isArray(legacy) ? legacy : [])].filter(validSavedLink); const deduped = []; const seen = new Set(); all.forEach((item) => { const key = linkKey(item); if (deletedSavedLinks.includes(key) || seen.has(key)) return; seen.add(key); deduped.push({ ...item, tags: Array.isArray(item.tags) ? item.tags : [] }); }); return deduped; } catch { return []; } }
  function writeSavedLinks() { window.localStorage.setItem(SAVED_LINKS_STORAGE, JSON.stringify(state.savedLinks)); }
  function readCollections() { try { const value = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(COLLECTIONS_STORAGE) || '[]'); return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((item) => item && typeof item.id === 'string' && typeof item.name === 'string' && (item.ownerId === undefined || item.ownerId === 'browser-local')) : []; } catch { return []; } }
  function writeCollections(value) { window.localStorage.setItem(COLLECTIONS_STORAGE, JSON.stringify(value)); }
  function collectionName(id) { return privateCollections.find((item) => item.id === id)?.name || ''; }
  function createCollectionLocal(name) { const collections = readCollections(); const existing = collections.find((item) => item.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()); if (existing) return existing; const timestamp = new Date().toISOString(); const item = { id: uid(), ownerId: 'browser-local', name, description: null, icon: null, createdAt: timestamp, updatedAt: timestamp }; privateCollections = [item, ...collections]; writeCollections(privateCollections); return item; }
  async function createCollection() { const name = window.prompt('新建资料夹名称（默认保存在私人资料库；桥接可用时会持久化）', '设计灵感'); if (!name?.trim()) return null; const normalized = name.trim(); const existing = privateCollections.find((item) => item.name.toLowerCase() === normalized.toLowerCase()); if (existing) return existing; try { const result = await api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/collections', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ name: normalized }) }); const item = result.collection; privateCollections = [item, ...privateCollections.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== item.id)]; writeCollections(privateCollections); return item; } catch { bridge = { connected: false, checked: true }; return createCollectionLocal(normalized); } }
  function loadState() { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE) || '{}'); const privateLibrary = Array.isArray(parsed.privateLibrary) ? parsed.privateLibrary : (Array.isArray(parsed.specialFavorites) ? parsed.specialFavorites.map(legacyItem) : []); return { events: Array.isArray(parsed.events) ? parsed.events : [], content: Array.isArray(parsed.content) ? parsed.content : [], privateLibrary, savedLinks: readSavedLinks(), watchItems: [], settings: { ...defaultSettings, ...(parsed.settings || {}) } }; } catch { return { events: [], content: [], privateLibrary: [], savedLinks: readSavedLinks(), watchItems: [], settings: { ...defaultSettings } }; } }
  function saveState() { window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, JSON.stringify(state)); writeSavedLinks(); }
  function legacyItem(item) { return { id: item.id, ownerId: item.userId || 'browser-local', userId: item.userId || 'browser-local', sourceType: 'X_POST', sourcePlatform: 'X', sourceId: item.postId || item.postUrl, sourceUrl: item.postUrl, title: item.pageTitle || null, content: null, authorName: null, authorHandle: item.authorHandle || null, authorAvatar: null, media: [], thumbnail: null, publishedAt: null, savedAt: item.createdAt, createdAt: item.createdAt, updatedAt: item.updatedAt || item.createdAt, tags: item.tags || [], note: item.note || null, collectionId: null, privacy: 'PRIVATE', metadata: { legacy: true, sourceEventId: item.sourceEventId } }; }
  function uid() { return window.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || `capture-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`; }
  function escapeHtml(value) { return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[character])); }
  function formatTime(value) { const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '时间未知' : date.toLocaleString('zh-CN', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }); }
  function relativeTime(value) { const diff = Date.now() - new Date(value).getTime(); if (diff < 60_000) return '刚刚'; if (diff < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60_000)} 分钟前`; if (diff < 86_400_000) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3_600_000)} 小时前`; return formatTime(value); }
  function normalizeUrl(value) { const url = new URL(value); if (url.protocol !== 'https:' || !['x.com', 'www.x.com', 'twitter.com', 'www.twitter.com'].includes(url.hostname.toLowerCase())) throw new Error('只能保存 HTTPS X 链接。'); url.hash = ''; [...url.searchParams.keys()].forEach((key) => { if (key.toLowerCase().startsWith('utm_') || key === 's' || key === 't') url.searchParams.delete(key); }); return url.toString(); }
  function postId(value) { return /\/status\/(\d+)/u.exec(value)?.[1] || null; }
  function sourceKey(value, id) { return id || postId(value) || value; }
  function enabled(action) { const s = state.settings; if (!s.enabled) return false; if (action === 'like' || action === 'unlike') return s.captureLikes; if (action === 'bookmark' || action === 'unbookmark') return s.captureBookmarks; if (action === 'opened' || action === 'viewed') return s.captureViews; if (action === 'copied_link' || action === 'share_to_mezip' || action === 'manual_save') return s.captureSharedLinks; return true; }
  function savedLinkFromEvent(event) { return { id: event.id, sourceEventId: event.id, url: event.postUrl, purpose: event.note || '', title: event.pageTitle || '', tags: [...(event.tags || [])], createdAt: Date.parse(event.createdAt || event.capturedAt) || Date.now() }; }
  function mergeSavedLink(link) { const key = linkKey(link); if (deletedSavedLinks.includes(key)) return null; const index = state.savedLinks.findIndex((item) => linkKey(item) === key); if (index >= 0) { state.savedLinks[index] = { ...state.savedLinks[index], ...link, tags: [...new Set([...(state.savedLinks[index].tags || []), ...(link.tags || [])])] }; return state.savedLinks[index]; } state.savedLinks.unshift({ ...link, tags: [...new Set(link.tags || [])] }); return link; }
  function syncSavedLinksFromEvents() { state.events.filter((event) => event.actionType === 'copied_link' || event.actionType === 'manual_save').forEach((event) => mergeSavedLink(savedLinkFromEvent(event))); writeSavedLinks(); }
  function savedLinkSource(item) { const event = state.events.find((entry) => (item.sourceEventId && entry.id === item.sourceEventId) || (entry.postUrl === item.url && (entry.actionType === 'copied_link' || entry.actionType === 'manual_save'))); if (event) return event; return { id: item.sourceEventId || item.id, userId: 'browser-local', platform: 'X', actionType: 'copied_link', postUrl: item.url, postId: postId(item.url), authorHandle: null, pageTitle: item.title || null, capturedAt: new Date(item.createdAt || Date.now()).toISOString(), source: 'MANUAL_IMPORT', device: 'browser', browser: 'Browser', note: item.purpose || null, tags: item.tags || [], syncStatus: 'LOCAL_ONLY', createdAt: new Date(item.createdAt || Date.now()).toISOString(), updatedAt: new Date(item.createdAt || Date.now()).toISOString() }; }
  function localCapture(input) { const url = normalizeUrl(input.postUrl); if (!enabled(input.actionType)) return { event: null, disabled: true, deduplicated: false }; const capturedAt = input.capturedAt || new Date().toISOString(); const bucket = Math.floor(new Date(capturedAt).getTime() / 30_000); const duplicate = state.events.find((event) => event.actionType === input.actionType && event.postUrl === url && Math.floor(new Date(event.capturedAt).getTime() / 30_000) === bucket && (input.actionType !== 'add_note' || (event.note || '') === (input.note || ''))); if (duplicate) return { event: duplicate, disabled: false, deduplicated: true }; const now = new Date().toISOString(); const event = { id: uid(), userId: 'browser-local', platform: 'X', actionType: input.actionType, postUrl: url, postId: input.postId || postId(url), authorHandle: input.authorHandle || null, pageTitle: state.settings.savePageMetadata ? input.pageTitle || null : null, capturedAt, source: input.source || 'LOCAL_CAPTURE', device: input.device || 'browser', browser: input.browser || (navigator.userAgent.includes('Edg/') ? 'Edge' : 'Browser'), note: input.note || null, tags: [...new Set((input.tags || []).map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean))], syncStatus: 'PENDING_ENRICHMENT', createdAt: now, updatedAt: now }; if (input.actionType === 'add_note') { const events = [event, ...state.events]; window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, JSON.stringify({ ...state, events })); state.events = events; return { event, disabled: false, deduplicated: false }; } state.events.unshift(event); if (event.actionType === 'copied_link' || event.actionType === 'manual_save') { deletedSavedLinks = deletedSavedLinks.filter((key) => key !== linkKey(savedLinkFromEvent(event))); mergeSavedLink(savedLinkFromEvent(event)); } saveState(); return { event, disabled: false, deduplicated: false }; }
  async function api(path, options = {}) { const response = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, { ...options, credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(options.headers || {}) } }); const payload = await response.json(); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload?.error?.message || '本地服务请求失败'); return payload.data; }
  async function hydrateFromBridge() { const [settings, stats, timeline, library, collections] = await Promise.all([api('/v1/x/local-capture/settings'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/stats'), T.loadX(api), api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/collections')]); state.settings = { ...state.settings, ...settings }; state.events = (timeline.events || []).sort((a, b) => (Date.parse(T.time(b)) || 0) - (Date.parse(T.time(a)) || 0)); state.timelineTruncated = timeline.truncated; state.content = timeline.content || []; state.privateLibrary = library.items || []; privateCollections = Array.isArray(collections?.items) ? collections.items : []; writeCollections(privateCollections); state.remoteStats = stats; state.watchItems = await api('/v1/watch/records?limit=100').then((result) => Array.isArray(result?.items) ? result.items : []).catch(() => []); syncSavedLinksFromEvents(); saveState(); }
  async function syncSavedLinksToBridge() { let synced = false; for (const item of state.savedLinks) { const exists = state.events.some((event) => (event.actionType === 'copied_link' || event.actionType === 'manual_save') && event.postUrl === item.url && (event.note || '') === (item.purpose || '') && (event.pageTitle || '') === (item.title || '')); if (exists) continue; try { await api('/v1/x/local-capture/events', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ actionType: 'copied_link', postUrl: item.url, pageTitle: item.title || null, note: item.purpose || null, tags: item.tags || [], source: 'MANUAL_IMPORT' }) }); synced = true; } catch { /* keep the shared browser record if the bridge is unavailable */ } } if (synced) await hydrateFromBridge(); }
  let bridgeRequest = null;
  function probeBridge() { if (bridgeRequest) return bridgeRequest; const button = document.querySelector('#refresh-timeline'); if (button) button.disabled = true; bridgeRequest = refreshBridge().finally(() => { bridgeRequest = null; if (button) button.disabled = false; }); return bridgeRequest; }
  async function refreshBridge() { try { await api('/v1/x/local-capture/health'); await hydrateFromBridge(); await syncSavedLinksToBridge(); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; } catch { bridge = { connected: false, checked: true }; } updateBridgeUi(); render(); }
  async function capture(input) { try { const result = await api('/v1/x/local-capture/events', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(input) }); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result; } catch { bridge = { connected: false, checked: true }; return localCapture(input); } }
  function contentFor(event) { return T.contentFor(event, state.content); }
  function libraryForUrl(url) { return state.privateLibrary.find((item) => item.sourceUrl === url); }
  function localAddLibrary(input) { const url = normalizeUrl(input.postUrl); const source = state.events.find((event) => event.postUrl === url && (event.actionType === 'like' || event.actionType === 'bookmark' || event.actionType === 'copied_link' || event.actionType === 'manual_save') && (!input.sourceEventId || event.id === input.sourceEventId)) || state.savedLinks.map(savedLinkSource).find((event) => event.postUrl === url && (!input.sourceEventId || event.id === input.sourceEventId)); if (!source) throw new Error('私人资料库只能添加已点赞、已收藏或已保存的 X 链接。'); const key = sourceKey(url, input.postId || source.postId); const existing = state.privateLibrary.find((item) => item.sourceId === key || item.sourceUrl === url); if (existing) return { item: existing, deduplicated: true }; const content = contentFor(source); const now = new Date().toISOString(); const item = { id: uid(), ownerId: 'browser-local', userId: 'browser-local', sourceType: 'X_POST', sourcePlatform: 'X', sourceId: key, sourceUrl: url, title: input.pageTitle || source.pageTitle || content?.pageTitle || null, content: content?.textExcerpt || null, authorName: null, authorHandle: input.authorHandle || source.authorHandle || content?.authorHandle || null, authorAvatar: null, media: content?.media || [], thumbnail: null, publishedAt: null, savedAt: now, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, tags: [...new Set((input.tags || source.tags || []).map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean))], note: input.note ?? source.note ?? null, collectionId: input.collectionId || null, privacy: 'PRIVATE', metadata: { sourceEventId: source.id, sourceAction: source.actionType } }; state.privateLibrary.unshift(item); saveState(); return { item, deduplicated: false }; }
  async function addLibrary(input) { try { const result = await api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(input) }); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result; } catch { bridge = { connected: false, checked: true }; return localAddLibrary(input); } }
  async function addLibraryBatch(inputs) { try { const result = await api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/batch', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ items: inputs }) }); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result.items; } catch { return inputs.map((input) => localAddLibrary(input)); } }
  function localRemoveLibrary(id) { const before = state.privateLibrary.length; state.privateLibrary = state.privateLibrary.filter((item) => item.id !== id); saveState(); return before !== state.privateLibrary.length; }
  async function removeLibrary(id) { try { const result = await api(`/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result; } catch { bridge = { connected: false, checked: true }; return { deleted: localRemoveLibrary(id) }; } }
  async function patchLibrary(id, patch) { try { const result = await api(`/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify(patch) }); bridge = { connected: true, checked: true }; await hydrateFromBridge(); return result; } catch { const index = state.privateLibrary.findIndex((item) => item.id === id); if (index < 0) throw new Error('私人资料不存在。'); state.privateLibrary[index] = { ...state.privateLibrary[index], ...patch, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }; saveState(); return state.privateLibrary[index]; } }
  function updateBridgeUi() { const pill = document.querySelector('#bridge-status'); if (pill) { pill.textContent = bridge.connected ? '本地桥接已连接' : '浏览器本地模式'; pill.className = `pill ${bridge.connected ? 'pill-green' : 'pill-muted'}`; } const settingsPill = document.querySelector('#settings-bridge-pill'); if (settingsPill) { settingsPill.textContent = bridge.connected ? 'CONNECTED' : 'LOCAL ONLY'; settingsPill.className = `pill ${bridge.connected ? 'pill-green' : 'pill-muted'}`; } }
  function runGlobalSearch(value) { const query = String(value || '').trim(); if (!query) return; const needle = query.toLowerCase(); const includes = (item) => `${item.sourceUrl || item.url || item.postUrl || ''} ${item.title || item.pageTitle || ''} ${item.content || item.note || item.purpose || ''} ${item.authorHandle || item.creator || ''} ${(item.tags || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(needle); if (state.watchItems.some(includes)) { window.location.href = `./watch.html?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`; return; } if (state.privateLibrary.some(includes)) { librarySearch = query; window.location.hash = '#special'; renderLibrary(); return; } currentFilter = 'all'; interestMode = null; const timelineSearch = document.querySelector('#timeline-search'); if (timelineSearch) timelineSearch.value = query; window.location.hash = '#timeline'; renderTimeline(); }
  function counts(events) { const result = Object.fromEntries(ACTIONS.map((action) => [action, 0])); events.forEach((event) => { result[event.actionType] = (result[event.actionType] || 0) + 1; }); return result; }
  function eventIcon(action) { return LABELS[action]?.[0] || '•'; } function eventLabel(action) { return LABELS[action]?.[1] || action; }
  function render() { renderRoute(); renderMetrics(); renderWeek(); renderRecent(); renderTimeline(); renderLibrary(); renderSavedLinks(); renderInterestWithSavedLinks(); renderSettings(); updateBridgeUi(); }
  function renderRoute() { const route = (window.location.hash || '#overview').slice(1).split('?')[0]; document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach((view) => view.classList.toggle('hidden', view.dataset.view !== route)); document.querySelectorAll('[data-route]').forEach((link) => link.classList.toggle('active', link.dataset.route === route)); }
  function renderMetrics() { const c = counts(state.events); const items = [['今日点赞记录', state.events.filter((e) => e.actionType === 'like' && new Date(e.capturedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length, '含可见状态补收'], ['今日收藏记录', state.events.filter((e) => e.actionType === 'bookmark' && new Date(e.capturedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length, '含可见状态补收'], ['今日浏览', state.events.filter((e) => e.actionType === 'viewed' && new Date(e.capturedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length, '当前页面可见'], ['私人资料', state.privateLibrary.length, '再次确认保留']]; const el = document.querySelector('#metrics'); if (el) el.innerHTML = items.map(([label, value, detail]) => `<article class="metric panel"><span>${label}</span><strong>${value || '0'}</strong><small>${detail}</small></article>`).join(''); const pending = document.querySelector('#pending-count'); if (pending) pending.textContent = String(state.events.filter((event) => event.syncStatus === 'PENDING_ENRICHMENT').length); const last = document.querySelector('#last-capture'); if (last) last.textContent = state.events[0] ? relativeTime(state.events[0].capturedAt) : '—'; const badge = document.querySelector('#official-badge'); if (badge) badge.textContent = state.remoteStats?.officialApiStatus || 'SEE X CENTER'; }
  function renderWeek() { const chart = document.querySelector('#week-chart'); if (!chart) return; const days = []; for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i -= 1) { const date = new Date(); date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); date.setDate(date.getDate() - i); const value = state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt).toDateString() === date.toDateString()).length; days.push({ label: `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`, value }); } const max = Math.max(1, ...days.map((day) => day.value)); chart.innerHTML = days.map((day) => `<div class="day-bar"><i style="height:${Math.max(3, day.value / max * 100)}%" title="${day.value} 条本地记录"></i><span>${day.value}</span><small>${day.label}</small></div>`).join(''); }
  function eventRow(event) { const content = contentFor(event); return `<div class="event-row"><span class="event-icon">${eventIcon(event.actionType)}</span><div class="event-main"><strong>${escapeHtml(T.label(event))}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(event.authorHandle ? `@${event.authorHandle} · ` : '')}${escapeHtml(content?.pageTitle || event.pageTitle || event.postUrl)}</small></div><time class="event-time">${relativeTime(event.capturedAt)}</time></div>`; }
  function renderRecent() { const el = document.querySelector('#recent-events'); if (el) el.innerHTML = state.events.length ? state.events.slice(0, 6).map(eventRow).join('') : `<div class="empty"><strong>还没有本地记录</strong>打开 X 并明确点击操作，或先保存一条链接。</div>`; }
  function filteredEvents(applyAction = true) {
    const from = T.periodStart(document.querySelector('#period-filter')?.value || 'all');
    const query = (document.querySelector('#timeline-search')?.value || '').toLocaleLowerCase().trim();
    return state.events.filter((event) => {
      if (applyAction && !T.matches(event, currentFilter)) return false;
      if (from && new Date(T.time(event)) < from) return false;
      if (query && !T.searchText(event, state.content).includes(query)) return false;
      if (interestMode === 'recent-month' && new Date(T.time(event)) < new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86400000)) return false;
      if (interestMode === 'year-footprint' && new Date(T.time(event)).getFullYear() !== new Date().getFullYear()) return false;
      if (interestMode?.startsWith('tag:') && !(event.tags || []).includes(interestMode.slice(4))) return false;
      return true;
    }).sort((a, b) => ((Date.parse(T.time(b)) || 0) - (Date.parse(T.time(a)) || 0)) * (document.querySelector('#timeline-sort')?.value === 'oldest' ? -1 : 1));
  }
  function renderTimelineFilters() {
    const base = filteredEvents(false);
    document.querySelector('#action-filters').innerHTML = T.actions.map(([key, label]) => `<button type="button" data-filter="${key}" class="${currentFilter === key ? 'active' : ''}" aria-pressed="${currentFilter === key}">${label} <span>${base.filter((event) => T.matches(event, key)).length}</span></button>`).join('');
    const count = document.querySelector('#timeline-count');
    if (count) count.textContent = `${filteredEvents().length} 条匹配 / ${state.events.length} 条已读取 X 记录。计数为动作或补收记录数，不代表当前点赞 / 收藏总量。${state.timelineTruncated ? '已达到单次 10,000 条上限。' : ''}${bridge.connected ? '' : ' 当前为浏览器缓存，可点击刷新重试。'}`;
  }
  function selectInterest(mode) {
    interestMode = null; currentFilter = 'all';
    document.querySelector('#period-filter').value = 'all';
    document.querySelector('#timeline-search').value = '';
    if (mode === 'special') { window.location.hash = '#special'; return; }
    if (mode === 'saved_links') { window.location.hash = '#interest'; document.querySelector('#interest-saved-links')?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'start' }); return; }
    if (mode?.startsWith('tag:') || ['recent-month', 'year-footprint'].includes(mode)) interestMode = mode;
    else currentFilter = mode || 'all';
    window.location.hash = '#timeline'; renderTimeline();
  }
  function timelineCard(event) { const eligible = event.actionType === 'like' || event.actionType === 'bookmark' || event.actionType === 'copied_link' || event.actionType === 'manual_save'; const library = eligible ? libraryForUrl(event.postUrl) : null; const content = contentFor(event); const action = eligible ? `<label class="library-select-wrap"><input class="library-select" type="checkbox" data-url="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}" data-event-id="${escapeHtml(event.id)}" ${library ? 'checked disabled' : ''} aria-label="选择加入私人资料库"></label><button class="button button-special special-toggle" data-url="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}" data-event-id="${escapeHtml(event.id)}" data-library-id="${escapeHtml(library?.id || '')}">${library ? '✓ 已加入私人资料库' : '再次收藏到私人资料库'}</button>` : ''; return `<article class="timeline-card panel" data-event-id="${escapeHtml(event.id)}" data-action-type="${escapeHtml(event.actionType)}"><span class="event-icon">${eventIcon(event.actionType)}</span><div class="timeline-main"><strong>${escapeHtml(T.label(event))}</strong><p>${escapeHtml([content?.textExcerpt || content?.pageTitle || event.pageTitle, event.note ? `备注：${event.note}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join('\n') || '这条记录没有附加文字；原始链接仍然保留。')}</p><a href="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)} ↗</a><div class="timeline-meta">${T.recovered(event) ? '<span class="tag">可见状态补收 · 原操作时间未知</span>' : ''}${(event.tags || []).map((tag) => `<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(tag)}</span>`).join('')}<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(event.source === 'SHARE_EXTENSION' ? 'SHARE EXTENSION' : 'LOCAL CAPTURE')}</span></div></div><div class="timeline-side"><time>${T.recovered(event) ? '观测于 ' : ''}${formatTime(T.time(event))}</time><span class="source-badge">${event.syncStatus === 'PENDING_ENRICHMENT' ? '待补全' : event.syncStatus}</span><div class="timeline-actions"><button class="button button-quiet copy-link" data-url="${escapeHtml(event.postUrl)}">复制链接</button><button type="button" class="button button-quiet add-timeline-note" data-event-id="${escapeHtml(event.id)}">添加备注</button>${action}</div></div></article>`; }
  function renderTimeline() { const el = document.querySelector('#timeline-events'); if (!el) return; renderTimelineFilters(); const events = filteredEvents(); el.innerHTML = `<div class="library-batch-bar panel"><span>已选择 <strong id="library-selected-count">0</strong> 条</span><button class="button button-primary" id="batch-library" disabled>批量加入私人资料库</button></div>${events.length ? events.map(timelineCard).join('') : `<div class="empty panel"><strong>暂无符合条件的行为</strong>本地记录会从你启用 Capture 后开始累积，不会伪造过去的数据。</div>`}`; el.querySelectorAll('.add-timeline-note').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => openTimelineNote(button.dataset.eventId))); el.querySelectorAll('.copy-link').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', async () => { await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(button.dataset.url || ''); await capture({ actionType: 'copied_link', postUrl: button.dataset.url, source: 'LOCAL_CAPTURE' }); button.textContent = '已复制'; })); el.querySelectorAll('.special-toggle').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', async () => { button.disabled = true; try { if (button.dataset.libraryId) await removeLibrary(button.dataset.libraryId); else await addLibrary({ postUrl: button.dataset.url, sourceEventId: button.dataset.eventId }); render(); } catch (error) { button.disabled = false; window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '私人资料库操作失败'); } })); const updateCount = () => { const count = el.querySelectorAll('.library-select:checked:not(:disabled)').length; el.querySelector('#library-selected-count').textContent = String(count); el.querySelector('#batch-library').disabled = count === 0; }; el.querySelectorAll('.library-select').forEach((input) => input.addEventListener('change', updateCount)); el.querySelector('#batch-library').addEventListener('click', async () => { const inputs = [...el.querySelectorAll('.library-select:checked:not(:disabled)')].map((input) => ({ postUrl: input.dataset.url, sourceEventId: input.dataset.eventId })); await addLibraryBatch(inputs); render(); }); updateCount(); }
  function libraryCategory(item) { const type = String(item.sourceType || '').toUpperCase(); const platform = String(item.sourcePlatform || '').toUpperCase(); const text = `${JSON.stringify(item.media || [])} ${item.title || ''} ${item.content || ''} ${item.note || ''} ${(item.tags || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase(); const url = String(item.sourceUrl || '').toLowerCase(); if (platform === 'X' || type === 'X_POST') return 'x'; if (type === 'MOVIE' || type === 'EPISODE' || (platform === 'WATCH' && /电影|movie|film/.test(text))) return 'movie'; if (type === 'VIDEO' || type === 'WATCH_ITEM' || platform === 'WATCH' || platform === 'YOUTUBE' || platform === 'BILIBILI' || /video|\.mp4|\.webm|\.mov/.test(text)) return 'video'; if (type === 'ARTICLE' || /article|文章|长文/.test(text)) return 'article'; if (type === 'IMAGE' || /image|图片|\.png|\.jpe?g|\.gif|\.webp/.test(text)) return 'image'; if (type === 'CODE' || /github|代码|snippet|sql|python|typescript|javascript/.test(`${url} ${text}`)) return 'code'; if (type === 'WEBPAGE' || type === 'WEB' || /^https?:/.test(url)) return 'web'; return 'other'; }
  function libraryKind(item) { const category = libraryCategory(item); if (category === 'movie' || category === 'video') return 'video'; if (category === 'image') return 'image'; return 'text'; }
  function libraryCategoryLabel(category) { return ({ all: '全部', x: 'X', movie: '电影', video: '视频', web: '网页', article: '文章', image: '图片', code: '代码', other: '其他' })[category] || '其他'; }
  function libraryCard(item, compact = false) { const category = libraryCategory(item); const sourceLabel = item.sourcePlatform === 'WATCH' ? `观看记录 / ${libraryCategoryLabel(category)}` : libraryCategoryLabel(category); const folder = collectionName(item.collectionId); return `<article class="special-card panel${compact ? ' compact' : ''}"><div class="special-card-head"><span class="event-icon">★</span><time>加入于 ${formatTime(item.savedAt)}</time></div><strong>${escapeHtml(item.title || item.authorHandle || `来自 ${sourceLabel} 的私人资料`)}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(item.content || item.note || '你明确选择保留的资料。')}</p>${item.authorHandle ? `<small>@${escapeHtml(item.authorHandle)}</small>` : ''}<a href="${escapeHtml(item.sourceUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">打开原始链接 ↗</a><div class="special-card-foot"><span class="tag">${sourceLabel} · 私人</span>${folder ? `<span class="tag">📁 ${escapeHtml(folder)}</span>` : ''}${(item.tags || []).map((tag) => `<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(tag)}</span>`).join('')}<button class="button button-quiet edit-library" data-library-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">标签 / 主要作用</button><button class="button button-quiet edit-collection" data-library-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">资料夹</button><button class="button button-quiet remove-library" data-library-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">移出</button></div></article>`; }
  function filteredLibrary() { const query = librarySearch.toLowerCase().trim(); return state.privateLibrary.filter((item) => { if (libraryFilter !== 'all' && libraryCategory(item) !== libraryFilter) return false; return !query || `${item.sourceUrl} ${item.title || ''} ${item.content || ''} ${item.authorHandle || ''} ${item.note || ''} ${(item.tags || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(query); }); }
  function editLibrary(item) { const note = window.prompt('主要作用（仅本地保存）', item.note || ''); if (note === null) return; const tags = window.prompt('标签（用逗号分隔）', (item.tags || []).join(', ')); if (tags === null) return; void patchLibrary(item.id, { note: note.trim() || null, tags: tags.split(',').map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean) }).then(render); }
  async function editCollection(item) { const collections = privateCollections; const names = collections.map((entry) => entry.name).join('、'); const answer = window.prompt(`资料夹名称（留空取消；输入“新建”创建）${names ? `\n已有：${names}` : ''}`, collectionName(item.collectionId)); if (answer === null) return; if (answer.trim() === '新建') { const created = await createCollection(); if (!created) return; await patchLibrary(item.id, { collectionId: created.id }); } else if (!answer.trim()) { await patchLibrary(item.id, { collectionId: null }); } else { const target = collections.find((entry) => entry.name.toLowerCase() === answer.trim().toLowerCase()) || createCollectionLocal(answer.trim()); await patchLibrary(item.id, { collectionId: target.id }); } render(); }
  async function manageCollections() { const collections = privateCollections; if (!collections.length) { await createCollection(); render(); return; } const answer = window.prompt(`资料夹管理：输入“新建”创建，输入“删除:名称”删除，或输入现有名称重命名。\n已有：${collections.map((entry) => entry.name).join('、')}`); if (!answer?.trim()) return; const command = answer.trim(); if (command === '新建') { await createCollection(); } else if (command.startsWith('删除:')) { const target = collections.find((entry) => entry.name === command.slice(3).trim()); if (!target) return window.alert('找不到这个资料夹。'); try { await api(`/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/collections/${encodeURIComponent(target.id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); } catch { privateCollections = collections.filter((entry) => entry.id !== target.id); writeCollections(privateCollections); } privateCollections = privateCollections.filter((entry) => entry.id !== target.id); writeCollections(privateCollections); } else { const target = collections.find((entry) => entry.name.toLowerCase() === command.toLowerCase()); if (!target) return window.alert('找不到这个资料夹；输入“新建”可创建。'); const name = window.prompt('新的资料夹名称', target.name); if (!name?.trim()) return; try { const result = await api(`/v1/x/local-capture/private-library/collections/${encodeURIComponent(target.id)}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ name: name.trim() }) }); privateCollections = privateCollections.map((entry) => entry.id === target.id ? result.collection : entry); } catch { privateCollections = privateCollections.map((entry) => entry.id === target.id ? { ...entry, name: name.trim(), updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : entry); } writeCollections(privateCollections); } render(); }
  function bindLibrary(root) { root.querySelectorAll('.remove-library').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', async () => { button.disabled = true; await removeLibrary(button.dataset.libraryId || ''); render(); })); root.querySelectorAll('.edit-library').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => { const item = state.privateLibrary.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.libraryId); if (item) editLibrary(item); })); root.querySelectorAll('.edit-collection').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => { const item = state.privateLibrary.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.libraryId); if (item) void editCollection(item); })); }
  function renderLibrary() { const preview = document.querySelector('#special-preview'); if (preview) { const items = state.privateLibrary.slice(0, 3); preview.innerHTML = items.length ? items.map((item) => libraryCard(item, true)).join('') : `<div class="empty"><strong>私人资料库还是空的</strong>在点赞、收藏或已保存链接旁点击「再次收藏到私人资料库」。</div>`; bindLibrary(preview); } const full = document.querySelector('#special-favorites'); if (!full) return; const controls = `<div class="library-controls panel"><div class="filter-tabs" id="library-filters">${[['all', '全部'], ['x', 'X'], ['movie', '电影'], ['video', '视频'], ['web', '网页'], ['article', '文章'], ['image', '图片'], ['code', '代码'], ['other', '其他']].map(([key, label]) => `<button data-library-filter="${key}" class="${libraryFilter === key ? 'active' : ''}">${label}</button>`).join('')}</div><input id="library-search" type="search" value="${escapeHtml(librarySearch)}" placeholder="搜索正文、标签、链接、作者或主要作用"><button id="new-collection" class="button button-quiet" type="button">＋ 新建资料夹</button><button id="manage-collections" class="button button-quiet" type="button">管理资料夹</button><span class="pill pill-muted">${state.privateLibrary.length} 条私密资料 · ${privateCollections.length} 个资料夹</span></div>`; const items = filteredLibrary(); full.innerHTML = `${controls}${items.length ? items.map((item) => libraryCard(item)).join('') : `<div class="empty panel"><strong>没有匹配的私人资料</strong>只有你明确选择的内容才会进入这里。</div>`}`; bindLibrary(full); full.querySelectorAll('[data-library-filter]').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => { libraryFilter = button.dataset.libraryFilter || 'all'; renderLibrary(); })); full.querySelector('#library-search')?.addEventListener('input', (event) => { librarySearch = event.target.value; renderLibrary(); }); full.querySelector('#new-collection')?.addEventListener('click', () => { void createCollection().then(() => renderLibrary()); }); full.querySelector('#manage-collections')?.addEventListener('click', () => { void manageCollections(); }); }
  function savedLinkCard(item) { const library = libraryForUrl(item.url); return `<article class="saved-link-card"><div><h4>${escapeHtml(item.title || '未命名 X 链接')}</h4><p>${escapeHtml(item.purpose || '这条链接由你明确保存。')}</p><a href="${escapeHtml(item.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">${escapeHtml(item.url)} ↗</a><div class="saved-link-meta">${(item.tags || []).map((tag) => `<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(tag)}</span>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="saved-link-actions"><time>${formatTime(item.createdAt)}</time><button type="button" class="button button-special saved-link-library" data-saved-link-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}" ${library ? 'disabled' : ''}>${library ? '✓ 已加入私人资料库' : '再次收藏到私人资料库'}</button></div></article>`; }
  function renderSavedLinks() { const el = document.querySelector('#interest-saved-links'); if (!el) return; const count = document.querySelector('#saved-links-count'); if (count) count.textContent = `${state.savedLinks.length} 条`; const items = [...state.savedLinks].sort((left, right) => Number(right.createdAt) - Number(left.createdAt)); el.innerHTML = items.length ? items.map(savedLinkCard).join('') : `<div class="empty"><strong>还没有已保存的链接</strong>在「收集 X 链接」中保存一条真实链接后，它会自动出现在这里。</div>`; el.querySelectorAll('.saved-link-library').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', async () => { const item = state.savedLinks.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.savedLinkId); if (!item) return; button.disabled = true; try { await addLibrary({ postUrl: item.url, sourceEventId: item.sourceEventId, pageTitle: item.title || null, note: item.purpose || null, tags: item.tags || [] }); render(); } catch (error) { button.disabled = false; window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '导入私人资料库失败'); } })); }
  function renderInterestWithSavedLinks() { const tagCloud = document.querySelector('#tag-cloud'); const tagCounts = {}; [...state.events, ...state.savedLinks, ...state.privateLibrary].forEach((entry) => (entry.tags || []).forEach((tag) => { tagCounts[tag] = (tagCounts[tag] || 0) + 1; })); const tags = Object.entries(tagCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]); if (tagCloud) tagCloud.innerHTML = tags.length ? tags.map(([tag, count]) => `<button type="button" class="tag tag-button" data-interest-mode="tag:${escapeHtml(tag)}">${escapeHtml(tag)} · ${count}</button>`).join('') : `<div class="empty" style="width:100%"><strong>还没有兴趣标签</strong>在已保存链接或私人资料库中添加自己的标签。</div>`; const c = counts(state.events); const summary = document.querySelector('#interest-summary'); if (summary) summary.innerHTML = [['总记录', state.events.length, null], ['总点赞', c.like, 'like'], ['总收藏', c.bookmark, 'bookmark'], ['私人资料', state.privateLibrary.length, 'special'], ['分享至 ME.zip', c.share_to_mezip, 'share_to_mezip'], ['已保存链接', state.savedLinks.length, 'saved_links'], ['带备注', state.events.filter((event) => event.note?.trim()).length, 'notes']].map(([label, value, mode]) => mode ? `<button type="button" class="summary-row" data-interest-mode="${mode}"><span>${label}</span><strong>${value}</strong><small>点击查看</small></button>` : `<div class="summary-row summary-row-static"><span>${label}</span><strong>${value}</strong><small>累计</small></div>`).join(''); const insight = document.querySelector('#interest-insights'); if (insight) insight.innerHTML = `<button type="button" class="insight-card" data-interest-mode="recent-month"><strong>最近 30 天兴趣变化</strong><span>${state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt) >= new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86_400_000)).length} 条本地事件</span><small>点击查看真实记录</small></button><button type="button" class="insight-card" data-interest-mode="year-footprint"><strong>年度互联网足迹</strong><span>${state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt).getFullYear() === new Date().getFullYear()).length} 条本年度事件</span><small>从启用当天开始累计</small></button>`; }
  function renderInterest() { const tagCloud = document.querySelector('#tag-cloud'); const tagCounts = {}; [...state.events, ...state.privateLibrary].forEach((entry) => (entry.tags || []).forEach((tag) => { tagCounts[tag] = (tagCounts[tag] || 0) + 1; })); const tags = Object.entries(tagCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]); if (tagCloud) tagCloud.innerHTML = tags.length ? tags.map(([tag, count]) => `<button type="button" class="tag tag-button" data-interest-mode="tag:${escapeHtml(tag)}">${escapeHtml(tag)} · ${count}</button>`).join('') : `<div class="empty" style="width:100%"><strong>还没有兴趣标签</strong>在资料库中添加自己的标签。</div>`; const c = counts(state.events); const summary = document.querySelector('#interest-summary'); if (summary) summary.innerHTML = [['总记录', state.events.length, null], ['总点赞', c.like, 'like'], ['总收藏', c.bookmark, 'bookmark'], ['私人资料', state.privateLibrary.length, 'special'], ['分享至 ME.zip', c.share_to_mezip, 'share_to_mezip'], ['X 链接收集', c.copied_link, 'copied_link']].map(([label, value, mode]) => mode ? `<button type="button" class="summary-row" data-interest-mode="${mode}"><span>${label}</span><strong>${value}</strong><small>点击查看</small></button>` : `<div class="summary-row summary-row-static"><span>${label}</span><strong>${value}</strong><small>累计</small></div>`).join(''); const insight = document.querySelector('#interest-insights'); if (insight) insight.innerHTML = `<button type="button" class="insight-card" data-interest-mode="recent-month"><strong>最近 30 天兴趣变化</strong><span>${state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt) >= new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86_400_000)).length} 条本地事件</span><small>点击查看真实记录</small></button><button type="button" class="insight-card" data-interest-mode="year-footprint"><strong>年度互联网足迹</strong><span>${state.events.filter((event) => new Date(event.capturedAt).getFullYear() === new Date().getFullYear()).length} 条本年度事件</span><small>从启用当天开始累计</small></button>`; }
  function renderSettings() { const s = state.settings; ['enabled', 'captureLikes', 'captureBookmarks', 'captureViews', 'captureSharedLinks', 'watchCapture', 'savePageMetadata'].forEach((key) => { const input = document.querySelector(`#setting-${key}`); if (input) input.checked = s[key] !== false; }); }
  function openCaptureDialog() { const dialog = document.querySelector('#capture-dialog'); if (typeof dialog.showModal === 'function') dialog.showModal(); else dialog.setAttribute('open', ''); }
  async function submitCapture(event) { event.preventDefault(); const error = document.querySelector('#capture-error'); error.textContent = ''; try { const result = await capture({ actionType: document.querySelector('#capture-action').value, postUrl: document.querySelector('#capture-url').value.trim(), authorHandle: document.querySelector('#capture-author').value.trim() || null, pageTitle: document.querySelector('#capture-title').value.trim() || null, note: document.querySelector('#capture-note').value.trim() || null, tags: document.querySelector('#capture-tags').value.split(',').map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean), source: 'MANUAL_IMPORT' }); if (result.disabled) throw new Error('当前设置已关闭这类记录。'); document.querySelector('#capture-dialog').close(); event.target.reset(); render(); } catch (caught) { error.textContent = caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : '保存失败'; } }
  function openTimelineNote(id) {
    if (noteBusy) return;
    const source = state.events.find((item) => item.id === id); if (!source) return;
    const dialog = document.querySelector('#timeline-note-dialog');
    noteContext = { source: { ...source }, local: bridge.checked && !bridge.connected, payload: null };
    document.querySelector('#timeline-note-source').textContent = source.pageTitle || contentFor(source)?.pageTitle || source.postUrl;
    document.querySelector('#timeline-note-text').value = '';
    document.querySelector('#timeline-note-error').textContent = '';
    document.querySelector('#timeline-note-mode').textContent = noteContext.local ? '当前为浏览器本地模式，备注将保存在此浏览器。' : '备注将作为一条新记录保存到本机资料库，原记录保持不变。';
    if (typeof dialog.showModal === 'function') dialog.showModal(); else dialog.setAttribute('open', '');
    document.querySelector('#timeline-note-text').focus();
  }
  function closeTimelineNote() {
    if (noteBusy) return;
    const dialog = document.querySelector('#timeline-note-dialog');
    if (typeof dialog.close === 'function') dialog.close(); else dialog.removeAttribute('open');
  }
  async function submitTimelineNote(event) {
    event.preventDefault(); if (noteBusy || !noteContext) return;
    const context = noteContext, input = document.querySelector('#timeline-note-text'), error = document.querySelector('#timeline-note-error');
    const note = input.value.trim(); error.textContent = '';
    if (!note) { error.textContent = '请先写下备注。'; input.focus(); return; }
    if (note.length > 10000) { error.textContent = '备注最多 10,000 字。'; return; }
    if (!enabled('add_note')) { error.textContent = '当前已关闭本地记录，请先在设置中启用。'; return; }
    if (!context.payload || context.payload.note !== note) {
      const source = context.source;
      context.payload = { actionType: 'add_note', platform: source.platform || 'X', postUrl: source.postUrl, postId: source.postId || null, authorHandle: source.authorHandle || null, pageTitle: source.pageTitle || contentFor(source)?.pageTitle || null, note, tags: [...(source.tags || [])], source: 'MANUAL_IMPORT', capturedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    noteBusy = true;
    const controls = [...document.querySelector('#timeline-note-form').querySelectorAll('button,textarea')];
    controls.forEach((control) => { control.disabled = true; });
    try {
      const result = context.local ? localCapture(context.payload) : await api('/v1/x/local-capture/events', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(context.payload) });
      if (result?.disabled) throw new Error('当前已关闭本地记录，请先在设置中启用。');
      if (!result?.event) throw new Error('备注尚未保存，请重试。');
      if (!context.local) {
        bridge = { connected: true, checked: true };
        state.events = [result.event, ...state.events.filter((item) => item.id !== result.event.id)].sort((a,b) => (Date.parse(T.time(b)) || 0) - (Date.parse(T.time(a)) || 0));
        try { saveState(); } catch { /* The API has confirmed the durable save. */ }
      }
      noteBusy = false; closeTimelineNote(); noteContext = null; render();
      document.querySelector('#timeline-note-feedback').textContent = context.local ? '备注已保存到此浏览器。' : '备注已保存，可在「添加备注」和「带备注」中查看。';
    } catch (caught) {
      error.textContent = (caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : '备注保存失败') + '；输入已保留，可重试。';
    } finally {
      noteBusy = false; controls.forEach((control) => { control.disabled = false; });
    }
  }
  function downloadExport() { const payload = { exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(), mode: 'LOCAL_CAPTURE', events: state.events, content: state.content, privateLibrary: state.privateLibrary, settings: state.settings }; const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); link.download = `mezip-x-local-capture-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`; link.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href); }
  async function pasteCaptureUrl() { const error = document.querySelector('#capture-error'); try { const value = await navigator.clipboard.readText(); if (!value.trim()) throw new Error('剪贴板没有可用链接。'); document.querySelector('#capture-url').value = value.trim(); error.textContent = ''; } catch { error.textContent = '无法读取剪贴板，请手动粘贴 X 链接。'; } }
  function bind() { window.addEventListener('hashchange', render); document.querySelector('#global-search-form')?.addEventListener('submit', (event) => { event.preventDefault(); runGlobalSearch(document.querySelector('#global-search')?.value); }); document.querySelector('#open-capture')?.addEventListener('click', openCaptureDialog); document.querySelector('#open-capture-timeline')?.addEventListener('click', openCaptureDialog); document.querySelector('#paste-capture-url')?.addEventListener('click', () => void pasteCaptureUrl()); document.querySelector('#capture-form')?.addEventListener('submit', submitCapture); document.querySelector('#period-filter')?.addEventListener('change', renderTimeline); document.querySelector('#timeline-search')?.addEventListener('input', renderTimeline); document.querySelector('#timeline-sort')?.addEventListener('change', renderTimeline); document.querySelector('#refresh-timeline')?.addEventListener('click', () => void probeBridge()); document.querySelector('#action-filters')?.addEventListener('click', (event) => { const button = event.target.closest('[data-filter]'); if (!button) return; currentFilter = button.dataset.filter; interestMode = null; renderTimeline(); }); document.querySelector('#interest-insights')?.addEventListener('click', (event) => { const target = event.target.closest('[data-interest-mode]'); if (target) selectInterest(target.dataset.interestMode) }); document.querySelector('#interest-summary')?.addEventListener('click', (event) => { const target = event.target.closest('[data-interest-mode]'); if (target) selectInterest(target.dataset.interestMode) }); document.querySelector('#tag-cloud')?.addEventListener('click', (event) => { const target = event.target.closest('[data-interest-mode]'); if (target) selectInterest(target.dataset.interestMode) }); document.querySelector('#export-data')?.addEventListener('click', downloadExport); document.querySelector('#retry-bridge')?.addEventListener('click', () => void probeBridge()); document.querySelector('#delete-history')?.addEventListener('click', async () => { if (!window.confirm('确定删除当前本地 Capture 历史吗？私人资料库不会被删除。')) return; try { await api('/v1/x/local-capture/history', { method: 'DELETE' }); } catch { state.events = []; state.content = []; saveState(); } await hydrateFromBridge().catch(() => {}); render(); }); ['enabled', 'captureLikes', 'captureBookmarks', 'captureViews', 'captureSharedLinks', 'watchCapture', 'savePageMetadata'].forEach((key) => document.querySelector(`#setting-${key}`)?.addEventListener('change', async (event) => { const patch = { [key]: event.target.checked }; try { state.settings = await api('/v1/x/local-capture/settings', { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify(patch) }); bridge.connected = true; } catch { state.settings = { ...state.settings, [key]: event.target.checked, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }; saveState(); } render(); })); }
  document.querySelector('#timeline-note-form')?.addEventListener('submit', submitTimelineNote);
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-close-timeline-note]').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', closeTimelineNote));
  document.querySelector('#timeline-note-dialog')?.addEventListener('cancel', (event) => { if (noteBusy) event.preventDefault(); });

===== FILE: standalone/mezip-local/apps/web/public/x-local-capture-v7/resources-app.js =====
(() => {
  const API = window.localStorage.getItem('mezip.x.local.capture.api') || 'http://127.0.0.1:4319';
  const STORAGE = 'mezip.resource.records.v1.browser-local';
  const SESSION_STORAGE = 'mezip.resource.open-sessions.v1.browser-local';
  const LIBRARY_STORAGE = 'mezip.x.local.capture.browser.v3';
  const state = { items: [], library: [], filter: 'all', query: '', loading: true, error: null, localOnly: false };
  const $ = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector);
  const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[character]));
  const formatDate = (value) => { if (!value) return '尚未从 ME.zip 打开'; const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '时间未知' : date.toLocaleString('zh-CN', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }); };
  const uid = () => window.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || `resource-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
  const normalize = (input) => ({ ...input, id: input.id || uid(), platform: input.platform || (() => { try { return new URL(input.url).hostname; } catch { return '未注明来源'; } })(), author: input.author || null, description: input.description || null, tags: Array.isArray(input.tags) ? input.tags : [], currentProgressPercent: Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(input.currentProgressPercent) || 0)), status: Number(input.currentProgressPercent) >= 100 ? 'COMPLETED' : (input.status || 'IN_PROGRESS'), liked: Boolean(input.liked), bookmarked: Boolean(input.bookmarked), openCount: Math.max(0, Number(input.openCount) || 0), firstOpenedAt: input.firstOpenedAt || null, lastOpenedAt: input.lastOpenedAt || null, createdAt: input.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(), updatedAt: input.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString() });
  const readLocal = () => { try { const value = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE) || '[]'); return Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(normalize) : []; } catch { return []; } };
  const writeLocal = () => window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, JSON.stringify(state.items));
  const addLocalOpenSession = (recordId, openedAt) => { try { const current = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(SESSION_STORAGE) || '[]'); const sessions = Array.isArray(current) ? current : []; sessions.unshift({ id: uid(), ownerId: 'browser-local', resourceRecordId: recordId, source: 'MEZIP_READING_HISTORY', openedAt, idempotencyKey: null, createdAt: openedAt }); window.localStorage.setItem(SESSION_STORAGE, JSON.stringify(sessions)); } catch { /* Record progress still remains available in browser-local mode. */ } };
  const readLocalLibrary = () => { try { const value = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(LIBRARY_STORAGE) || '{}'); return Array.isArray(value.privateLibrary) ? value.privateLibrary : []; } catch { return []; } };
  const writeLocalLibrary = () => { try { const value = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(LIBRARY_STORAGE) || '{}'); window.localStorage.setItem(LIBRARY_STORAGE, JSON.stringify({ ...value, privateLibrary: state.library })); } catch { /* browser storage may be unavailable */ } };
  async function api(path, options = {}) { const response = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, { credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(options.headers || {}) }, ...options }); const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload?.error?.message || `本地服务错误（${response.status}）`); return payload.data; }
  function label(type) { return ({ WEBPAGE: '网页', ARTICLE: '文章', CODE: '代码', X_LINK: 'X 链接' })[type] || type; }
  function icon(type) { return ({ WEBPAGE: '🌐', ARTICLE: '📄', CODE: '</>', X_LINK: '𝕏' })[type] || '▤'; }
  function isPrivate(item) { return state.library.some((entry) => entry.metadata?.resourceRecordId === item.id); }
  function filtered() { const needle = state.query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase(); return state.items.filter((item) => (state.filter === 'all' || item.resourceType === state.filter || item.status === state.filter) && (!needle || `${item.title} ${item.platform} ${item.author || ''} ${item.description || ''} ${item.note || ''} ${item.url} ${(item.tags || []).join(' ')}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle))); }
  function card(item) { const percent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(item.currentProgressPercent) || 0)); const privateState = isPrivate(item); const openLabel = item.openCount > 0 && item.status !== 'COMPLETED' ? '继续阅读' : '开始阅读'; return `<article class="resource-card panel"><div class="resource-main"><div class="resource-meta"><span class="tag">${icon(item.resourceType)} ${label(item.resourceType)}</span><span class="tag">来源 App / 网站：${escapeHtml(item.platform)}</span><span class="tag">发布者 / 作者：${escapeHtml(item.author || '未注明')}</span><span class="tag">${item.status === 'COMPLETED' ? '已完成' : '未完成'}</span>${item.liked ? '<span class="tag">❤️ 已点赞</span>' : ''}${item.bookmarked ? '<span class="tag">🔖 已收藏</span>' : ''}</div><h3>${escapeHtml(item.title)}</h3><p class="resource-description"><strong>作品介绍：</strong>${escapeHtml(item.description || item.note || '暂无介绍；可在编辑时补充。')}</p><p class="resource-url">原始链接：${escapeHtml(item.url)}</p><div class="resource-progress-row"><div class="resource-progress" aria-label="资源进度"><span style="width:${percent}%"></span></div><strong>${Math.round(percent)}%</strong></div></div><div class="resource-side"><time>最近打开：${escapeHtml(formatDate(item.lastOpenedAt))} · ${item.openCount} 次</time><div class="resource-inline"><input class="resource-progress-input" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="${Math.round(percent)}" aria-label="${escapeHtml(item.title)} 当前进度"><button class="button button-quiet resource-progress-save" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">更新进度</button></div><div class="resource-actions"><button class="button button-primary resource-open" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">${openLabel} ↗</button><a class="button button-quiet" href="./reading-detail.html?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">阅读详情</a><button class="button button-quiet resource-like ${item.liked ? 'like-on' : ''}" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">${item.liked ? '❤️ 已点赞' : '♡ 点赞'}</button><button class="button button-quiet resource-bookmark ${item.bookmarked ? 'bookmark-on' : ''}" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">${item.bookmarked ? '🔖 已收藏' : '☆ 收藏'}</button><button class="button button-quiet resource-copy" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">复制链接</button><button class="button button-special resource-private" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}" ${privateState ? 'disabled' : ''}>${privateState ? '✓ 已在私人资料库' : '★ 加入私人资料库'}</button><button class="button button-danger resource-delete" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">删除</button></div></div></article>`; }
  function render() { $('#resource-loading').classList.toggle('hidden', !state.loading); $('#resource-error').classList.toggle('hidden', state.error === null); $('#resource-error').innerHTML = state.error ? `<strong>资源记录读取失败</strong><span>${escapeHtml(state.error)}</span><button id="resource-retry-inline" class="button button-quiet">重试</button>` : ''; $('#resource-status').textContent = state.localOnly ? '浏览器本地模式' : '本地桥接已连接'; $('#resource-status').className = `pill ${state.localOnly ? 'pill-muted' : 'pill-green'}`; if (state.loading || state.error) { $('#resource-list').classList.add('hidden'); return; } const items = filtered(); $('#resource-count').textContent = `${items.length} 条`; $('#resource-list').classList.remove('hidden'); $('#resource-list').innerHTML = items.length ? items.map(card).join('') : `<div class="empty panel"><strong>${state.items.length ? '没有符合当前筛选的记录' : '还没有网页、文章或代码记录'}</strong><span>先在上方保存一条真实链接，不会生成假数据。</span></div>`; bind(); }
  async function update(id, patch) { try { const result = await api(`/v1/resources/records/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify(patch) }); const index = state.items.findIndex((item) => item.id === id); if (index >= 0) state.items[index] = result.record; } catch (error) { const index = state.items.findIndex((item) => item.id === id); if (index < 0) throw error; state.items[index] = normalize({ ...state.items[index], ...patch, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }); writeLocal(); state.localOnly = true; } render(); }
  async function openResource(id) { const item = state.items.find((entry) => entry.id === id); if (!item) return; const target = window.open('about:blank', '_blank'); try { if (state.localOnly) { const now = new Date().toISOString(); item.openCount = Math.max(0, Number(item.openCount) || 0) + 1; item.firstOpenedAt ||= now; item.lastOpenedAt = now; item.updatedAt = now; addLocalOpenSession(item.id, now); writeLocal(); } else { const result = await api(`/v1/resources/records/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/open`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ source: 'MEZIP_READING_HISTORY', idempotencyKey: uid() }) }); const index = state.items.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === id); if (index >= 0) state.items[index] = normalize(result.record); } if (target) { target.opener = null; target.location.replace(item.url); } else window.open(item.url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer'); render(); } catch (error) { if (target) target.close(); window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '无法记录打开历史'); } }
  async function bindAction(button, action) { button.disabled = true; try { await action(); } catch (error) { button.disabled = false; window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '操作失败'); } }
  function bind() { $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-open').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void openResource(button.dataset.id || ''))); $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-progress-save').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void bindAction(button, async () => { const input = [...$('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-progress-input')].find((candidate) => candidate.dataset.id === button.dataset.id); await update(button.dataset.id || '', { currentProgressPercent: Number(input?.value || 0) }); }))); $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-like').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void bindAction(button, () => { const item = state.items.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.id); return update(button.dataset.id || '', { liked: !item?.liked }); }))); $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-bookmark').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void bindAction(button, () => { const item = state.items.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.id); return update(button.dataset.id || '', { bookmarked: !item?.bookmarked }); }))); $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-copy').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void bindAction(button, async () => { const item = state.items.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.id); await navigator.clipboard.writeText(item?.url || ''); button.textContent = '已复制链接'; }))); $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-private').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void bindAction(button, async () => { const item = state.items.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.id); if (!item) return; try { await api(`/v1/resources/records/${encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.id || '')}/private-library`, { method: 'POST' }); } catch { const now = new Date().toISOString(); state.library = [...state.library, { id: uid(), ownerId: 'browser-local', userId: 'browser-local', sourceType: item.resourceType === 'X_LINK' ? 'X_POST' : item.resourceType, sourcePlatform: item.resourceType === 'X_LINK' ? 'X' : 'OTHER', sourceId: item.id, sourceUrl: item.url, title: item.title, content: item.description, authorName: item.author, authorHandle: item.resourceType === 'X_LINK' ? item.author : null, authorAvatar: null, media: [], thumbnail: null, publishedAt: null, savedAt: now, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, tags: item.tags || [], note: item.note || null, collectionId: null, privacy: 'PRIVATE', metadata: { resourceRecordId: item.id, resourceType: item.resourceType, platform: item.platform, status: item.status, progressPercent: item.currentProgressPercent } }]; writeLocalLibrary(); } await load(); }))); $('#resource-list').querySelectorAll('.resource-delete').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void bindAction(button, async () => { if (!window.confirm('删除这条资源记录？私人资料库中的独立资料不会被删除。')) return; try { await api(`/v1/resources/records/${encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.id || '')}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); } catch { state.items = state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== button.dataset.id); writeLocal(); state.localOnly = true; } state.items = state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== button.dataset.id); render(); }))); }
  async function load() { state.loading = true; state.error = null; render(); try { const [records, library] = await Promise.all([api('/v1/resources/records'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library')]); state.items = Array.isArray(records?.items) ? records.items.map(normalize) : []; state.library = Array.isArray(library?.items) ? library.items : []; state.localOnly = false; } catch (error) { state.items = readLocal(); state.library = readLocalLibrary(); state.localOnly = true; state.error = state.items.length ? null : (error instanceof Error ? error.message : '本地桥接不可用'); } finally { state.loading = false; render(); } }
  $('#resource-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const message = $('#resource-form-message'); message.textContent = '正在保存…'; const input = { resourceType: $('#resource-type').value, title: $('#resource-title').value.trim(), platform: $('#resource-platform').value.trim(), author: $('#resource-author').value.trim(), url: $('#resource-url').value.trim(), description: $('#resource-description').value.trim(), currentProgressPercent: Number($('#resource-progress').value || 0), tags: $('#resource-tags').value.split(',').map((tag) => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean) }; try { const result = await api('/v1/resources/records', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(input) }); state.items = [...state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== result.record.id), normalize(result.record)]; state.localOnly = false; } catch { const existing = state.items.find((item) => item.resourceType === input.resourceType && item.url === input.url); const record = normalize({ ...(existing || {}), ...input }); state.items = [record, ...state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== record.id)]; writeLocal(); state.localOnly = true; } event.target.reset(); $('#resource-progress').value = '0'; message.textContent = state.localOnly ? '已保存到浏览器本地资源记录。' : '已保存到本机资源记录。'; render(); });
  $('#resource-filters').addEventListener('click', (event) => { const button = event.target.closest('[data-filter]'); if (!button) return; state.filter = button.dataset.filter || 'all'; $('#resource-filters').querySelectorAll('button').forEach((item) => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button)); render(); });
  $('#resource-search').addEventListener('input', (event) => { state.query = event.target.value || ''; render(); });
  $('#resource-retry').addEventListener('click', () => void load());
  void load();
})();

===== FILE: standalone/mezip-local/apps/web/public/x-local-capture-v7/timeline-tools.js =====
(() => {
  const actions = [
    ['all', '全部'], ['like', '❤️ 点赞'], ['bookmark', '🔖 收藏'],
    ['unlike', '取消点赞'], ['unbookmark', '取消收藏'],
    ['follow', '关注'], ['unfollow', '取消关注'], ['viewed', '👁 浏览'],
    ['opened', '↗ 打开'], ['share_to_mezip', '📤 分享至 ME.zip'],
    ['copied_link', '🔗 复制 / 收集链接'], ['manual_save', '手动保存'],
    ['add_note', '添加备注'], ['notes', '带备注'],
  ];
  const recovered = (item) => item.recovered === true || item.captureMethod === 'VISIBLE_STATE';
  const time = (item) => recovered(item) ? (item.observedAt || item.capturedAt) : item.capturedAt;
  const label = (item) => recovered(item)
    ? `补收${item.actionType === 'like' ? '已点赞' : item.actionType === 'bookmark' ? '已收藏' : '已记录状态'}`
    : (actions.find(([key]) => key === item.actionType)?.[1] || item.actionType || 'X 记录');
  function matches(item, filter) {
    if (filter === 'all') return true;
    if (filter === 'notes') return Boolean(item.note?.trim());
    if (filter === 'saved_links') return ['copied_link', 'manual_save'].includes(item.actionType);
    return item.actionType === filter;
  }
  function contentFor(item, content) {
    const id = item.postId || /\/status\/(\d+)/.exec(item.postUrl || '')?.[1];
    return content.find((entry) => entry.postUrl === item.postUrl || (id && (entry.postId || /\/status\/(\d+)/.exec(entry.postUrl || '')?.[1]) === id));
  }
  function searchText(item, content = []) {
    const cached = contentFor(item, content) || {};
    return [label(item), item.postUrl, item.authorHandle, item.pageTitle, item.note,
      cached.pageTitle, cached.textExcerpt, cached.authorHandle, ...(item.tags || [])].filter(Boolean).join(' ').toLocaleLowerCase();
  }
  function periodStart(period) {
    const now = new Date();
    if (period === 'today') return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    if (period === 'week') return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate() - ((now.getDay() + 6) % 7));
    if (period === 'month') return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
    if (period === 'year') return new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1);
    return null;
  }
  async function loadX(api) {
    const events = new Map(), content = new Map(), cursors = new Set();
    let cursor = null;
    for (let page = 0; page < 100; page += 1) {
      const data = await api(`/v1/x/local-capture/timeline?limit=100${cursor ? `&cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}` : ''}`);
      for (const item of data?.events || []) events.set(item.id || `${item.actionType}|${item.capturedAt}|${item.postUrl}`, item);
      for (const item of data?.content || []) content.set(item.id || item.postUrl, item);
      cursor = data?.nextCursor == null ? null : String(data.nextCursor);
      if (!cursor) return { events: [...events.values()], content: [...content.values()], truncated: false };
      if (cursors.has(cursor)) throw new Error('X 时间轴分页游标重复，请重新读取。');
      cursors.add(cursor);
    }
    return { events: [...events.values()], content: [...content.values()], truncated: true };
  }
  window.TimelineTools = { actions, recovered, time, label, matches, contentFor, searchText, periodStart, loadX };
})();

===== FILE: standalone/mezip-local/apps/web/public/x-local-capture-v7/watch-app.js =====
(() => {
  const API = window.localStorage.getItem('mezip.x.local.capture.api') || 'http://127.0.0.1:4319';
  const state = { items: [], library: [], filter: 'recent', query: new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('q') || '', loading: true, error: null };
  const $ = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector);
  const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[character]));
  const formatTime = (seconds) => { const value = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(seconds) || 0)); const h = Math.floor(value / 3600); const m = Math.floor((value % 3600) / 60); const s = value % 60; return h ? `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}` : `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`; };
  const formatDate = (value) => { const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '时间未知' : date.toLocaleString('zh-CN', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }); };
  async function api(path, options = {}) { const response = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, { credentials: 'include', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(options.headers || {}) }, ...options }); const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload?.error?.message || `本地服务错误（${response.status}）`); return payload.data; }
  function isPrivate(item) { return state.library.some((entry) => entry.sourcePlatform === 'WATCH' && (entry.sourceId === item.contentKey || entry.metadata?.contentKey === item.contentKey)); }
  function filteredItems() { const query = state.query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase(); return state.items.filter((item) => { if (state.filter === 'continue' && item.status === 'COMPLETED') return false; if (state.filter === 'completed' && item.status !== 'COMPLETED') return false; if (state.filter === 'movie' && !['MOVIE', 'EPISODE'].includes(item.contentType)) return false; if (state.filter === 'video' && ['MOVIE', 'EPISODE'].includes(item.contentType)) return false; return !query || `${item.title} ${item.subtitle || ''} ${item.creator || ''} ${item.platform} ${item.domain} ${item.url}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query); }); }
  function empty(text, detail = '') { return `<div class="empty panel"><strong>${escapeHtml(text)}</strong>${detail ? `<span>${escapeHtml(detail)}</span>` : ''}</div>`; }
  function resumeUrl(item) {
    const raw = String(item.url || '');
    const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(item.currentTimeSeconds) || 0));
    if (!raw || item.status === 'COMPLETED' || seconds <= 0) return raw;
    try {
      const url = new URL(raw);
      if (/youtube\.com$|youtu\.be$/iu.test(url.hostname)) url.searchParams.set('t', `${seconds}s`);
      else if (/bilibili\.com$|b23\.tv$/iu.test(url.hostname)) url.searchParams.set('t', String(seconds));
      else url.hash = `t=${seconds}`;
      return url.toString();
    } catch { return raw; }
  }
  function card(item) { const percent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Number(item.progressPercent) || 0)); const image = item.poster || item.thumbnail; const privateState = isPrivate(item); const primary = item.status === 'COMPLETED' ? '重新打开' : '继续观看'; return `<article class="watch-card panel"><div class="watch-poster${image ? '' : ' placeholder'}">${image ? `<img class="watch-poster" src="${escapeHtml(image)}" alt="${escapeHtml(item.title)}">` : '▶'}</div><div class="watch-main"><h3>${escapeHtml(item.title)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(item.subtitle || '真实播放记录')} · ${escapeHtml(item.platform)} · ${escapeHtml(item.domain)}</p><div class="watch-meta"><span class="tag">${item.contentType === 'MOVIE' || item.contentType === 'EPISODE' ? '电影' : '视频'}</span>${item.creator ? `<span class="tag">${escapeHtml(item.creator)}</span>` : ''}<span class="tag">${item.status === 'COMPLETED' ? '已看完' : item.status === 'IN_PROGRESS' ? '继续观看' : '已开始'}</span></div><div class="watch-progress-row"><div class="watch-progress" aria-label="观看进度"><span style="width:${percent}%"></span></div><strong>${Math.round(percent)}%</strong></div><div class="watch-times">${formatTime(item.currentTimeSeconds)} / ${item.durationSeconds > 0 ? formatTime(item.durationSeconds) : '时长未知'} · 实际观看 ${formatTime(item.totalWatchSeconds)}</div></div><div class="watch-side"><time>最近观看：${escapeHtml(formatDate(item.lastWatchedAt))}</time><div class="watch-actions"><a class="button button-quiet" href="${escapeHtml(resumeUrl(item))}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">${primary}</a><a class="button button-quiet" href="./watch-detail.html?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}">详情</a><button class="button button-special watch-private" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}" ${privateState ? 'disabled' : ''}>${privateState ? '✓ 已入私人资料库' : '★ 加入私人资料库'}</button><button class="button button-quiet watch-delete" data-id="${escapeHtml(item.id)}">删除记录</button></div></div></article>`; }
  function render() { $('#watch-loading').classList.toggle('hidden', !state.loading); $('#watch-error').classList.toggle('hidden', state.error === null); $('#watch-error').innerHTML = state.error ? `<strong>观看记录读取失败</strong><span>${escapeHtml(state.error)}</span><button id="retry-watch-inline" class="button button-quiet">重试</button>` : ''; if (state.loading || state.error) { $('#watch-list').classList.add('hidden'); return; } const items = filteredItems(); $('#watch-count').textContent = `${items.length} 条`; $('#watch-list').classList.remove('hidden'); $('#watch-list').innerHTML = items.length ? items.map(card).join('') : empty(state.items.length ? '没有符合当前筛选的记录' : '还没有观看记录', '请在 Edge 中真实播放一个视频；仅打开页面不会创建记录。'); $('#watch-list').querySelectorAll('.watch-private').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void addPrivate(button))); $('#watch-list').querySelectorAll('.watch-delete').forEach((button) => button.addEventListener('click', () => void deleteRecord(button))); $('#retry-watch-inline')?.addEventListener('click', () => void load()); }
  async function addPrivate(button) { button.disabled = true; const item = state.items.find((entry) => entry.id === button.dataset.id); if (!item) return; try { await api(`/v1/watch/records/${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}/private-library`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ tags: [item.contentType === 'MOVIE' || item.contentType === 'EPISODE' ? '电影' : '视频'] }) }); await load(); } catch (error) { button.disabled = false; window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '加入私人资料库失败'); } }
  async function deleteRecord(button) { const id = button.dataset.id; if (!id || !window.confirm('删除这条观看记录？私人资料库中的独立资料不会被删除。')) return; button.disabled = true; try { await api(`/v1/watch/records/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }); state.items = state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== id); render(); } catch (error) { button.disabled = false; window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '删除观看记录失败'); } }
  async function load() { state.loading = true; state.error = null; render(); try { const [watch, library] = await Promise.all([api('/v1/watch/records?limit=100'), api('/v1/x/local-capture/private-library')]); state.items = Array.isArray(watch?.items) ? watch.items : []; state.library = Array.isArray(library?.items) ? library.items : []; $('#watch-status').textContent = '本地桥接已连接'; $('#watch-status').className = 'pill pill-green'; } catch (error) { state.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : '本地桥接不可用'; $('#watch-status').textContent = '本地桥接不可用'; $('#watch-status').className = 'pill pill-red'; } finally { state.loading = false; render(); } }
  $('#watch-filters').addEventListener('click', (event) => { const button = event.target.closest('[data-filter]'); if (!button) return; state.filter = button.dataset.filter || 'recent'; $('#watch-filters').querySelectorAll('button').forEach((item) => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button)); render(); });
  $('#watch-search').addEventListener('input', (event) => { state.query = event.target.value || ''; render(); });
  $('#retry-watch').addEventListener('click', () => void load());
  $('#watch-search').value = state.query;
  void load();
})();

===== FILE: standalone/mezip-local/apps/web/public/x-local-capture-v8/app.js =====
(() => {
  const dialog = document.querySelector('#capture-dialog');

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-close-capture-dialog]').forEach((button) => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!dialog) return;
      if (typeof dialog.close === 'function') dialog.close();
      else dialog.removeAttribute('open');
    });
  });
})();
